Checked 2026-09-25: The patient cohort and quote are right, but NMIBC includes lamina-propria-invasive T1 tumours (the paper builds a separate T1HG classifier), so a non-invasive carcinoma term is narrower than the disease the source names.

label: Cardiometabolic Risk in Chinese Study
quote: In the cardiometabolic risk in Chinese (CRC) study, we performed a community-based health examination survey for 6,431 individuals (18-93y) who were randomly selected from residents living in the urban area of Xuzhou, China, in 2009.
note: Community-based health examination survey of randomly selected, apparently healthy urban residents of Xuzhou studying cardiometabolic risk factors (insulin resistance, hypertension, early atherosclerosis); a general population survey with a broad risk-factor purpose rather than one disease, and no exposure design.

label: Cooperative Research Centre Cohort
quote: Participants were included if they: (1) were aged 18 years or older, (2) had a primary diagnosis of schizophrenia spectrum disorder (SSD), and (3) were using clozapine (no minimum duration of treatment).
note: Australian cohort of clozapine-treated patients with schizophrenia spectrum disorder recruited around Melbourne for pharmacogenomic studies of treatment outcome; a patient cohort, and clozapine treatment is a medication, not an environmental exposure. Checked 2026-09-25: The inclusion criteria that apply to all five cohorts, CRC among them, require a primary diagnosis of schizophrenia spectrum disorder, so the patient verdict stands; schizophrenia alone is narrower than the spectrum the source names.

label: Consortium for Refractive Error and Myopia
quote: Thus, we conducted the largest GWAS meta-analysis of CC to date, incorporating both European and Asian cohorts in a single analysis from the Consortium for Refractive Error and Myopia (CREAM) and validated our findings in the United Kingdom (UK) Biobank.
note: International consortium pooling population and clinical eye cohorts (Beaver Dam Eye Study, AREDS, ANZRAG) for GWAS of refractive error, myopia and ocular biometry; myopia, an eye disorder, is its stated subject, though the analysed phenotypes are continuous ocular traits, so borderline with a trait consortium. No exposure design.

label: Doetinchem Cohort Study
quote: In 1987 it started with an age-sex-stratified sample (20–59 years) of the inhabitants of Doetinchem, a mid-size Dutch town
note: Population-based RIVM cohort of Doetinchem inhabitants that began as cardiovascular risk-factor monitoring and is now explicitly a study of lifestyle (smoking, physical activity, alcohol, nutrition) and other determinants of chronic conditions and ageing, so lifestyle exposure is a stated design purpose, though shared with other determinants; its disease purpose (chronic conditions, ageing) is broad.

label: Genes-environments & Admixture in Latino Americans
quote: Cases were subjects with a physician diagnosis of asthma and manifestations of symptoms within the two years before recruitment, while controls were selected based on the absence of a medical history of asthma, allergic diseases, or other respiratory affections.
note: GALA II is a clinic-based case-control study of Latino children and young adults with and without physician-diagnosed asthma, so it is a disease cohort (direct statement). Its stated aim is the genetic and environmental basis of childhood asthma, which makes exposure a declared design purpose, but the bundle names no specific exposures for GALA II, so the exposure verdict is medium and the category is 'other'.

label: Groningen Expert Center for Kids with Obesity Drenthe study
quote: The GECKO (Groningen Expert Center for Kids with Obesity) Drenthe study is a population-based birth cohort with a focus on early risk factors for overweight and obesity.
note: GECKO Drenthe is a population-based Dutch birth cohort whose stated focus is early risk factors for overweight and obesity, a single disease focus in a general birth cohort. Lifestyle behaviours (diet, activity, screen time, sleep) are studied as risk factors but exposure is not the organising principle, so it is not an exposure cohort. Checked 2026-09-25: The quote (verbatim, checked with cached.py) gives a population birth cohort focused on overweight and obesity, so the verdict stands, but the two conditions are one entry each and the single obesity term covers only one of them.

label: Genes and Environment in Multiple Sclerosis
quote: GEMS identified prevalent cases fulfilling the McDonald criteria from the Swedish National MS registry.
note: GEMS is a Swedish population-based case-control study of prevalent multiple sclerosis drawn from the national MS registry, so a patient cohort. Its declared aim is genetic and environmental risk factors, with a dedicated questionnaire on environmental exposures and lifestyle factors (smoking, passive smoking, alcohol, sun exposure) and residential air-pollution assessment, so exposure is a stated design purpose alongside genetics; medium because the design is disease-first.

label: Georgia Stress and Heart Study
quote: The participants were from the Georgia Stress and Heart (GSH) study, an ongoing longitudinal study designed to evaluate the development of cardiovascular risk factors from childhood to adulthood
note: GSH is a longitudinal cohort of normotensive children recruited by public-school screening and followed into adulthood; its stated design is to evaluate the development of cardiovascular risk factors, one disease family, so it is a population study of cardiovascular disease. Psychosocial stress and lifestyle are covariates, not environmental exposures defining the cohort.

label: Health and Ageing in Africa: A Longitudinal Study of an INDEPTH Community in South Africa
quote: Socio-demographic data, infection history, and cognitive performance data were collected from 5059 consented participants (male (n = 2345) and female (n = 2714)) aged 40 years and older recruited from Bushbuckridge, Mpumalanga (November 2014 to November 2015) and a sub-set of 2246 of these participants (male (n = 935) and female (n = 1311)) had genotype data.
note: HAALSI is a population-based study of adults aged 40 and over in a rural South African surveillance area, collecting health and ageing data; a broad health-and-ageing purpose with no exposure or disease selection.

label: Agincourt Health and Socio-demographic Surveillance System
quote: The HDSS (90 000 people), based on an annual update of resident status and vital events, now supports multiple investigations into the causes and consequences of complex health, population and social transitions.
note: The Agincourt HDSS is a whole-population health and demographic surveillance system in rural South Africa supporting many studies of health, population and social transitions; neither exposure nor disease defines it.

label: Health2006 Study
quote: Health2006 is a population-based epidemiological study of general health, diabetes and cardiovascular disease of 3,471 individuals aged 18–74 years [48].
note: Health2006 is a random population sample from the Danish civil register studied for general health, allergy, diabetes and cardiovascular disease: a broad general-population purpose covering several disease areas, so not a disease cohort, and exposures are not a design focus.

label: Heidelberger Langzeitstudie zu Risikofaktoren und Diagnose chronischer Erkrankungen
quote: Briefly, HeiDE (‘Heidelberger Langzeitstudie zu Risikofaktoren und Diagnose chronischer Erkrankungen’) is a population-based study carried out in the German city of Heidelberg and surrounding area with an initial aim of characterising associations of personality and somatic disease.
note: HeiDE is a population-based cohort of Heidelberg adults assessed for health-related personality traits and followed for chronic (somatic) disease in general; a broad chronic-disease purpose and no environmental exposure focus.

label: Heart Failure Molecular Epidemiology for Therapeutic Targets Consortium
quote: The HERMES (HEart failure Molecular Epidemiology for Therapeutic targetS) consortium aims to identify the genomic and molecular basis of heart failure.
note: HERMES is a consortium of 51 studies pooling heart failure cases (with controls) from population cohorts, EHR cohorts, case-control studies and trials for heart failure genetics, so a disease aggregation classified by what it collects; no exposure focus.

label: International Glaucoma Genetics Consortium
quote: The IGGC is a large international consortium established to identify glaucoma genetic risk genes through large-scale meta-analysis43,44.
note: The IGGC is an international consortium meta-analysing primary open-angle glaucoma case-control GWAS and glaucoma endophenotypes, so a disease aggregation; nothing about environmental exposure.

label: International HIV Controllers Study
quote: To determine the genetic basis for this rare phenomenon, we established a multinational consortium (www.hivcontrollers.org) to recruit HIV-1 controllers, who are defined by at least three measurements of plasma virus load (VL) < 2000 RNA copies/ml over at least a 12-month period in the absence of antiviral therapy.
note: The International HIV Controllers Study recruits people living with HIV-1 who spontaneously control viral load, for host genetics of HIV control; participants are selected by infection status (a disease), not as exposed-uninfected, so it is a patient cohort and not an exposure cohort.

label: Immunomodulation and Multiple Sclerosis Epidemiology
quote: Current projects include an incidence cohort (EIMS), post-marketing cohorts of patients on novel disease-modifying drugs (IMSE), and a prevalence cohort (GEMS).
note: IMSE is a set of Swedish phase IV post-marketing cohorts of multiple sclerosis patients treated with disease-modifying drugs, followed through the Swedish MS registry; a patient cohort whose only 'exposure' is medication, which is out of scope.

label: International Parkinson Disease Genomics Consortium
quote: This work has centered on available genome wide SNP genotyping of IPDGC members case and control cohorts from the USA, Canada, England, Wales, The Netherlands, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Austria, Finland, Norway, Estonia, and Australia (Fig. 1).
note: The IPDGC pools Parkinson disease case and control cohorts worldwide for collaborative genetics research, so a disease aggregation; no exposure focus.

label: Japan PGx Data Science Consortium Database
quote: The database contains the genotypes of 2.5 million single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) and 5 human leukocyte antigen loci from 2994 Japanese healthy volunteers, as well as 121 kinds of clinical information, including self-reports, physiological data, hematological data and biochemical data.
note: The JPDSC database is a collection of 2994 healthy Japanese volunteers assembled as control data for pharmacogenomics studies: healthy volunteers, no disease and no exposure selection.

label: Justification for the Use of Statins in Prevention: an Intervention Trial Evaluating Rosuvastatin
quote: JUPITER was a randomized, double‐blind, placebo‐controlled trial of rosuvastatin 20 mg daily versus placebo in the primary prevention of CVD in 17 802 asymptomatic men ≥50 years and women ≥60 years with low‐density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL‐C) <130 mg/dL and hsCRP (high‐sensitivity C‐reactive protein) ≥2.0 mg/L who were monitored for a median follow‐up period of 1.9 years (maximum 5 years).
note: JUPITER is a primary-prevention statin trial in asymptomatic older adults selected for elevated high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (chronic inflammation), a cardiovascular risk marker, so participants were chosen for their risk of cardiovascular disease rather than having it. The only intervention is a medication, so it is not an exposure cohort.

label: KOALA Birth Cohort Study
quote: The aim of the KOALA Birth Cohort Study in the Netherlands is to identify factors that influence the clinical expression of atopic disease with a main focus on lifestyle (e.g., anthroposophy, vaccinations, antibiotics, dietary habits, breastfeeding and breast milk composition, intestinal microflora composition, infections during the first year of life, and gene-environment interaction).
note: KOALA is a Dutch birth cohort set up to identify factors influencing atopic disease, so a population study of one disease family (direct statement). Its design centres on lifestyle exposures, recruiting an 'alternative lifestyle' group (organic or vegetarian diet, anthroposophy, no vaccination or antibiotics) for contrast with conventional families, which makes lifestyle exposure a stated design purpose; medium because these are lifestyle rather than classical environmental agents.

label: Mayo Clinic Breast Cancer Study
quote: The Mayo Clinic Breast Cancer Study (MCBCS) is an on-going clinic-based case-control study initiated in February 2001 at Mayo Clinic, Rochester, MN.
note: MCBCS is a clinic-based case-control study of women with invasive breast cancer and cancer-free controls at Mayo Clinic, so a patient cohort; no exposure focus.

label: Mayo Mammography Health Study
quote: The MMHS prospectively enrolled patients scheduled for a screening mammogram from October 2003 through September 2006 at the Mayo Clinic in Rochester, MN.
note: MMHS is a prospective cohort of women without prior breast cancer enrolled at routine screening mammography, established to study mammographic density and breast cancer risk (it is a BCAC member). Participants are an unselected screening population, so the role is population study of one disease rather than patients or at risk; no exposure focus.

label: North American Rheumatoid Arthritis Consortium
quote: The North American Rheumatoid Arthritis Consortium, using well-defined clinical criteria, has collected 257 families containing 301 affected sibling pairs with RA.
note: NARAC is a collection of multiplex rheumatoid arthritis families (affected sibling pairs) later extended with RA case-control collections, so a patient cohort; no exposure focus.

label: National Biobank of Korea
quote: As of December 2011, a total of 525,416 biospecimens with related information have been secured: 325,952 biospecimens from the general population obtained through cohort studies and 199,464 biospecimens of patients from regional biobanks.
note: The National Biobank of Korea is the national hub biobank holding general-population cohort samples (KoGES) and hospital patient samples across many diseases; a broad biobank aggregation with neither a single disease nor an exposure focus.

label: Northern Sweden Health and Disease Study
quote: The NSHDS is a population-based prospective longitudinal cohort comprising >140 000 participants in the two northernmost regions in Sweden, Norrbotten and Västerbotten, with >240 000 blood samples and 1.5 million person-years of follow-up.
note: NSHDS is a population-based prospective cohort combining the Västerbotten Intervention Programme, Northern Sweden MONICA and the Mammography Screening Project. The cohort profile says it was initiated with a cancer focus to complement the cardiovascular focus of VIP and MONICA, so as a whole its purpose spans cancer, cardiovascular and other diseases: a broad health-and-disease cohort rather than a study of one disease; no exposure focus.

label: Ontario Familial Breast Cancer Registry
quote: Epidemiology questionnaire data are available for 6779 affected probands (with a personal history of breast cancer), 4116 unaffected probands, and 16,526 relatives with or without a personal history of breast or ovarian cancer.
note: The OFBCR is the Ontario site of the Breast Cancer Family Registry, enrolling women with invasive breast cancer identified through the Ontario Cancer Registry together with their relatives and population controls; the registry is built around affected probands (relatives are at risk), so patients, breast cancer. The quote describes the whole registry of which Ontario is a site. No exposure focus.

label: Prolonged Anticoagulation During eighteen months vs placebo after Initial Six-month treatment for a first episode of idiopathic Pulmonary Embolism
quote: 371 adult patients who had experienced a first episode of symptomatic unprovoked pulmonary embolism (ie, with no major risk factor for thrombosis) and had been treated initially for 6 uninterrupted months with a vitamin K antagonist were randomized and followed up between July 2007 and September 2014 in 14 French centers.
note: PADIS-PE is a randomised trial of extended anticoagulation in adults after a first unprovoked pulmonary embolism, so all participants have the disease; the only exposure is a medication, which is out of scope.

label: Polish Breast Cancer Study
quote: Incident cases from 2000–2003 identified through a rapid identification system in participating hospitals covering ∼90% of all eligible cases; periodic check against the cancer registries in Warsaw and Łódź to assure complete identification of cases
note: The Polish Breast Cancer Study is a population-based case-control study of incident breast cancer in Warsaw and Lodz (the quote is its entry in a table of breast cancer case series), so a patient cohort; no exposure focus.

label: Predicting Risk Of Cancer At Screening
quote: We recruited women (aged 47–73 years) into the PROCAS (Predicting Risk Of Cancer At Screening; Manchester, UK: 2009–2013) Study.
note: PROCAS recruited women attending routine NHS breast screening in Greater Manchester, collecting risk-factor questionnaires and breast density to predict breast cancer risk; an unselected screening population studied for one disease, so population study of breast cancer (the name states the purpose). No exposure focus.

label: Qingdao Twin Registry
quote: Over 11,000 pairs of twins and multiples of all ages have been recruited into the registry.
note: A registry of twins and multiples of all ages in Qingdao, sampled for heritability and gene-environment studies of chronic disease, metabolic disorders, health behaviours and ageing. A twin registry with a broad chronic-disease remit is neither an exposure nor a disease cohort; tobacco and alcohol use are studied as outcomes among many, not a recruitment basis.

label: Chinese National Twin Registry
quote: Materials and Methods Study Sample All participants were recruited from the Chinese National Twin Registry (CNTR), the first established, largest population-based twin registry in China.
note: A population-based twin registry of over 61,000 twin pairs from 11 Chinese provinces used to analyse genetic and environmental influences on chronic diseases, especially cardiovascular. The remit is broad and the participants are unselected twins, so no on both counts; sampling disease-concordant and discordant pairs for specimens does not make the registry a disease cohort.

label: Reproductive Genetics Consortium
quote: The ReproGen consortium is an international network of investigators interested in better understanding the genetic basis of reproductive ageing.
note: A GWAS meta-analysis consortium on reproductive ageing and timing (age at menarche, age at natural menopause) across many population cohorts. Menopause and reproductive timing are normal variation, not disease, and no environmental exposure is its subject.

label: Singapore and Sweden Breast Cancer Study
quote: The Singapore and Sweden Breast Cancer Study (SASBAC) is a population-based case-control study of postmenopausal breast cancer in women aged 50 to 74 years born in Sweden.
note: A population-based case-control study of postmenopausal breast cancer in Sweden (also CAHRES, Cancer Hormone Replacement Epidemiology in Sweden), with incident cases from the cancer registries and population controls. The cases make it a disease cohort; hormone replacement therapy is a medication, not an environmental exposure. Checked 2026-09-25: SASBAC/CAHRES is a population-based case-control study of postmenopausal breast cancer, and the same study also enrolled endometrial cancer cases: the endometrial cancer GWAS supplement (https://media.springernature.com/original/springer-static/esm/art%3A10.1038%2Fng.3562/MediaObjects/41588_2016_BFng3562_MOESM301_ESM.pdf) says 'Formerly known as the Singapore and Sweden Breast/Endometrial Cancer Study (SASBAC), this population based case- control study was conducted among Swedish women aged 50-74 years' and 'Endometrial cancer cases were identified through the nation-wide cancer registries in Sweden.'

label: Samuel Lunenfeld Research Institute Study
quote: SLRIc /Toronto 331 499 Toronto, Canada Hospital-based case–control
note: The Toronto lung cancer study of the Samuel Lunenfeld Research Institute, listed in Table 1 of the TRICL meta-analysis as a hospital-based case-control study of 331 lung cancer cases and 499 controls, and described as the lung cancer study from Canada (University of Toronto and Samuel Lunenfeld Research Institute). Smoking is analysed as a covariate, not a recruitment basis.

label: Seoul National University Bundang Hospital cohort
quote: The Seoul National University Bundang Hospital (SNUBH) cohort comprises 1,216 participants, consisting of 610 patients with GC and 606 non-cancer controls, with ages ranging from 26 to 80 years, who were recruited from the enrolled participants who visited the Digestive Disease Center, SNUBH.
note: A hospital-based case-control cohort of gastric cancer patients and non-cancer controls at the Digestive Disease Center of SNUBH, Korea, genotyped to study gastric cancer risk by histological type and sex. Helicobacter pylori status and smoking are adjustment covariates, not the recruitment basis.

label: Tohoku Medical Megabank Community-Based Cohort Study
quote: Inclusion criteria were aged 20 years or over and living in Miyagi or Iwate Prefecture.
note: A community cohort of adults living in Miyagi and Iwate Prefectures, the areas devastated by the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake, established to assess the long-term impact of the disaster on its victims (with disaster-effect and psychological-distress data) alongside gene-environment interactions. Residents of a disaster area followed for that exposure; the disease remit (cancer, cardiovascular disease) is broad, so not a disease cohort.

label: Tohoku Medical Megabank Project Birth and Three-Generation Cohort Study
quote: We recruited pregnant women and their fetuses as probands.
note: A birth and three-generation cohort of pregnant women, their fetuses and extended families in Miyagi Prefecture, run by the Tohoku Medical Megabank Project, which the profile says was established because of concern about the middle- and long-term health impacts of the 2011 earthquake and tsunami on affected people; the cohort records personal GEJE experience and disaster-related information. A disaster-area cohort, though its main stated purpose is genome and omics study of disease risk across generations, hence medium; that broad remit is not a disease focus.

label: TRacking Adolescents' Individual Lives Survey Clinical Cohort
quote: The clinical cohort consists of individuals who have been referred to a child psychiatric outpatient clinic in the Northern Netherlands any time before the age of 11.
note: The TRAILS clinical cohort: 543 Dutch children referred to a child psychiatric outpatient clinic before age 11 (predominantly ADHD, disruptive behaviour and autism-spectrum diagnoses), followed alongside the TRAILS population cohort. A patient series of child psychiatric disorders; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Taiwan-US Diabetic Retinopathy Study
quote: Control subjects in the GWAS analyses were defined as subjects with type 2 diabetes without DR; case subjects were subjects with type 2 diabetes with either of the defined DR phenotypes.
note: A Taiwanese collection of Chinese people with type 2 diabetes, with (124) and without (654) severe non-proliferative or proliferative diabetic retinopathy, assembled 1996-2011 for genetic studies of diabetic retinopathy (Table 1 of the pooled Mendelian randomization paper). The quoted case and control definition applies to all 18 DR GWAS in that paper, TUDR among them, hence medium; all participants are diabetic patients.

label: Breakthrough Generations Study
quote: The Breakthrough Generations Study is a long-term prospective cohort study focussed on potential aetiological factors for breast cancer in women.
note: A UK general-population cohort of 112,049 women (and some men) recruited by generational referral from 2003, with repeated questionnaires and blood samples, whose stated purpose is breast cancer aetiology. A general population cohort set up for one disease; endogenous and exogenous risk factors are studied, but no environmental agent defines the design.

label: DiaGene Study
quote: The DiaGene study is a multi-centre, prospective, extensively phenotyped type 2 diabetes cohort study with concurrent inclusion of diabetes-free individuals at baseline as controls in the city of Eindhoven, The Netherlands.
note: A prospective cohort of 1886 patients with type 2 diabetes from primary care and outpatient clinics in Eindhoven, with 854 diabetes-free controls, studying the aetiology and vascular complications of type 2 diabetes. Patients with one disease; no exposure basis.

label: Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma in Childhood
quote: COPSAC2000 is a mother child cohort where all the mothers had a history of a doctor’s diagnosis of asthma after 7 years of age and thus this is a high risk asthma cohort comprising 411 children.
note: The Danish COPSAC programme collects two mother-child birth cohorts built around childhood asthma: COPSAC2000, 411 children of mothers with doctor-diagnosed asthma (a high-risk cohort), and COPSAC2010, 700 children of unselected mothers followed for the same asthma remit. Classified by the at-risk member and the programme's single disease focus; nothing environmental defines recruitment.

label: ProHealth Kaiser GWAS
quote: A genome-wide association study (GWAS) of prostate cancer in Kaiser Permanente health plan members (7,783 cases, 38,595 controls; 80.3% non-Hispanic white, 4.9% African-American, 7.0% East Asian, and 7.8% Latino)
note: A GWAS sample assembled from Kaiser Permanente studies (RPGEH, the ProHealth Study and the California Men's Health Study) for prostate cancer cases, with GERA men without a prostate cancer diagnosis as controls. An aggregation built around prostate cancer cases; no exposure basis.

label: Genetics of Pancreatic Beta-cell Failure in Mexican-Americans
quote: BetaGene recruited non-diabetic women with a history of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), their adult family members, and women without history of GDM.
note: A family study of Mexican Americans in Los Angeles designed to find genetic determinants of pancreatic beta-cell function, within the GUARDIAN diabetes consortium: probands are non-diabetic women with prior gestational diabetes, a group at high risk of type 2 diabetes, with their relatives and women without GDM as comparison. At-risk selection follows from the design; no exposure basis.

label: Gene-Lifestyle Interactions in Dental Endpoints
quote: the Gene-Lifestyle Interactions in Dental Endpoints (GLIDE) consortium18, which is a unique collection of epidemiological cohorts with detailed information on clinical endpoints of dental diseases
note: A consortium of population cohorts (ARIC, SHIP, NFBC1966, MDC, TWINGENE, HCHS/SOL, WGHS, BBJ) and dental registries formed to meta-analyse GWAS of dental caries and periodontitis. Classified by its dental-disease remit, like a meta-analysis consortium on one topic; despite the word lifestyle in its name, the described work is genetic association on dental endpoints, not exposure measurement, so not an exposure cohort.

label: Harvard Aging Brain Study
quote: The Harvard Aging Brain Study (HABS NIH-P01AG036694) is a longitudinal observational study designed to further our understanding of differentiating “normal” aging from preclinical Alzheimer’s Dementia (AD).
note: A longitudinal study of cognitively normal older volunteers (CDR 0, MMSE above 25) in Boston with amyloid PET, MRI and cognitive testing, whose single stated purpose is preclinical Alzheimer's disease. Participants are neither patients nor selected for elevated risk, so population study of one disease; no exposure basis.

label: Hong Kong Osteoporosis Study
quote: We used data from the Hong Kong Osteoporosis Study (HKOS), which was the first prospective cohort study of osteoporosis and fracture in Asia [28].
note: A prospective cohort of community-dwelling Southern Chinese adults in Hong Kong recruited 1995-2010 and set up to study osteoporosis and fracture, followed through territory-wide electronic health records. A community cohort with one disease family as its purpose; coffee intake and other exposures are analysed but do not define the design.

label: Study of Asthma Phenotypes and Pharmacogenomic Interactions by Race-Ethnicity
quote: SAPPHIRE Recruitment The Study of Asthma Phenotypes and Pharmacogenomic Interactions by Race-ethnicity (SAPPHIRE) is an ongoing study that was approved by the Institutional Review Board of Henry Ford Health System.
note: Henry Ford Health System members aged 12-56 in metropolitan Detroit enrolled with and without a clinical diagnosis of asthma (per the definition) to study asthma phenotypes and pharmacogenomics across racial and ethnic groups; the food-allergy paper adjusts for asthma status within the cohort. The study's name states the disease, but the supplementary file describing recruitment is not cached, so the with/without-asthma design rests on the definition, hence medium.

label: South Asian Birth Cohort
quote: The South Asian Birth Cohort Study (START) will investigate the environmental and genetic basis of adiposity among 750 South Asian offspring recruited from highly divergent environments, namely, rural and urban India and urban Canada.
note: A birth cohort of pregnant South Asian women free of significant chronic disease and their offspring in rural and urban India and Canada, studying determinants of adiposity and related metabolic abnormalities. Adiposity is a trait, and the type 2 diabetes motivation is background rather than the design, so not a disease cohort; the environment studied is rural/urban setting, diet, activity and the intrauterine milieu, not environmental agents, so not an exposure cohort.

label: TRanslational Initiative on Unique and novel strategies for Management of Patients with Heart failure
quote: In the TRIUMPH (Translational Initiative on Unique and Novel Strategies for Management of Patients with Heart Failure) clinical cohort study, 496 acute HF patients were enrolled in 14 hospitals in The Netherlands, between 2009 and 2014.
note: An observational prospective cohort of 496 patients admitted with acute heart failure to 14 Dutch hospitals, with repeated blood sampling over a year to validate prognostic biomarkers. A patient series; no exposure basis.

label: Australian Stroke Genetics Collaborative
quote: ASGC stroke cases comprised stroke patients of European ancestry who were admitted to four clinical centers across Australia (The Neurosciences Department at Gosford Hospital, Gosford; the Neurology Department at John Hunter Hospital, Newcastle; The Queen Elizabeth Hospital, Adelaide; and the Royal Perth Hospital, Perth) between 2003 and 2008.
note: A case-control GWAS sample of 1,162 ischemic stroke patients admitted to four Australian hospitals 2003-2008 and 1,244 population controls from the Hunter Community Study. The cases make it a disease cohort; no exposure basis.

label: Early Growth Genetics Consortium
quote: The Early Growth Genetics (EGG) Consortium exists to facilitate joint analysis of genetic data from multiple studies in order to identify human genomic loci that impact a variety of human traits related to early growth (fetus to young adult).
note: A GWAS meta-analysis consortium of population and birth cohorts on early growth traits: birth weight and length, gestational duration, head circumference, childhood BMI and pubertal growth. Growth traits are not a disease (childhood obesity is one trait among them, not the defining subject) and no exposure is its subject.

label: Oxford Vascular Study
diseases: acute vascular events | transient ischaemic attack | stroke
quote: The Oxford Vascular Study is a prospective incidence study of all vascular events in a population of 92 728 people residing in Oxfordshire, UK.
note: A population-based incidence study in which every patient presenting with an acute vascular event (transient ischaemic attack, stroke, coronary and peripheral events) in a defined Oxfordshire population of 92,728 has been ascertained and followed since 2002. The followed cohort is the patients with vascular disease; no exposure basis. Checked 2026-09-25: A population-based incidence register of everyone in a defined Oxfordshire population presenting with an acute vascular event, the followed patients being those with TIA, stroke and other vascular events; role and diseases stand. The broad disease name was left unmapped although a broad vascular disease term fits the source's level.

label: Prospective Epidemiological Risk Factor Study
quote: PERF is comprised of 5855 post-menopausal Danish women, enrolled at baseline (PERF I) between 1999 and 2001.
note: An observational cohort of 5855 postmenopausal Danish women who had earlier taken part in trials or screenings at the Center for Clinical and Basic Research, followed through the Danish registries to identify risk factors for age-related diseases. Menopause is not a disease and the remit is broad, so no on both counts; no exposure basis.

label: Multiethnic Genome-wide Scan of Prostate Cancer
quote: To better understand the genetic risk for prostate cancer across diverse populations, we performed PrediXcan and GWAS in a case-control study of 4,769 self-identified African American (2,463 cases and 2,306 controls), 2,199 Japanese American (1,106 cases and 1,093 controls), and 2,147 Latin American (1,081 cases and 1,066 controls) individuals from the Multiethnic Genome-wide Scan of Prostate Cancer.
note: A nested case-control GWAS of incident invasive prostate cancer within the Multiethnic Cohort, with participants selected as SEER-identified prostate cancer cases and matched controls, so a disease cohort. The parent MEC is a diet-and-health cohort, but this sub-study's design is genetic case-control and has no exposure purpose of its own.

label: Army Study to Assess Risk and Resilience in Servicemembers
diseases: suicidal thoughts and behaviors | mental disorders
quote: in 2008 the US Army and US National Institute of Mental Health funded the Army Study to Assess Risk and Resilience in Servicemembers (Army STARRS), a multicomponent epidemiological and neurobiological study of risk and resilience factors for suicidal thoughts and behaviors, and their psychopathological correlates among Army personnel.
note: Epidemiological study of US Army soldiers (new recruits, active-duty soldiers and deploying combat teams) set up to find risk and resilience factors for suicidal behaviour and related mental disorders. Military service defines the participants, and the stated purpose is one disease family, so both verdicts are yes.

label: Barbados Asthma Genetics Study
quote: In 1993, the Barbados Asthma Genetics Study (BAGS) was initiated on nuclear and extended asthmatic families who self-reported as African Caribbean, resulting in the first evidence for linkage for asthma and tIgE in an African-ancestry population, and the development of novel family-based methods.
note: Family-based asthma genetics study of paediatric asthmatic probands referred from clinics and their nuclear and extended families in Barbados. House dust endotoxin was measured in one analysis, but the design is a disease family study, not an exposure cohort.

label: CECILE Breast Cancer Study
quote: We conducted a population-based case-control study on breast cancer in Côte d’Or and Ille-et-Vilaine, two administrative areas (départements) located in Eastern and Western part of France, respectively.
note: Population-based case-control study of breast cancer in two French départements: a patient cohort (high confidence). The bundle shows it measures organochlorine pollutants in cases and controls, records lifetime occupational and residential history and is funded by the environmental and occupational health agency, and the definition says it studies occupational and environmental risk factors, but no source in the bundle states that aim, so the exposure verdict rests on indirect evidence.

label: Cardiovascular Health Improvement Project
quote: The primary focus is to recruit patients with aortic disease; governance is provided by three executive committees (Additional file 1, Committees).
note: Longitudinal cardiovascular biobank of patients treated at the Michigan Medicine Frankel Cardiovascular Center, recruiting mainly patients with aortic disease: a patient biobank of one disease family, with no exposure design.

label: GENetic and clinical Predictors Of treatment response in Depression
quote: The GenPod trial is a multi-centre randomised controlled trial. quote: We retrospectively analyzed 3,328 CF patients with pancreatic insufficiency born after 1985 and recruited into the French CF Modifier Gene Study since 2004.

label: Dunedin Multidisciplinary Health and Development Study
quote: Participants were members of the Dunedin Multidisciplinary Health and Development Study, a longitudinal study of 1037 people born in New Zealand in 1972-1973.
note: Complete birth cohort born in Dunedin in 1972-1973, followed from age 3 into midlife on health and behaviour across seven research themes (mental health, cardiovascular, respiratory, oral, sexual health, psychosocial); a general birth cohort with no single disease or exposure purpose.

label: European Community Respiratory Health Survey
quote: The European Community Respiratory Health Survey collected information on prevalent asthma-like symptoms from representative samples of adults aged 20-44 years (29 centres in 13 European countries and Australia) at baseline and 10 and 20 years later (n=7844).
note: Multicentre cohort of adults aged 20-44 selected at random from population registers to compare the prevalence, risk factors and treatment of asthma and allergic disease across countries, followed for asthma, allergy, lung function and COPD: a general-population study set up for one disease family. Second-hand smoke, occupational and other risk factors are measured as risk factors for asthma rather than as the design purpose, so it is not an exposure cohort.

label: EDRN Colorectal and Pancreatic Neoplasm Virtual Biorepository
diseases: colorectal cancer | pancreatic cancer | gastrointestinal malignancies | premalignant conditions | inflammatory bowel disease | pancreatic diseases
quote: The main objective of this initiative was to gather dispersed biospecimens and data pertaining to patients who have been regularly managed and followed-up from 1990 to 2000 either for regular colorectal cancer screening or gastrointestinal malignancies, premalignant conditions, inflammatory bowel disease, pancreatic diseases and pancreatic and colorectal cancers at different centers in the University of Pittsburgh Medical Center (UPMC) hospital networks.
note: NCI Early Detection Research Network biorepository at the University of Pittsburgh of clinically annotated specimens and data from patients managed for colorectal and pancreatic cancers, other GI malignancies, premalignant conditions, IBD and pancreatic disease (plus colorectal cancer screening patients); a patient biorepository, with tumour accessions, and no exposure design.

label: Echinococcus Multilocularis and Internal Diseases in Leutkirch
quote: Participating in the present study were 2,187 adults (1,138 females [52.0%]; 1,049 males [48.0%], age: 18-65 years) taken from a sample of 4,000 persons randomly chosen from an urban population.
note: Population-based random sample of residents of Leutkirch, Germany, examined in 2002 with questionnaire, ultrasound and blood sampling; its original aim of measuring the prevalence of Echinococcus multilocularis infection was widened to internal diseases and public health generally, so it is a general health survey of unselected residents rather than a disease or exposure cohort.

label: Early Pseudomonas Infection Control Observational Study
quote: The Early Pseudomonas Infection Control (EPIC) program consists of two studies, a randomized multicenter trial in CF patients ages 1-12 years at first isolation of Pa from a respiratory culture, and a longitudinal cohort study enrolling Pa-negative patients.
note: Prospective observational cohort of children with cystic fibrosis aged 12 or under who were Pseudomonas aeruginosa-negative at enrolment, followed at 59 US CF centres for risk factors and consequences of early Pa acquisition; a patient cohort. Environmental risk factors (cigarette smoke, hot tubs, daycare) are among the risk factors evaluated, not a defining exposure or the design purpose. Checked 2026-09-25: EPIC Obs enrolled young CF patients who were Pseudomonas aeruginosa-negative in order to describe risk factors for and outcomes of early Pa acquisition, so the infection the cohort is named for and designed around is a missing disease; the CF patient role and quote stand.

label: Environmental Risk Longitudinal Twin Study
quote: The Environmental Risk Longitudinal Twin Study (E-Risk) comprised 2163 twin children from England and Wales (49.1% male) identified at birth in 1994 and 1995 and included administration of the Test of Word Reading Efficiency at age 7 years and the Wechsler Preschool and Primary Scale of Intelligence-Revised as a test of IQ at age 5 years.
note: Nationally representative twin birth cohort (England and Wales, 1994-95) studying how environmental and genetic factors contribute to behaviour, health and mental health problems from childhood to adulthood; a twin registry-type birth cohort with a broad purpose. The 'environmental risk' in its name is psychosocial (family, social, digital environments), not an environmental agent in scope here.

label: Gabapentin for chronic pelvic pain in women
quote: We aimed to measure the efficacy and safety of gabapentin in women with chronic pelvic pain and no obvious pelvic pathology.
note: Participants of a UK multicentre placebo-controlled trial of gabapentin in women aged 18-50 with chronic pelvic pain of at least three months and no obvious pelvic pathology; a patient (trial) cohort whose only 'exposure' is the trial drug. Checked 2026-09-25: GaPP2 is a trial in women with chronic pelvic pain and no obvious pelvic pathology, so the classification and quote stand; but the mapped HP Pelvic pain term is broader than the chronic pelvic pain the source names.

label: Interdisciplinary Group for Advanced Research on BirtH outcomes - DBT India Initiative
quote: A cohort study of pregnant women was initiated in May 2015 at the civil hospital in Gurugram, Haryana, India.
note: Single-centre prospective pregnancy cohort in Haryana, India, enrolling women before 20 weeks' gestation and following them to delivery to find correlates and risk-prediction tools for preterm birth. Participants are unselected pregnant women and the outcome studied, preterm birth, is a pregnancy outcome rather than a disease, so it is not classed as a disease cohort; no environmental exposure is its purpose.

label: Global Biobank Meta-analysis Initiative
quote: We introduce the Global Biobank Meta-analysis Initiative (GBMI)-a collaborative network of 23 biobanks from 4 continents representing more than 2.2 million consented individuals with genetic data linked to electronic health records.
note: Consortium of population biobanks with genotypes linked to health records that meta-analyses GWAS across many diseases and endpoints; a collection of general biobanks, not defined by any disease or exposure.

label: Treatment program of DLBCL patients from the Groupe d'Etude des Lymphomes de l'Adulte
quote: In stage 2, we included data from two unpublished and previously genotyped GWAS (GELA/EPIC and Mayo) plus one published GWAS (UCSF7), totaling 1,196 DLCBL cases and 1,445 controls (Online Methods; Supplementary Tables 1, 3).
note: Patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma enrolled in the GELA LNH03 treatment trials whose germline DNA formed the case series of the GELA DLBCL GWAS (controls drawn from EPIC France); a patient series treated with chemotherapy regimens, with no exposure design.

label: Genetic and Environmental Risk Factors for Alzheimer's Disease Among African Americans Study
quote: Cases met NINCDS-ADRDA criteria for possible or probable AD, determined in a consensus conference which included a behavioral neurologist, psychiatrist, neuropsychologist, and a behavioral neurology nurse practitioner.
note: Case-control study of Alzheimer's disease in African Americans aged 65 or over identified through Henry Ford Health System claims data, with AD cases and cognitively normal controls; the cases of a case-control study. 'Environmental risk factors' in the name is generic and no environmental agent defines the sample or its design as documented.

label: Gene Environment Interaction and Breast Cancer in Germany
quote: The GENICA study involved interviews to assess shift work information in 857 breast cancer cases and 892 controls.
note: Population-based case-control study of breast cancer in the Greater Bonn region, built (with the Institute for Prevention and Occupational Medicine) to study how genes and environmental exposures interact in breast cancer, with detailed interviews on night and shift work; the cases make it a disease cohort and its gene-environment design centres on exposures, though the specific agents documented here are occupational (night work) rather than physical or chemical.

label: Genizon GWAS
quote: Currently published GWASs include eight Europe-originated psoriasis-associated GWAS cohorts, including CASP [7], Kiel [8], Genizon [8], PsA GWAS [9], WTCCC2 [10], Exomechip [11], PAGE [12], and GAPC [12], two South Asia-originated psoriasis-associated GWAS cohort including three batches [13], and one East Asia-originated psoriasis-associated GWAS cohort [14].
note: Case-control GWAS sample of psoriasis patients and controls from the Quebec founder population assembled by Genizon BioSciences; the cases of a case-control study, no exposure design.

label: GEnetic analysis of NUclear Families with Atopic Dermatitis
quote: The GENUFAD study (Genetic Analysis of Nuclear Families with Atopic Dermatitis) recruited complete nuclear families with at least two children affected with early-onset (<2 years of age) and moderate to severe AD as previously described [20].
note: Family-based genetic study recruiting nuclear families through at least two children with early-onset moderate to severe atopic dermatitis, plus unrelated affected children in its extended phase; a patient (affected family) cohort with no exposure design.

label: German Myocardial Infarction Family Study
quote: The 875 case subjects in the German MI Family Study were persons who had myocardial infarction before the age of 60 years and at least one first-degree relative with premature coronary artery disease.
note: Series of German case collections (GerMIFS I-VII) of people with early myocardial infarction or coronary artery disease, including familial cases and patients referred for angiography, compared with population controls; an aggregation of patient case series for one disease family, no exposure design.

label: Gene-Lifestyle Interactions and Complex Traits Involved in Elevated Disease Risk Study
quote: Sixteen fasting glucose-raising loci were genotyped in middle-aged adults from the Gene x Lifestyle interactions And Complex traits Involved in Elevated disease Risk (GLACIER) Study, a population-based prospective cohort study from northern Sweden.
note: Population-based prospective cohort nested in the Northern Sweden Health and Disease Study, established specifically for gene-lifestyle interaction studies of cardiometabolic traits, with diet (FFQ), physical activity, smoking and alcohol data from the Vasterbotten Intervention Programme; lifestyle exposures are its stated main subject, hence an exposure cohort, but its participants are unselected adults and its disease scope (cardiometabolic traits, type 2 diabetes, obesity, CAD) is broad, so not a disease cohort.

label: German Multicenter Allergy Study
diseases: allergic diseases | asthma | allergic rhinitis | eczema
quote: The MAS (Multicenter Allergy Study) is a previously described population-based birth cohort in which 1314 German infants were followed since 1990 to investigate the epidemiology of allergic diseases [44].
note: German birth cohort of 1314 newborns recruited in 1990 in five cities, deliberately enriched for newborns at high allergy risk (two allergic family members or raised cord-blood IgE) and followed into adulthood to study asthma, allergic rhinitis, eczema and sensitisation; a birth cohort set up for one disease family (part of the sample also 'at risk'), with no environmental exposure as its purpose.

label: Genetic Modifier Study
quote: The Genetic Modifier Study (GMS) consists of unrelated patients homozygous for the common CF allele F508del (HGVS nomenclature: p.Phe508del), recruited from extremes of lung function9.
note: Case-control study of genetic modifiers of cystic fibrosis lung disease enrolling F508del-homozygous CF patients at the extremes of lung function from US CF centres; a patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: Genetic Modifier Study of Severe CF Liver Disease
diseases: cystic fibrosis | cystic fibrosis liver disease
quote: Two-stage case-control study enrolling patients with CF and severe liver disease with portal hypertension (CFLD) from 63 CF centers in the United States as well as 32 in Canada and 18 outside of North America, with the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill as the coordinating site.
note: International case-control study of genetic modifiers of severe liver disease in cystic fibrosis, enrolling CF patients with cirrhosis and portal hypertension and CF controls without liver disease; a patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: GSK
quote: The samples from GSK derived from two randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled comparisons of the antidepressant efficacy and the effects on sexual functioning of Bupropion XL and escitalopram in outpatients with moderate to severe depression (22).
note: Pharmacogenetic sample of outpatients with moderate to severe major depressive disorder from two GlaxoSmithKline escitalopram trials, contributed to NEWMEDS for antidepressant-response genetics; a patient (trial) cohort whose only 'exposure' is a medication.

label: GSK Munich recurrent major depression case-control study
quote: The first GWAS was performed on 1022 recurrent MDD patients and 1000 controls genotyped on the Illumina 550 platform.
note: GlaxoSmithKline case-control sample of German patients with recurrent major depression recruited at the Max Planck Institute of Psychiatry in Munich and two satellite hospitals, with screened community controls, used as the first case-control cohort of the recurrent MDD GWAS; the cases of a case-control study, no exposure design. Checked 2026-09-25: Cases of a case-control study of recurrent MDD, so patients is right and the quote is verbatim; but the cases were required to have recurrent MDD, and the mapped term is the broader major depressive disorder.

label: Great Smoky Mountains Study
quote: The Great Smoky Mountains Study (GSMS) was originally designed to examine the prevalence of common childhood psychiatric disorders, their development over time and use of mental health services in a predominantly rural area of the southeastern United States.
note: A population-based longitudinal study of rural North Carolina children, sampled at random with oversampling of high scorers on a psychiatric screen, designed to study childhood psychiatric disorders and service use; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Hasselt Appendicitis Immunology and Environmental Study
quote: This study aimed at characterizing immune responses towards a large variety of gut commensals and pathogens, and pattern recognition receptor (PRR) ligands, and investigating the course of systemic inflammation in a prospective cohort of acute appendicitis patients.
note: A prospective cohort of acute appendicitis patients at Jessa Hospital, Hasselt; its registered aim includes analysing environmental factors (diet, lifestyle, early-life environment by questionnaire) in the pathology of appendicitis, so it counts as designed to study exposures, though the exposures are broad. Checked 2026-09-25: HAPPIEST is a prospective cohort of acute appendicitis patients, so patients and the disease stand; the old quote (325 patients recruited at Jessa Hospital) did not say what the patients had, so it is replaced with a verbatim abstract sentence that does.

label: Hwasun Cancer Epidemiology Study-Breast
quote: Included in this project were 3,387 female breast 94 cancer cases, who were newly diagnosed between April 2004 and February 2013 at 95 Chonnam National University Hwasun Hospital, a cancer specified hospital in 96 Jeollanam-do province, South Korea.
note: The breast cancer arm of a hospital-based case-control study at Chonnam National University Hwasun Hospital; its cases are newly diagnosed breast cancer patients, and no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Health2008 Study
quote: In the population-based Health2008 study, 2218 men and women aged 30-60 years were invited.
note: A cross-sectional population-based study of a random sample of adults aged 30-60 in the Copenhagen area; neither an exposure nor a single disease defines it.

label: Health2010 Study
quote: Health2010 study was conducted between 2010-2011 and included a random sample aged 18-69 years and living in the western part of the capital region of Denmark.
note: A population-based study of a random sample of Danish adults aged 18-69 with a broad focus (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, asthma and allergy), so not a single-disease cohort, and no exposure defines it.

label: Hong Kong Diabetes Register
quote: We investigated glycemic progression among 7,091 Chinese patients with T2D from the Hong Kong Diabetes Register enrolled between 1995 and 2007.
note: A prospective register of diabetes patients at the Prince of Wales Hospital, Hong Kong, followed for complications and outcomes; a patient cohort with no defining environmental exposure.

label: HostSeq initiative
quote: The HostSeq initiative recruited 10,059 Canadians infected with SARS-CoV-2 between March 2020 and March 2023, obtained clinical information on their disease experience and whole genome sequenced (WGS) their DNA.
note: A Canadian databank aggregating 13 studies of people infected with SARS-CoV-2, for host-genetic research on COVID-19 outcomes; the participants have the infection, so it is a disease (patients) aggregation rather than an exposed-uninfected cohort.

label: Hvidoere Remission Phase Study
quote: A total of 275 patients aged <16 years were followed from onset of type 1 diabetes.
note: A multinational cohort of children with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes followed for 12 months to study residual beta-cell function; a patient cohort with no defining exposure.

label: Nord-Trøndelag Health Study 1995–97
quote: All current residents ≥20 years of age in Nord-Trøndelag have been invited to each survey wave: the HUNT1 (1984–86, 77 202 participants, 89.4% of invitees participated),1 HUNT2 (1995-97, 65 228 participants, 69.5%)2 and HUNT3 (2006-08, 50 800 participants, 54.1%)3 surveys (Figure 1).
note: The second HUNT survey, to which all adult residents of Nord-Trøndelag were invited; a general population health survey defined neither by an exposure nor by a disease.

label: HypnoLaus Sleep Cohort Study
quote: Taking into account improvements in recording techniques and new criteria used to define respiratory events, we aimed to assess the prevalence of sleep-disordered breathing and associated clinical features in a large population-based sample.
note: A population-based sleep cohort of consecutive CoLaus/PsyCoLaus participants given home polysomnography; its stated aim is the prevalence of sleep-disordered breathing, one disease family, so a population study of disease; no exposure defines it.

label: Interaction of Gene and Environment of Depression during PostPartum
quote: IGEDEPP (Interaction of Gene and Environment of Depression during PostPartum) is a prospective multicenter cohort study of 3310 Caucasian women who gave birth between 2011 and 2016, with follow-up until one year postpartum.
note: A prospective cohort of women recruited after delivery in Paris maternity units and followed for a year to study postpartum depression; the 'environment' it studies is stressful life events and childhood trauma, which are psychosocial and outside the exposure scope.

label: Impact of Neurodevelopmental disorders and School performance: genes and environment
quote: Children who screened positive were interviewed for diagnostic confirmation according to the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, while students who screened negative served as controls.
note: A school-based cohort in Catalonia screening children for mental health problems and learning difficulties with diagnostic confirmation, set up to study neurodevelopmental disorders and school performance; 'environment' in the name is not a specific environmental exposure.

label: Japanese Consortium for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis research
quote: The JaCALS registry is a multicenter patient registry for ALS involving 42 institutions across Japan.
note: A Japanese multicentre registry of ALS patients with DNA and clinical follow-up; a patient cohort with no defining exposure.

label: JAPC GWAS
quote: Briefly, incident prostate cancer cases were identified by cohort linkage to Surveillance, Epidemiology and End Results cancer registries covering Hawaii and California.
note: A nested case-control GWAS of prostate cancer in Japanese American men of the Multiethnic Cohort; the cases have the disease, and the GWAS itself is not designed around an environmental exposure.

label: Japan Prospective Studies Collaboration for Aging and Dementia
quote: The Japan Prospective Studies Collaboration for Aging and Dementia (JPSC-AD) is a multisite, population-based prospective cohort study of dementia, which was designed to enroll approximately 10,000 community-dwelling residents aged 65 years or older from 8 sites in Japan and to follow them up prospectively for at least 5 years.
note: A population-based cohort of community-dwelling older Japanese followed for incident dementia; its 'environmental risk factors' are general lifestyle and medical variables (diabetes, obesity, smoking, inactivity), not a defining environmental exposure.

label: Korean Research Project on the Integrated Exposure Assessment of Hazardous Substances for Food Safety
quote: We selected 4867 subjects of all ages throughout Korea.
note: A nationwide Korean survey population sampled across all ages and built to assess dietary exposure to hazardous substances (heavy metals and others) with biomonitoring; an exposure study of the general population, not a disease cohort.

label: LAPC GWAS
quote: Incident Latino PrCa cases were identified by linking with the cancer registries in Hawaii and California.
note: A nested case-control GWAS of prostate cancer in Latino men of the Multiethnic Cohort; the cases have the disease, and the GWAS is not designed around an environmental exposure.

label: Levodopa in Early Parkinson's Disease
quote: Patients with early stage PD whose functional health does not yet necessitate initiation of PD-medication will be randomised to either 40 weeks of treatment with levodopa/carbidopa 100/25 mg TID including 2 weeks of dose escalation or to 40 weeks placebo TID.
note: A Dutch randomised delayed-start trial of levodopa in patients with early Parkinson's disease; a patient trial cohort whose only 'exposure' is a medication, which is out of scope.

label: Luxembourg Parkinson's Study
quote: Since 2015, over 800 individuals with PD and atypical parkinsonism along with more than 800 control subjects have been recruited in the frame of the observational, monocentric, nation-wide, longitudinal-prospective Luxembourg Parkinson's study.
note: A Luxembourg observational cohort of patients with Parkinson's disease and atypical parkinsonism plus controls, deeply phenotyped for diagnosis and progression markers; no environmental exposure defines it. Checked 2026-09-25: Patients with PD and atypical parkinsonism plus controls, recruited for deep phenotyping; verdict, role and quote stand. 'Parkinsonian disorder' is broader than atypical parkinsonism.

label: Lung Tissue Research Consortium
diseases: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease | idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis | interstitial lung disease
quote: The LTRC was a biobank resource established by the NHLBI to collect and distribute lung tissue, blood samples, clinical data, and radiographic studies from participants with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), other related idiopathic interstitial pneumonias (IIP) and interstitial pneumonias associated with connective tissue diseases who undergo medically-indicated lung resection.
note: An NHLBI biobank of lung tissue and blood from adults undergoing thoracic surgery, formed to collect material from patients with COPD and interstitial lung diseases (some participants turned out not to have them); no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Mammary Carcinoma Risk Factor Investigation
quote: In a large population-based case-control study in Germany, including 3,464 breast cancer cases aged 50-74 at diagnosis and 6,657 population based and frequency matched controls
note: A German population-based case-control study of postmenopausal breast cancer whose cases were followed as a patient cohort; its main risk factor of interest, menopausal hormone therapy, is a medication and out of the exposure scope.

label: Mayo Clinic Study of Aging
quote: The objective of this study was to establish a prospective population-based cohort to investigate the prevalence, incidence and risk factors for mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and dementia.
note: A random population sample of Olmsted County residents established to study the prevalence, incidence and risk factors of MCI and dementia; a population study of one disease family, not defined by any exposure. Checked 2026-09-25: A random population sample set up to study MCI and dementia, so population study of disease stands with a verbatim quote; the MCI mapping is too broad.

label: MedStar
quote: Discovery studies were PennCath and MedStar (webappendix p 2), which recruited patients before coronary angiography at the University of Pennsylvania Medical Center (Penn) and Washington Hospital Center (WHC), respectively.
note: A hospital-based case-control study of angiographic coronary artery disease among patients undergoing cardiac catheterisation at Washington Hospital Center; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Melanoma in Southern Sweden
quote: The Melanoma Inquiry in Southern Sweden (MISS) was a prospective cohort study looking at risk factors for melanoma [27].
note: A random population sample of southern Swedish women set up to study melanoma risk factors, centred on UV exposure, sunbed use and sun-exposure habits by questionnaire; so both a population study of melanoma and a cohort designed to study UV exposure (quote is the title of the cohort's design paper, printed by cached.py).

label: Michigan State University Twin Registry
quote: The MSUTR has two broad components: a large-scale, population-based registry of child, adolescent, and adult twins and their families (current N~30,000) and a series of more focused and in-depth studies drawn from the registry (projected N~7,200).
note: A population-based twin registry from Michigan birth records; although its research focus is psychopathology, twin registries are out of scope as disease cohorts, and no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Mater-University of Queensland Study of Pregnancy
quote: MUSP was originally developed as a birth cohort study. It has become a longitudinal study of growth, development and ageing with an emphasis on the generational transmission of a wide range of factors impacting on adult health outcomes.
note: A Brisbane pregnancy birth cohort of mother-child pairs that became a general longitudinal study of growth, development and ageing; neither exposure nor one disease is its design basis.

label: Myositis Genetics Consortium
quote: We analyzed 2,565 Caucasian IIM patient samples collected through the Myositis Genetics Consortium (MYOGEN) and 10,260 ethnically matched control samples.
note: An international consortium collecting DNA from patients with idiopathic inflammatory myopathies; its members are patients, so disease: patients; no exposure basis.

label: Carolina Breast Cancer Study
quote: The present study was conducted within the Carolina Breast Cancer Study (CBCS), a large, population-based case-control study of breast cancer biology and epidemiology enriched for breast cancers occurring among young women.
note: A population-based case-control and case cohort study of breast cancer in North Carolina; cases have the disease. Risk factors are studied among many, not as an exposure design.

label: North Carolina Bladder Cancer Study
quote: Using a polymerase chain reaction (PCR)-based method, we examined the frequency of the homozygous deleted genotype (GSTM1 0/0) in 229 patients with transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder and 211 control subjects who were enrolled from the Urology Clinics at Duke University Medical Center and the University of North Carolina Hospitals.
note: A hospital-based bladder cancer case-control study; cases are patients. Smoking is analysed as a modifier of genetic susceptibility, but participants were not selected for exposure and the main subject is carcinogen-metabolism and DNA-repair genotype, so exposure is no.

label: NCI-Maryland Prostate Cancer Case-Control Study
quote: the NCI-Maryland Prostate Cancer Case-Control Study consisting of 798 men with incident prostate cancer (402 AA and 496 EA) and 1,008 population-based controls (474 AA and 534 EA).
note: A prostate cancer case-control study in Baltimore; cases are patients. No exposure defines the cohort.

label: Northern Finland Birth Cohort 1966
quote: At baseline, all mothers with expected dates of delivery between 1 January and 31 December 1966 were recruited from the two northernmost provinces in Finland.
note: A whole-population birth cohort of northern Finland set up to study risk factors and consequences of preterm birth and intrauterine growth retardation (pregnancy outcomes, not a disease in scope), later a general life-course cohort.

label: Linxian General Population Nutrition Intervention Trial
quote: Rates of oesophageal/gastric cardia cancer in Linxian, a rural county in north central China, are among the world's highest, but the risk factors are not well understood.
note: A randomized vitamin/mineral supplementation trial of healthy adults in Linxian, a county with some of the world's highest oesophageal/gastric cardia cancer rates, followed as a cohort; nutritional exposure is its main subject (borderline, as the exposure is a supplement intervention) and its purpose is prevention of these cancers.

label: Neuro-Ophthalmology Research at Fundació ACE
diseases: dementia | mild cognitive impairment | Alzheimer's disease
quote: The study population included 1847 dementia patients, 764 MCI patients, and 559 CH individuals from the NORFACE cohort (Table 1).
note: Memory-clinic cohort of people evaluated for cognitive decline at Ace Alzheimer Center Barcelona, mostly dementia and MCI patients with some cognitively healthy participants; no exposure basis. Checked 2026-09-25: A memory-clinic cohort of people evaluated for cognitive decline, mostly dementia (84% AD) and MCI patients, founded to search for retinal biomarkers of AD; verdict and quote stand, but the MCI mapping is too broad.

label: New York Cancer Project
quote: A new cohort study was undertaken with several aims: (1) to provide a database and biorepository for studies of cancer etiology and pathogenesis, including host genetics;
note: A venue-sampled cohort and biorepository of New York adults whose stated aims centre on cancer aetiology and racial/ethnic disparities in cancer; no exposure defines it.

label: Okinawa Bioinformation Bank
quote: BBJ is a hospital-based disease cohort, whereas OBi is a population-based study, and the mean age of BBJ participants is higher than that of OBi participants.
note: A population-based biobank of Okinawa residents for population history and genetics of common and rare diseases; neither exposure nor a single disease defines it.

label: Pancreatic Cancer Cohort Consortium
quote: We performed a multistage genome-wide association study including 7,683 individuals with pancreatic cancer and 14,397 controls of European descent.
note: An NCI consortium collecting pancreatic cancer cases and controls from cohorts and case-control studies for GWAS; classified by its cases as a pancreatic cancer patient aggregation; no exposure basis.

label: Prostate Cancer Genome-wide Association Study of Uncommon Susceptibility Loci
quote: A new genome-wide association study was conducted in prostate cancer cases and controls of European ancestry from the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal, and Ovarian (PLCO) Cancer Screening Trial.
note: A nested prostate cancer case-control GWAS within the PLCO screening trial; cases are prostate cancer patients; no exposure basis.

label: University of Pennsylvania Catheterization Study
quote: Discovery studies were PennCath and MedStar (webappendix p 2), which recruited patients before coronary angiography at the University of Pennsylvania Medical Center (Penn) and Washington Hospital Center (WHC), respectively.
note: Consecutive patients undergoing cardiac catheterisation and coronary angiography, studied for coronary artery disease; no exposure basis.

label: Pediatric Imaging, Neurocognition, and Genetics
quote: The main objective of the multi-site Pediatric Imaging, Neurocognition, and Genetics (PING) study was to create a large repository of standardized measurements of behavioral and imaging phenotypes accompanied by whole genome genotyping acquired from typically-developing children varying widely in age (3 to 20 years).
note: A cross-sectional imaging-genetics repository of typically developing children and young adults about brain and cognitive development; neither exposure nor disease defines it.

label: Karolinska Mammography Project for Risk Prediction of Breast Cancer - Case-Control Study
quote: pKARMA is a cohort of 5002 invasive breast cancer patients diagnosed between 2001 and 2008 in Stockholm and 5433 breast cancer-free women from KARMA (26).
note: A Swedish breast cancer case-control study of Stockholm breast cancer patients with KARMA controls; no exposure basis.

label: Parkinson Research Examination of CEP-1347 Trial
quote: Consenting PD patients not yet requiring dopaminergic therapy (n = 806) were randomized equally to CEP-1347 in dosages of 10 mg BID, 25 mg BID, or 50 mg BID, or matching placebo, and were evaluated blindly and prospectively.
note: A randomized drug trial in early Parkinson's disease patients, followed observationally afterwards; the only exposure is a drug, so exposure is no.

label: Predictors For ECT
diseases: major depressive episode | major depressive disorder
quote: Here, we test the utility of targeting the severe end of the MDD spectrum through genome-wide SNP genotyping of 2725 cases who received electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) for a major depressive episode (MDE) and 4035 controls.
note: Swedish patients treated with ECT for severe major depressive episodes; ECT is a treatment, not an environmental exposure. Checked 2026-09-25: Patients who received ECT for a major depressive episode (77% unipolar); verdict and quote stand, but mapping the episode to MDD conflates it with the narrower MDD subset the source distinguishes.

label: Performance of Rotavirus and Oral Polio Vaccines in Developing Countries
quote: A birth cohort of 700 infants from the Mirpur area of Dhaka, Bangladesh was established, following infants for the first 2 years of life.
note: A vaccine-trial birth cohort of newborns in low-income Dhaka studying oral vaccine underperformance; the defining exposure is vaccination (a medical intervention), and enteric infections are outcomes studied, not a recruitment basis or a single-disease purpose.

label: Queensland Twin Registry
quote: Queensland Twin Registry (QTwin) Study is a population-based registry of identical and non-identical twins and triplets of all ages, living in Australia.
note: A population-based twin registry; twin registries are no on both counts.

label: Research in African American Alzheimer Disease Initiative
quote: We performed whole-genome sequencing (WGS) and multipoint linkage analyses in 51 multi-generational AA AD families ascertained through the Research in African American Alzheimer Disease Initiative (REAAADI) and the National Institute on Aging Late Onset Alzheimer's disease (NIA-LOAD) Family Based Study.
note: A family-based study of African American families affected by Alzheimer's disease (patients with their relatives) to find AD genes; no exposure basis.

label: The Roskilde cohort of pregnant women
quote: To test if serum YKL-40 is increased in women developing preeclampsia or small-for-gestational age fetuses.
note: A cohort of unselected pregnant women set up to test a biomarker for preeclampsia and fetal growth restriction; pregnancy itself does not count, but its stated purpose is these pregnancy disorders, so population study of disease (borderline). Checked 2026-09-25: Unselected pregnant women enrolled to test whether serum YKL-40 predicts preeclampsia and small-for-gestational-age, so population study of disease stands (borderline); the source says small-for-gestational-age, a size classification broader than fetal growth restriction.

label: Shanghai Breast Cancer Genetics Study
quote: The SBCGS was conducted in 5152 participants (2867 case participants and 2285 control participants) from the following four population-based studies conducted among Chinese women in urban Shanghai between 1996 and 2005: the Shanghai Breast Cancer Study [25], the Shanghai Breast Cancer Survival Study [26], the Shanghai Endometrial Cancer Study (contributing controls only) [27] and the Shanghai Women’s Health Study [28].
note: A breast cancer case-control genetics study pooling cases and controls from four Shanghai studies; classified by its cases as breast cancer patients; no exposure basis.
