quote: Shanghai Jiao Tong University Diabetes Study (SJTUDS) The cases (n = 190) were probands of type 2 diabetic pedigrees with fasting plasma glucose ≥ 7.0 mmol/L and/or 2-h post plasma glucose ≥ 11.1 mmol/L and diagnosed before 40 years old.
note: Type 2 diabetes case-control study at the Shanghai Diabetes Institute with early-onset familial cases and normoglycaemic controls.

label: Städtisches Klinikum Karlsruhe Deutsches Krebsforschungszentrum Study
quote: Germany Women diagnosed with primary in situ or invasive breast cancer at the Städtisches Klinikum Karlsruhe from March 1993 to July 2005.
note: Hospital-based breast cancer case series at Karlsruhe with GC-HBOC controls, a BCAC member study.

label: Singapore Translational and Clinical Research in Psychosis
quote: The second is a prospective study of a large group of individuals who are assessed to be at ultra-high risk of psychosis, and the third is a randomized controlled trial to improve neurocognition in patients with schizophrenia.
note: National psychosis research programme in Singapore: schizophrenia patients for GWAS and a trial, plus an ultra-high-risk psychosis cohort; primarily patients.

label: Finnish Genetic Predisposition to Prostate Cancer Study
quote: TAMPERE Finnish Genetic Predisposition to Prostate Cancer Study Tampere Finland Case-control - Finland, Retrospective, Observational, Population-based Johanna Schleutker European 2544 1226 2409 1179 Identified through linkage to the Finnish Cancer Registry and patient records; and the Finnish arm of the ERSPC study Cohort participants without a diagnosis of cancer
note: Population-based prostate cancer case-control study in Finland with registry-identified cases, a PRACTICAL member.

label: TASPRAC Study
quote: TASPRAC The Tasmanian Familial Prostate Cancer Study and the Tasmanian Prostate Cancer Case Control study were funded by Cancer Australia, Cancer Council Tasmania, the Royal Hobart Hospital Research Foundation, Perpetual Trustees, the Mazda Foundation and the Max Bruce Trust.
note: Tasmanian prostate cancer resource combining a familial prostate cancer study and a population-based case-control study (PRACTICAL member); the quote names both components.

label: University of California San Francisco Atrial Fibrillation Study
quote: A subset of 113 participants with early-onset atrial fibrillation underwent WGS as a part of the TOPMed Program.
note: Case set of atrial fibrillation patients from the UCSF electrophysiology laboratory, with early-onset cases sequenced in TOPMed.

label: University of Florida Diabetes Institute Study Bank
quote: We determined the capacity for a combined genetic risk score (GRS) to discriminate disease-risk subgroups in a racially and ethnically diverse cohort from the southeastern U.S. including 637 T1D patients, 46 at-risk relatives having two or more T1D-related autoantibodies (≥2AAb+), 790 first-degree relatives (≤1AAb+), 68 second-degree relatives (≤1 AAb+), and 405 controls.
note: A type 1 diabetes study bank of patients, autoantibody-positive and other relatives, and controls; disease cohort (patients, with at-risk relatives), no environmental exposure focus.

label: Familial Prostate Cancer Study Ulm
quote: familial cases (n=162): identified through questionnaires for family history by collaborating urologists all over Germany
note: A familial and sporadic prostate cancer case-control study in Ulm; cases are prostate cancer patients, no exposure focus.

label: University of North Carolina CanCORS study
quote: UNC_CanCORS assembled a prospective population-based cohort of colorectal cancer patients from a 33-county area in North Carolina diagnosed between April 2003 and January 2005.
note: The North Carolina CanCORS site: a population-based cohort of colorectal cancer patients; disease cohort, no exposure focus.

label: Utah Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia Study
quote: Utah Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia Study UTAH 355 420 Mixed: clinic- and population- based cases and controls, USA Prevalent cases from Huntsman Cancer Hospital's Hematology Clinics
note: A CLL case-control GWAS in Utah with clinic and registry cases; disease cohort (patients), no exposure focus.

label: University of Wisconsin Transdisciplinary Tobacco Use Research Center Trial
quote: UW-TTURC participants were recruited for nicotine dependence and smoking cessation treatment clinical trials in Madison and Milwaukee, Wisconsin beginning in 2001
note: A smoking cessation trial of adults smoking 10 or more cigarettes a day: participants were recruited as smokers (tobacco exposure) and treated for nicotine dependence, an addiction counted as a disease.

label: Västerbotten Intervention Project
quote: The programme was initiated in parts of the county in 1985 as a community-level and individual-level programme to reduce the morbidity and mortality from CVD in Northern Sweden.
note: A population-based health-examination cohort of all Västerbotten residents at ages 40, 50 and 60; not selected for exposure, but set up as a programme against cardiovascular disease, so a population study of that disease family.

label: Wake Forest University Breast Cancer Study
quote: African-American breast cancer cases and controls in WFBC were recruited at Wake Forest University Health Sciences from November 1998 through December 2008 (51).
note: A hospital-based breast cancer case-control study; disease cohort (patients), no exposure focus.

label: Women's Health Initiative Clinical Trial
quote: Postmenopausal women ranging in age from 50 to 79 are enrolled at one of 40 WHI clinical centers nationwide into either a clinical trial (CT) that will include about 64,500 women or an observational study (OS) that will include about 100,000 women.
note: The WHI randomised trials in unselected postmenopausal women; the dietary modification (low-fat diet) arm makes diet a design exposure, while the hormone and calcium/vitamin D arms are treatments; aimed at several diseases (CHD, breast and colorectal cancer, fractures), so not a single-disease cohort.

label: Weiss Laboratory Autism Collection
quote: The Weiss Laboratory Autism Collections are a combination of Californian cohorts including the UCSF/Weiss (42 trios, 13 cases), UCSF/Hendren
note: An aggregation of Californian autism case, trio and control collections genotyped for the PGC autism GWAS; disease (patients), no exposure focus.

label: Wenzhou Medical University Biobank - Tibetans
note: Tibetans recruited on the Tibetan Plateau for a study of genetic adaptation to high altitude; selection is by ancestry and residence for a genetic question, not an environmental hazard exposure, and no disease is targeted.

label: Washington University Genetics Study
quote: WUGS (n=898) Washington University Genetics Study St. Louis, USA Case series, hospital-based
note: A hospital-based case series of prostate cancer patients contributing to PRACTICAL; disease cohort, no exposure focus.

label: Nurses' Health Studies
quote: The NHS I began in 1976 when 121,700 female registered nurses, aged 30–55 years, were enrolled by completing a baseline questionnaire about their health and lifestyle [20].
note: An umbrella of the Nurses' Health Study cohorts: nurses enrolled as a general sample for risk factors of major chronic diseases, not selected for an occupational hazard and not about one disease.

label: International Consortium on the Genetics of Heroin Dependence
quote: The project uses a case-control design in which cases met lifetime DSM-IV criteria for heroin dependence.
note: A heroin dependence case-control genetics consortium; cases have the addiction (a disease); illicit drug use is not among the exposure categories here, so exposure is no.

label: Cardiovascular Effects of Air Pollution and Noise in Stockholm
quote: Recruiting individuals from Stockholm County the Cardiovascular Effects of Air pollution and Noise Study (CEANS) cohort was included.
note: Four Stockholm population cohorts pooled to study air pollution and noise as risk factors for cardiovascular disease; the study name itself states both the exposures and the disease.

label: My Purchases cohort
quote: All Danish residents 18 years and older with a valid digital signature (MitID) and an account with the digital receipt solution can donate information about their purchases for research purposes.
note: A Danish cohort donating digital purchase receipts to study how diet and household lifestyle exposures affect health; open to all adult residents, not about one disease.

label: Study on Transitions in Employment, Ability and Motivation
quote: STREAM is an ongoing prospective cohort among persons aged 45 to 64 years in the Netherlands stratified by age and employment status.
note: A Dutch occupational-health cohort of people aged 45-64 on work characteristics, health and work participation, part of the OMega-X occupational exposome consortium; counted as designed around occupational exposures, though its main outcome is work participation rather than exposure effects, so the exposure verdict is borderline.

label: Swedish Cervical Screening Cohort
quote: The Cervical Screening Cohort enrols women screened for human papillomavirus (HPV) and cervical abnormalities within the capital region of Sweden from the organised screening program and the non-organised testing of cervical samples.
note: The Stockholm cervical screening population with biobanked cervical samples, run by a cervical cancer elimination centre; a population study of cervical cancer. HPV is screened for as the disease cause, not as a defining exposure; the cohort is also used by the HEAP exposome project, but exposure is not its design basis.

label: Dutch Famine Birth Cohort
quote: The main outcomes of interest of the DFBC are chronic cardiovascular and metabolic diseases, ageing and mental health.
note: A famine-exposed birth cohort born around the Dutch Hunger Winter, set up to study prenatal undernutrition; outcomes span cardiovascular, metabolic, ageing and mental health, so not a single-disease cohort.

label: Diabetes Prediction in Skåne
quote: The Diabetes Prediction in Skåne (DiPiS) study is a prospective follow-up of children at risk of T1D in southern Sweden.
note: Newborns in Skåne screened for type 1 diabetes risk, with at-risk children followed for islet autoantibodies; at-risk disease cohort. Environmental triggers are mentioned only in the definition, not as a stated design centre in the sources read.

label: Étude Longitudinale Française depuis l'Enfance
quote: A total of 349 maternity units were randomly selected in metropolitan France and the children were recruited at birth from the 320 maternity units that agreed to participate.
note: The French national birth cohort, formed by merging a social-science project with an environmental-health project on pollutant exposure of pregnant women and children; exposure to emerging pollutants is a priority theme, though the cohort's objective is broad; not a disease cohort.

label: ENVIRonmental influence ON early AGEing
quote: The study includes children from a population-based cohort in Belgium recruited between January 1, 2010, and December 31, 2016, with available cord blood appetite hormone levels and participating in follow-up visits.
note: A population-based Belgian birth cohort built to study how early-life environmental exposures (air pollution named on the study website, green space in its papers) influence ageing; ageing is not a disease.

label: Finnish HPV vaccination cohort
quote: Community-randomized HPV vaccination trial cohort: gender-neutral HPV16/18 vaccination arm, girls-only HPV16/18 vaccination and hepatitis B-virus (HBV) vaccination of boys arm, and arm gender-neutral HBV vaccination arm.
note: A community-randomised HPV vaccination trial of unselected Finnish adolescents followed for HPV; the intervention is a vaccine (a medical procedure, not an environmental exposure), and the trial's single disease focus is HPV infection.

label: Nascita e INFanzia: gli Effetti dell'Ambiente
note: An Italian internet-recruited birth cohort named for and set up to study the effects of the environment and early-life exposures; not about one disease.

label: Rhea Study
quote: This has changed dramatically over the last 50 years, and the Rhea cohort was created in response to the rising concerns about the high rates of childhood obesity in Greece
note: A population-based mother-child cohort in Crete created in response to childhood obesity, set in the context of the changing Mediterranean diet; the obesity focus is stated directly, the diet-exposure design is indirect (it is also used for prenatal metal exposure studies). Checked 2026-09-25: The verdict stands: the catalogue states the cohort was created in response to childhood obesity, and the quote is verbatim. The mapped term is obesity in general, broader than the childhood obesity the source names.

label: Rotterdam Study III
quote: The study aims to unravel etiology, preclinical course, natural history and potential targets for intervention for chronic diseases in mid-life and late-life.
note: The third Rotterdam Study cohort of all residents aged 45 and over in the district, studying chronic diseases broadly; neither exposure- nor single-disease-based.

label: Suivi de l'Exposition à la Pollution Atmosphérique durant la Grossesse et Effets sur la Santé
quote: The SEPAGES cohort is a French couple-child cohort that recruited 484 pregnant women between July 2014 and July 2017
note: SEPAGES is a Grenoble couple-child cohort whose name and stated aims centre on characterising environmental exposures (air pollution, endocrine disruptors) in pregnancy and early life; it is a population birth cohort, not a disease cohort.

label: Sysdimet study
quote: We recruited individuals with impaired glucose metabolism and features of the metabolic syndrome into a 12 week, parallel design, dietary intervention trial conducted at the Department of Clinical Nutrition, University of Eastern Finland (Kuopio, Finland).
note: Sysdimet is a 12-week dietary intervention trial whose main subject is diet; participants were selected for impaired glucose metabolism and metabolic syndrome features, a pre-disease state for type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease.

label: Finnish Maternity Cohort
quote: Population-based Finnish Maternity Cohort (FMC) comprises 2M first trimester sera collected from 1M women during 33 years.
note: The FMC is a nationwide biobank of leftover first-trimester sera from essentially all pregnant women in Finland, i.e. unselected donors; it is used mainly for cancer studies via registry linkage but was not recruited for a disease or an exposure.

label: Polish-Norwegian Study
quote: The PONS cohort is a longitudinal observational regional study collecting information on health and health-related behaviours in the south-eastern part of Poland.
note: PONS is a community-based cohort of volunteers aged 45-64 from the Kielce region studying health, lifestyle behaviours and chronic disease risk factors broadly; neither one exposure nor one disease defines it.

label: Monitoring Project on Risk Factors for Chronic Diseases
quote: The project was carried out in random population samples of Amsterdam (respons rate 33%), Maastricht (43%) and Doetinchem (68%) in the Netherlands.
note: MORGEN is a Dutch random population sample aged 20-65 in which risk factors for chronic diseases (cardiovascular and others) were monitored; its purpose is broad chronic disease rather than one disease, and no exposure defines it.

label: Generation R Next Study
quote: This study was embedded within Generation R Next, a population-based prospective cohort from preconception through postpartum in Rotterdam.
note: Generation R Next is a population-based Rotterdam preconception and pregnancy cohort about growth, development and health of children and parents; not exposure- or disease-defined.

label: Nordic Children and Adults Born Preterm
quote: The Finnish study population includes all births in Finland during 1987–2023, identified from the Finnish Medical Birth Register, THL (approximately 2 100 000 children).
note: NORDCAP is a register-based total birth cohort of all births in Finland, set up to study how preterm birth and pregnancy disorders predict later outcomes; participants are unselected and environmental exposures are only one later-added theme.

label: Wearable data collection study
note: The HEAP wearable data collection study is an exposome pilot following pregnant and non-pregnant women with personal exposure monitors; its purpose is exposure measurement, and participants are not selected for disease.

label: Kardiovize Brno 2030
quote: The Kardiovize Brno 2030 study was designed as a prospective cohort study to investigate the complex relationships of cardiovascular disease and outcomes with a range of biological, psychosocial, environmental, behavioral, and economic factors in an urban population of the Czech Republic.
note: Kardiovize Brno 2030 is a random population sample of Brno residents designed as a cardiovascular health study; environmental factors are one of many measured domains.

label: 1970 British Cohort Study
quote: The 1970 British Cohort Study (BCS70) is an ongoing, multidisciplinary, longitudinal study of a cohort of over 17 000 births in England, Scotland and Wales.
note: BCS70 is a national birth cohort of people born in one week of 1970 followed for health, development and social circumstances; neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: Study on the influence of Air pollution on Lung function, Inflammation and Ageing
quote: SALIA is a population-based cohort of elderly women (not a cohort of either highly exposed or diseased and more susceptible subjects)
note: SALIA is a population-based cohort of women from the industrial Ruhr Area and rural comparison areas, set up to study the health effects of air pollution; participants were not selected for disease.

label: NoMa study
quote: We recently conducted an 8-wk, double-blind, randomized controlled trial replacing SFAs with PUFAs in healthy subjects with moderate hypercholesterolemia (n = 99).
note: NoMa is an 8-week dietary fat-quality intervention trial whose main subject is diet; participants were otherwise healthy adults recruited for moderate hypercholesterolemia.

label: National Health and Nutrition Survey – HYDRIA
quote: As part of the HYDRIA 2013–2014 National Health and Nutrition study, a cross-sectional survey of a nationally representative sample of adults in Greece
note: HYDRIA is a nationally representative Greek health examination and nutrition survey whose design centres on measuring dietary intake (EFSA methodology) alongside health; participants are a population sample, not a disease group.

label: Grain Fibre Modification for Gut-mediated Health Effects
quote: The aim was to investigate whether the white wheat bread enriched with bioprocessed rye bran (BRB + WW) promotes similar effects to WGR on glucose metabolism and plasma levels of SCFAs in healthy subjects with self-reported gastrointestinal symptoms.
note: FIBREFECTS is a crossover cereal-fibre intervention trial whose main subject is diet; participants were healthy adults with self-reported gastrointestinal symptoms (a symptom, not a diagnosed disease; IBD and coeliac disease were exclusions).

label: Piccolipiù birth cohort
quote: Piccolipiù is a prospective cohort of expected 3000 newborns, who will be recruiting in six maternity units of five Italian cities (Florence, Rome, Trieste, Turin and Viareggio) since October 2011.
note: Piccolipiù is a multipurpose Italian birth cohort of unselected newborns; environmental exposures are one of several stated aims beside parental conditions and social factors, and most planned questions concern maternal and social risk factors, so it is not an exposure cohort (borderline).

label: Foods for weight management
quote: Originally 99 (28 males, 71 females) obese (inclusion criteria being body mass index (BMI) 30–40 kg/m2, age 30–65 years) subjects were recruited into the intervention study.
note: ELIPA is a weight-management dietary trial in obese adults comparing foods of higher and lower satiety value; diet is its main subject and obesity is the recruitment criterion.

label: Constances
quote: A cross-sectional observational study was conducted using retrospective data from the CONSTANCES cohort, a large population-based cohort study in France, including adults aged 18 to 69 years at enrolment.
note: CONSTANCES is a general-purpose French population cohort drawn from national health insurance beneficiaries; it has a declared focus on occupational and social factors among other areas, but occupational exposure does not define it, and its disease interests are broad (chronic diseases, ageing).

label: Gene and Environment: Prospective Study on Infancy in Italy
quote: we enrolled children of women older than 18 years, Italian citizens and residents in the Local Health Unit RME.
note: GASPII is a Rome birth cohort piloting a national Italian birth cohort to study genetic and environmental influences on child health in general; its members are unselected newborns and no single exposure or disease defines it.

label: Kaunas cohort
quote: On their first visit to a general practitioner, all pregnant women living in Kaunas between 2007 and 2008 were invited to join the cohort.
note: KANC was set up as the Kaunas cohort of the EU HiWATE project on drinking-water contaminants and pregnancy outcomes and later joined the HELIX exposome project; all pregnant women in Kaunas were invited, so it is not disease-selected.

label: Central European Longitudinal Studies of Parents and Children: Young Adults
quote: Young Adults cohort is an on-going follow-up study of the Czech part of the ELSPAC birth cohort (European Longitudinal Study of Pregnancy and Childhood) that was initiated in 1991–1992 in the Czech Republic, in Brno and Znojmo region.
note: CELSPAC: YA is a population-based follow-up of the young adults of the Czech ELSPAC birth cohort plus peers, siblings and partners, studying lifestyle, social and environmental factors and early signs of chronic disease broadly.

label: European Longitudinal Study of Pregnancy and Childhood
quote: ELSPAC was designed as a population-based prospective longitudinal birth cohort study to investigate the effects of biological, psychosocial, economic and environmental factors on pregnancy, delivery and subsequent child´s development and health.
note: ELSPAC-CZ is a population-based birth cohort of children born in Brno and Znojmo in 1991-1992, with broad aims covering biological, psychosocial, economic and environmental factors on child development.

label: Perturbateurs Endocriniens: Étude Longitudinale sur les Anomalies de la Grossesse, l’Infertilité et l’Enfance
quote: The PELAGIE cohort included 3,421 pregnant women from Brittany from 2002 through February 2006.
note: PELAGIE is a Brittany mother-child cohort set up to study prenatal exposure to environmental and occupational chemicals such as pesticides and endocrine disruptors; participants are pregnant women from the general population.

label: Generation XXI
quote: Data were drawn from Generation XXI, a prospective population-based birth cohort study assembled in Porto, Portugal
note: Generation XXI is a population-based Porto birth cohort studying early-life determinants of growth and health in general; neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: Moli-sani Study
quote: Established in 2005-2010 with the purpose of investigating genetic and environmental risk factors in the onset of main chronic-degenerative diseases, the Study has recruited 24,325 men and women aged ≥35 years residing in the southern Italian region of Molise.
note: Moli-sani is a random population sample of adults in Molise studying genetic and environmental risk factors for chronic-degenerative diseases (cardiovascular, cancer, neurodegenerative) broadly; no single disease or exposure defines it.

label: Central European Longitudinal Studies of Parents and Children: The Next Generation
quote: In this preliminary study, maternal and neonatal oral swabs and neonatal fecal (meconium and transitional stool) swabs were selected from a pool of samples from healthy mother-neonate pairs participating in the pilot phase of CELSPAC: TNG during their hospital stay.
note: CELSPAC: TNG is a Brno birth cohort run by RECETOX whose stated aim is assessing exposome factors affecting child health; it enrols unselected pregnant women and looks at chronic diseases and developmental disorders broadly.

label: Cypriot Children's Health and Environment Observatory
quote: The cohort will consist of children enrolled in the first grade of primary school, who will undergo annual follow-up assessments until completion of primary education.
note: Cypriot site of an exposome-based children's cohort built around the exposome; participants are unselected first-grade schoolchildren and the disease aim is broad (chronic disease risk).

label: Observation of Cardiovascular Risks and Health in Luxembourg
quote: ORISCAV-LUX (Observation des Risques et de la Santé Cardio-Vasculaire au Luxembourg = Observation of Cardiovascular Risks and Health in Luxembourg) was the first nationwide epidemiological study aimed at establishing an objective picture of the prevalence of lifestyle-related risk factors for cardiovascular disease in the general population residing in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg.
note: Nationwide population-based survey whose stated purpose is cardiovascular risk factors, so a population study of cardiovascular disease; lifestyle and greenness are measured but exposure is not the design purpose.

label: Barcelona Life Study Cohort
quote: BiSC included pregnant women between 18 years to 45 years old with singleton pregnancy from the general population who were living in the catchment area of the recruiting hospitals and were able to communicate in Spanish/Catalan.
note: Exposome birth cohort of general-population pregnant women in Barcelona; designed around exposures, not selected for any disease.

label: Puberty and metabolic risk in obese children. Epigenetic alterations and pathophysiological and diagnostic implications
quote: Children were allocated into five experimental groups according to their obesity and insulin resistance (IR) status before and after the onset of puberty.
note: Pubertal follow-up of GENOBOX children (a childhood-obesity case-control study) grouped by obesity and insulin resistance to study metabolic syndrome progression; no environmental exposure focus.

label: Study of Secondary Exposure to Pesticides among Children, Adolescents, and Adults
note: Children of an agricultural community in Ecuador, recruited with a balance of those living and not living with floricultural or agricultural workers, followed for pesticide effects; not a disease cohort.

label: Rome Longitudinal Study
quote: We used the Rome Longitudinal Study, the administrative cohort of residents in Rome who filled in the 2001 population census.
note: Administrative census-based cohort of all Rome residents; air pollution, noise and greenness are linked to addresses and used in later analyses, but no source states exposure as its design purpose.

label: Prevention Cube
note: Occupational health surveillance records of Belgian employees pooled for research on work-related and sector-specific health problems (a member of the OMega-X occupational exposome consortium); no single disease.

label: Czech Health, Alcohol and Psychosocial factors In Eastern Europe study
quote: each consists of a random sample of men and women aged 45-69 years old at baseline, stratified by gender and 5 year age groups, and selected from population registers.
note: Czech arm of HAPIEE, a population-register random sample whose main hypotheses concern alcohol and nutrition; its disease aim covers cardiovascular and other non-communicable diseases, too broad for a disease cohort.

label: International Lipid-Based Nutrient Supplements Project-DYAD-Malawi
quote: We enrolled 1391 women with uncomplicated pregnancies (<20 gestational weeks) in a randomized controlled trial in Malawi.
note: Randomised trial of maternal and infant dietary supplementation in rural Malawi; diet is its main subject (borderline, as the supplements are partly micronutrient capsules), and participants had uncomplicated pregnancies.

label: New Hampshire Birth Cohort Study
quote: The New Hampshire Birth Cohort is an ongoing study and starting in January 2009, we began recruiting 18–45 year old pregnant women receiving prenatal care at study clinics
note: Birth cohort built to study environmental contaminants such as arsenic in private well water; pregnant women recruited at prenatal clinics without disease selection.

label: Shanghai Dapuqiao Aging and Cognition Study
quote: Participants were recruited from the Dapu neighborhood in Huangpu District, a central urban area of Shanghai with a high density of older adults, to investigate health and lifestyle characteristics in an aging population.
note: Community-based cohort of older Shanghai residents recruited through the annual physical examination programme to study health, lifestyle and cognition in ageing; no disease or exposure selection.

label: Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe
quote: Our study is based on the first wave of the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE, http://www.share-project.org), a large population-based survey conducted in 2004-2005 in twelve European countries.
note: Population-based multidisciplinary panel survey of people aged 50 and over on health, ageing and socio-economics; neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: Harmonized Diagnostic Assessment of Dementia for the Longitudinal Aging Study in India
quote: LASI-DAD is a representative subsample of LASI that has a focus on cognitive aging and dementia among persons aged 60 and over in India, with an oversampling of those at a higher risk of cognitive impairment.
note: Population-representative study of late-life cognition and dementia, oversampling people at high risk of cognitive impairment; environmental exposures are collected only as one set of dementia risk factors.

label: Hokkaido Study on Environment and Children's Health
note: Birth cohort designed to study prenatal and postnatal environmental chemical exposures; outcomes span birth defects, growth, allergies, infections and neurodevelopment, so no single disease.

label: GINIplus/LISA North
quote: The GINIplus (German Infant Nutritional Intervention plus environmental and genetic influences on allergy development) and LISA (Influence of Lifestyle factors on the development of the Immune System and Allergies) studies are prospective population-based birth cohorts from East and West Germany.
note: Pooled Wesel (rural, near the Ruhr) participants of two population-based German birth cohorts whose stated purposes are nutritional, environmental and lifestyle influences on allergy development; used in the ESCAPE air-pollution analyses.

label: Walnuts Smart Snack Dietary Intervention Trial
quote: WALNUTs (WSS) is a multi-school, parallel (two-group), controlled, 6-month superiority randomized clinical trial in a large population-based sample aiming to include 800 healthy teenagers in Barcelona, Spain.
note: School-based randomised dietary intervention trial (walnuts) in healthy adolescents; diet is its main subject, and participants are healthy.

label: GENOBOX study
quote: The case group was recruited from children who came to the hospitals to confirm the diagnosis of overweight or obesity or for identification of minor gastrointestinal disorders that were discarded after clinical and laboratory tests.
note: Hospital-based case-control study of children with overweight or obesity and controls, set up to study childhood obesity; diet and activity are analysed but exposure is not the design. Checked 2026-09-25: The verdict stands: a hospital case-control study whose cases came to confirm overweight or obesity, set up to study childhood obesity (catalogue description); the quote is verbatim in PMC9180328. The mapped term is obesity in general, broader than the childhood obesity named.

label: Rio Birth Cohort Study on Environmental Exposure and Childhood Development
quote: The study population will be all children born at the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro Maternity Hospital from July 1st, 2020 to June 30th, 2021.
note: Hospital-based birth cohort designed to study prenatal and early-life exposure to metals, pesticides and plasticisers; all births at one maternity hospital, no disease selection.

label: Programming Research in Obesity, Growth, Environment and Social Stressors
quote: The Programming Research in Obesity, Growth, Environment, and Social Stressors (PROGRESS) study recruited pregnant women who received prenatal care through the Mexican Social Security System (Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social, IMSS) between July 2007 and February 2010.
note: Mexico City birth cohort built around prenatal metals, air pollution and phthalates; outcomes are neurodevelopment, growth and metabolic health broadly, so not a disease cohort despite 'obesity' in the name.

label: Infants' Environmental Health Study
quote: We enrolled 451 pregnant women from Matina County, Costa Rica, which has large-scale banana production.
note: Birth cohort of pregnant women living near banana plantations with aerial mancozeb spraying, designed to study pesticide and manganese exposure; not disease-selected.

label: Multi-Partner Consortium to Expand Dementia Research in Latin America
quote: The Multi-Partner Consortium to Expand Dementia Research in Latin America (ReDLat) recruited 2162 participants with AD, FTD, or healthy controls from six countries: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, and Peru.
note: Multicentre cohort of Alzheimer's disease and frontotemporal dementia patients with controls; its 'exposome' is chiefly social vulnerability and socio-economic indicators, which is not an environmental exposure design.

label: Sustainable plant protection transition: a global health approach
note: Field study recruiting farmers, neighbours of fields and distant consumers by expected pesticide exposure for biomonitoring and risk assessment; no disease selection.

label: Maule Cohort
quote: All eligible Molina residents will be enrolled. Participants were identified through a household census.
note: Population-based census cohort of an agricultural county studying the natural history of chronic diseases broadly; pesticides and pollutants are among many risk factors, not the design purpose.

label: Survey on Health, Well-Being, and Aging in Colombia
quote: This is a cross-sectional study of community-dwelling elderly individuals living in urban and rural areas of Colombia.
note: Population-based national survey of community-dwelling older Colombians on health, ageing and social determinants; neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: Encuesta Nacional de Situación Nutricional
quote: In Colombia, South America, the Colombian Institute for Family Wellbeing (ICBF in Spanish) along with the Ministry of Health (MinSalud) conducted the ENSIN-2015, which is representative of 99% of the Colombian population
note: Nationally representative national nutrition survey whose main subject is the population's diet and nutritional situation; not selected for any disease.

label: Cohorts Consortium of Latin America and the Caribbean
quote: The main aim of the CC-LAC is to start a collaborative cohort data pooling in LAC to examine the association between cardio-metabolic risk factors (e.g. blood pressure, glucose and lipids) and non-fatal and fatal cardiovascular outcomes (e.g. stroke or myocardial infarction).
note: Consortium pooling population-based Latin American and Caribbean cohorts (not recruited for a risk factor or disease) to study cardio-metabolic risk factors and cardiovascular outcomes; a population study of cardiovascular disease, not an exposure consortium.

label: Ecuador Life
quote: What for -The main goal is to investigate the origins of allergic diseases, asthma, and atopy in low- and middle-income tropical settings.
note: Rural Ecuadorian birth cohort designed around early-life helminth and microbial exposures, with allergic disease, atopy and asthma as its stated outcomes. Checked 2026-09-25: A birth cohort whose stated purpose is atopy and allergic disease; the original quote (verbatim) does not name asthma, so it is replaced with the catalogue sentence naming all three outcomes.

label: Banco Nacional de Tumores Terry Fox
quote: Entre 2011 y 2013 se captaron donantes con cáncer-(DC), donantes sin cáncer-(DCS) y supervivientes, quienes fi rmaron consentimiento informado-(CI) aprobado por el comité de ética institucional
note: National tumour bank of the Colombian cancer institute: donors with cancer (tumour tissue), cancer survivors and donors without cancer; a cancer patient biobank. Risk-factor questionnaires are routine, not an exposure design.

label: China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study
quote: The China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS) is a nationally representative longitudinal survey of persons in China 45 years of age or older and their spouses, including assessments of social, economic, and health circumstances of community-residents.
note: Nationally representative ageing survey of Chinese adults aged 45+; general population, neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: REal-time Assessment of Community Transmission
quote: The REal-time Assessment of Community Transmission-1 (REACT-1) Study was funded by the Department of Health and Social Care in England to provide reliable and timely estimates of prevalence of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection over time, by person and place.
note: Random population samples of England tested for SARS-CoV-2 infection and antibodies, now a recontactable cohort; a population study of COVID-19, not an environmental exposure cohort.

label: 3xG study
quote: The 3xG study (Health—Municipalities—Birth, translated from Gezondheid, Gemeenten, Geboorten) is a birth cohort study that monitors and promotes health of the inhabitants of three bordering rural communities (Dessel, Mol, and Retie) in Flanders, Belgium.
note: Local Flemish birth cohort in the nuclear-waste municipalities Dessel, Mol and Retie built around human biomonitoring of environmental exposures (metals, PFAS, glyphosate measured); general health follow-up, no disease focus.

label: Cohort ’18, Growing Up in Hungary
quote: It is based on a nationwide representative sample of pregnant women who gave birth between March 2018 and April 2019.
note: Nationally representative Hungarian birth cohort on childbearing, childrearing and child development; neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: COMmunity-based Behavior and Attitude survey in Tuvalu
quote: The COMmunity-based Behavior and Attitude survey in Tuvalu (COMBAT) collected data between February and May 2022 from 1030 adults (985 with complete data) from Funafuti, the main island, and the other 8 outlying islands [17].
note: Nationwide community survey/cohort of Tuvaluan adults centred on diet, lifestyle behaviours and climate-related exposures; outcomes are obesity and non-communicable diseases broadly, so not a single-disease cohort.

label: São Paulo Western Region Birth Cohort
quote: The São Paulo Western Region Birth Cohort (Região Oeste Coorte – ROC-Cohort) enrolled locally resident babies born at the University Hospital of the School of Medicine of the University of São Paulo between April 1, 2012, and March 31, 2014.
note: Birth cohort of all local births at one São Paulo hospital studying social factors and toxic stress on child development; the named exposures are psychosocial (toxic stress, neighbourhood violence), not an in-scope environmental agent, and there is no disease focus.

label: Next Steps
quote: Next Steps (previously known as the Longitudinal Study of Young People in England, LSYPE) is an ongoing, multidisciplinary, longitudinal study following 16 122 people who were in secondary school in England and were born in 1989–90.
note: National school-based cohort of young people in England born 1989-90, multidisciplinary; neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: PROMESA cohort study
quote: Enrolled children will be followed monthly (phone call) and at months 6 and 12 (in person) post-enrolment with upper and lower Acute Respiratory Infections (ARI) examinations, asthma development, asthma control, and genotoxic damage.
note: Randomly sampled under-five children in high and low PM2.5 zones of Bogotá and Medellín, followed to relate the external exposome, above all particulate air pollution, to respiratory disease (ARI, asthma). Checked 2026-09-25: Children followed to relate the exposome to respiratory outcomes (acute respiratory infections and asthma); verdict and quote stand, but the ARI term is broader than the acute respiratory infections the source names.

label: Butajira Nutrition, Mental Health, and Pregnancy Study
note: Population-based pregnancy cohort in the Butajira HDSS designed to study maternal nutrition and mycotoxin (aflatoxin) exposure; outcomes are fetal and child growth, not a disease.

label: Primeiros Laços
quote: eighty low-income pregnant youth were randomized into two groups: intervention (HVP by nurses, n = 40) and control (healthcare as usual, n = 40).
note: Randomised trial of a nurse home-visiting programme for low-income pregnant adolescents and their children; the intervention is not an environmental exposure and pregnancy is not a disease.

label: Golestan Cohort Study
quote: Cohort Profile: The Golestan Cohort Study--a prospective study of oesophageal cancer in northern Iran.
note: Population-based cohort in Golestan set up to study oesophageal cancer; its primary aim is to identify lifestyle risk factors (opium, tobacco, alcohol, hot tea, diet), in the manner of a diet/lifestyle-and-cancer cohort.

label: Norwegian Family Based Life Course Study
quote: All Norwegians participating in censuses from 1960 to 2001 were included.
note: Register-based cohort of the whole Norwegian census population for multigenerational life-course research; neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: Chilean COVID-19 Biorepository
quote: Adults with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection provided broad informed consent.
note: Nationwide Chilean biorepository of adults with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection, for host-genetic studies of COVID-19 severity and long COVID; a patient cohort, not an exposure cohort.

label: Million Women Study
quote: The main purpose of the Million Women Study is to examine the relationship between breast cancer and use of HRT, in a context where use of hormonal therapy is recorded as reliably as possible and breast cancers are diagnosed as uniformly and consistently as possible.
note: Population-based cohort of UK women invited to breast screening, set up to study HRT and breast cancer; HRT is a medication, so not an environmental exposure cohort, but a population study of breast cancer.

label: Saudi Biobank
quote: This project aims to support a wide range of genetic and epidemiological research studies that are focused on improving the preventive, diagnostic, and treatment of common and rare diseases in KSA.
note: National population biobank of Saudi nationals for research on common and rare diseases; environment is mentioned only in passing, so neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: Prospective Epidemiological Research Studies in Iran
quote: The PERSIAN project is an ongoing, nationwide, population-based prospective cohort that began enrolment in 2014 to characterise environmental, lifestyle, and genetic determinants of non-communicable diseases across Iran’s diverse populations.
note: Nationwide population-based Iranian cohort studying environmental, lifestyle and genetic determinants of non-communicable diseases in general; broad purpose, so no on both counts.

label: Generation Victoria
quote: All children living in Victoria, Australia, born between 4 October 2021 and 3 October 2023 and their parents/guardians are eligible for GenV’s ‘Cohort 2020s’.
note: Whole-population statewide birth and parent cohort in Victoria, a broad platform for child and adult health research; neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: South Asia Biobank
quote: The SAB is a large comprehensive biobank of South Asian individuals in Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka that was established to examine risk factors of diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and other chronic diseases.
note: Population-based biobank of South Asian adults for risk factors of diabetes, cardiovascular disease and other chronic diseases; the purpose is broad (chronic diseases) and environmental data are one of many measures.

label: Dementias Platform UK
quote: Dementias Platform UK (DPUK; https://www.dementiasplatform.uk/) brings together a wide range of cohorts in the DPUK Data Portal to facilitate collaborative research opportunities and answer important questions about dementia.
note: Data platform pooling UK population and clinical cohorts (including Parkinson's and familial Alzheimer's cohorts) for dementia and neurodegeneration research; its stated purpose is dementia, with no exposure focus.

label: Iganga-Mayuge Health and Demographic Surveillance Site
quote: The IMHDSS cohort covers a catchment area of 155 km2 with a population of 95 000 individuals and is served by 23 health facilities.
note: Health and demographic surveillance of the whole population of an eastern Ugandan area, a general population-health platform; neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: HUNT4 70+
quote: Participants from the HUNT4 70+ sub-study were re-evaluated four years later, which offers a unique opportunity to investigate the incidence of dementia and progression from MCI to dementia within this representative cohort.
note: Sub-study of HUNT4 inviting all residents aged 70+ for cognitive and health assessment, used for dementia and MCI prevalence and incidence; a population study of dementia, not an exposure cohort. Checked 2026-09-25: All residents aged 70+ invited to cognitive assessment with expert dementia and MCI diagnoses; the verdict and verbatim quote stand, but mild cognitive impairment is mapped to the much broader cognitive disorder.

label: Coronagenes
quote: We plan to look for genes influencing the risk of catching severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 SARS-CoV-2 and developing COVID-19.
note: Online volunteers sharing direct-to-consumer genotype data with COVID-19 questionnaires (cases and controls) to find genes for COVID-19 risk and severity; not selected by infection, so a population study of COVID-19; no environmental exposure.

label: German National Cohort
quote: Specifically, NAKO is designed to identify novel and better characterize established risk and protection factors for the development of cardiovascular diseases, cancer, diabetes, neurodegenerative and psychiatric diseases, musculoskeletal diseases, respiratory and infectious diseases in a random sample of the general population.
note: German national population cohort drawn at random from the general population with a broad purpose covering many chronic and infectious diseases; neither exposure- nor single-disease-focused.

label: The Malaysian Cohort
quote: TMC is a nationwide prospective cohort project, which recruited approximately 100 000 Malaysians aged between 35 and 70 y at baseline.
note: Nationwide Malaysian population cohort studying non-communicable diseases in general; broad purpose, no exposure focus.

label: Cancer Prevention Study-3
quote: The American Cancer Society Cancer Prevention Study-3 (CPS-3) is a prospective cohort study of over 300,000 US adults with the primary goal of investigating cancer incidence and mortality
note: US adult cohort recruited by the American Cancer Society whose primary goal is cancer incidence and mortality, so a population study of cancer; lifestyle is studied but no exposure is a stated design focus.

label: Personalized Environment and Genes Study
quote: PEGS participants are recruited in outpatient clinics and hospitals and at over 200 unique sites in North Carolina that include businesses, career fairs, universities, community events such as charity walks, health fairs and festivals, senior centers, sporting events, social clubs, religious institutions, and military bases.
note: NIEHS cohort (formerly the Environmental Polymorphisms Registry) built to collect exposome and genetic data on diverse North Carolina adults; exposure-centred design, but it covers many diseases rather than one.

label: Newfoundland and Labrador Genome Project
quote: The NL Genome Project was based on the random recruitment of participants from General Practice clinics from across the province that were 18 years of age and over, possessed a valid NL health card, and provided written consent.
note: General population genetics cohort of Newfoundland and Labrador recruited at random from GP clinics; no exposure or disease selection.

label: UKCTOCS Longitudinal Women's Cohort
quote: UKCTOCS Longitudinal Women’s Cohort (UKLWC) includes the 202,280 postmenopausal women from the general population who joined the United Kingdom Collaborative Trial of Ovarian Cancer Screening and donated their samples and data for use in secondary studies
note: Bioresource of general-population postmenopausal women from an ovarian cancer screening trial, now an open platform for the study of common disease; participants were not selected for disease or risk, so no on both counts.

label: Kilifi Health and Demographic Surveillance System
quote: The focus of research work has been on the incidence of infectious diseases in children, defining risk factors including genetic risks, and interventions to prevent infectious diseases—particularly vaccines.
note: Health and demographic surveillance population in Kilifi, Kenya, set up and used mainly to study the incidence and prevention of infectious diseases of childhood; no exposure focus.

label: Cancer Prevention Study II Nutrition Cohort
quote: The Cancer Prevention Study II Nutrition Cohort was established in 1992 and was designed to investigate the relation between diet and other lifestyle factors and exposures and the risk of cancer, mortality, and survival.
note: Diet-and-cancer subcohort of CPS-II, designed to relate diet and lifestyle exposures to cancer risk, like EPIC.

label: Environmental influences on Child Health Outcomes Cohort
note: US consortium of pregnancy and paediatric cohorts built to study how early-life environmental exposures affect child health; its outcomes span several areas (perinatal, airway, obesity, neurodevelopment, positive health), so not a single-disease aggregation.

label: Japan Public Health Center-based Prospective Study for the Next Generation
quote: The target population for the JPHC-NEXT is the total of 261,939 residents (130,602 men and 131,337 women) aged 40–74 years who were registered in the basic residence registers of the 16 municipalities at the time of enrollment in 2011–2016.
note: Japanese population-based cohort of municipal residents with the broad aim of risk factors for lifestyle-related disease and healthy life expectancy; neither exposure- nor single-disease-focused.

label: China Patient-centered Evaluative Assessment of Cardiac Events Million Persons Project
quote: The pilot is the first large-scale population-based screening project in China aimed at identifying subjects at high risk of cardiovascular disease (CVD) and collecting detailed information and biospecimens as part of a precision medicine project.
note: Nationwide Chinese population screening cohort run to identify people at high risk of cardiovascular disease, so a population study of cardiovascular disease; no exposure focus.

label: Africa Centre Demographic Information System
quote: The aim of ACDIS was to describe the demographic, social and health impacts of a rapidly progressing HIV epidemic in rural South Africa, and to monitor the impact of intervention strategies.
note: Open population surveillance cohort in rural KwaZulu-Natal set up to study the HIV epidemic (later extended to TB and NCDs); participants are all residents, not selected by exposure.

label: LifeGene
quote: The population-based LifeGene study (Sweden) randomly recruited individuals aged 18 to 43 years (n = 12 167).
note: Swedish population-based cohort recruited at random with a broad health purpose; no exposure or disease selection.

label: SG100K
quote: Funded by an NMRC OF-LCG grant that brought together four longitudinal cohorts in Singapore, the SG100K cohort is an Investigator-Initiated Study focused on determinants and prediction of cardiovascular disease and diabetes in Asian populations.
note: Aggregation of four Singapore population cohorts whose stated focus is the determinants and prediction of cardiometabolic disease (cardiovascular disease and diabetes); no exposure focus.

label: South African Population Research Infrastructure Network
quote: Building on the strengths of three existing Health and Demographic Surveillance Systems, SAPRIN is a harmonized network of population-based cohorts with data that are made accessible for the research community and national policy makers.
note: National network of South African health and demographic surveillance populations with a general demographic and health purpose.

label: Lifecourse biological pathways underlying social differences in healthy aging
quote: Lifepath is a research consortium funded by the European Commission under Horizon 2020, designed to explore whether healthy aging is an achievable goal for the entire society.
note: Consortium of population cohorts studying how socioeconomic position affects healthy ageing; socio-economic status alone is not an environmental exposure and healthy ageing is not a disease.

label: Vorarlberg Health Monitoring and Prevention Programme
quote: a population-based cohort of more than 145 000 Austrian men and women followed for an average of nearly 10 years
note: Population risk-factor surveillance and prevention programme cohort in Vorarlberg covering cancer, cardiovascular disease and mortality broadly; no exposure or single-disease focus.

label: 45 and Up Study
quote: The Sax Institute's 45 and Up Study is a large-scale Australian cohort study of 267 151 men and women aged 45 years and over, randomly sampled from the general population of New South Wales (NSW), Australia.
note: Random sample of the NSW population aged 45+ as a resource for research on health and ageing; broad purpose.

label: International Health Cohorts Consortium
quote: IHCC membership criteria prioritize large population cohorts, capability for longitudinal health follow-up, broad participant selection, biological sample collection, and a commitment to data-sharing.
note: Consortium of large population cohorts and biobanks chosen for broad participant selection; collects general population cohorts, so no on both counts.

label: China Osteoporosis Study
quote: Three studies(OOS, KCOS and COS) were originally designed to identify potential genes underlying osteoporosis.
note: The identification of the 2011 sample as COS follows the existing checked definition and matching sample characteristics. Later papers analyse 1624 or 1620 people; these are analysis subsets. Recruitment around Xi’an and Changsha is stated, but the whole later COS resource size is not. No parent or aggregation established in the papers read.

label: Collaborative Study on the Genetics of Asthma
quote: Families were ascertained through two siblings with asthma and then were expanded to include other affected relatives, by extending the family either through relatives with asthma or through one unaffected relative.
note: PMIDs 11349227 and 11793707 and the TAGC supplement were read. They report 266 families and ethnic-group/phenotype counts, but no total participant count; these were not summed. Pooled CAG/CSGA/SARP contributions do not establish a separate parent assertion.

label: Center for Translational Molecular Medicine – Circulating Cells Cohort
quote: CTMM Circulating Cells is a multi-center cohort of four Dutch medical centers that enrolled patients with stable or unstable angina pectoris undergoing coronary angiography, with the aim of identifying cellular biomarkers for the prediction of adverse cardiovascular events.
note: The later 279-person analysis is a subgroup, not the cohort size. Angina is the stated inclusion diagnosis; CAD is not inferred for every symptomatic participant. No parent cohort or aggregation established.

label: California Teachers Study
quote: To determine risk factor profiles and cancer incidence rates among participants in the California Teachers Study (CTS), a study designed to document high breast cancer incidence rates of California teachers and to investigate emergent hypotheses in the etiology of breast and other cancers.
note: Cancer outcomes in a population cohort, not a cancer-patient recruitment series. Occupational membership alone does not establish occupational-hazard exposure.

label: Dutch Autoimmune Hepatitis Study Group
quote: The registry of the Dutch Autoimmune Hepatitis Study Group contains data from autoimmune hepatitis patients, the collection of data started in 2008 and is ongoing.
note: The national epidemiology paper provides the registry patient count; 649 genotyped AIH-1 cases, 476 treated patients and 396 prognostic-score patients are subsets. External GWAS controls are not registry participants. No parent or aggregation established.

label: The Danish study of Functional Disorders
quote: The Danish study of Functional Disorders (DanFunD) cohort was initiated to outline the epidemiology of functional somatic syndromes (FSS) and is the first larger coordinated epidemiological study focusing exclusively on FSS.
note: The design paper reports the combined count directly. DanFunD includes a Health2006 follow-up and an independent sample, so is not a subcohort of Health2006. Lifestyle and chemical-sensitivity measurements do not make it an exposure cohort.

label: Deprenyl and tocopherol antioxidative therapy of parkinsonism
quote: At 28 US and Canadian sites, 800 eligible patients in the early stages of untreated Parkinson's disease were enrolled in DATATOP and randomized to (1) active deprenyl, (2) active tocopherol, (3) active deprenyl and tocopherol, or (4) placebo treatments.
note: Use the achieved enrolment in PMID:2508608, not the planned sample-size calculation in PMID:2515723. Drug interventions are outside the environmental-exposure classification. No cohort parent established; the Parkinson Study Group is a research network.

label: Dortmund Bladder Cancer Study
quote: The case–control series consists of 197 patients with a confirmed bladder cancer from the Department of Urology, St.-Josefs-Hospital Dortmund-Hörde, located in the Ruhr area, an area of former coal, iron and steel industries and 240 controls from the same Department of Urology, admitted for treatment of benign urological diseases, enrolled from July 2009 to July 2010.
note: No combined participant total is stated; cases and controls are not summed. The association table uses 196 cases and 239 controls after analysis selection. Recruitment by bladder-cancer status does not imply selection for industrial exposure. No parent or aggregation established.

label: Diet, Cancer and Health
quote: The primary aim of the cohort is to investigate associations of diet and lifestyle with the risk of cancer and other chronic diseases.
note: The parent is EPIC; the later Next Generations extension is distinct. The 4040-person AF case-cohort sample is not the recruitment total.

label: Case-Control Study of Prostate Cancer among African Americans in Washington, DC
quote: Unrelated men self-described as African American were recruited for several case-control studies on genetic risk factors for prostate cancer between the years 2001 and 2005 from the Division of Urology at Howard University Hospital (HUH) in Washington, DC.
note: No combined total stated; case and control counts are not summed.

label: deCODE CAD/MI Study
quote: deCODE CAD 6640/ 27611 54.7 36.3/ 61.9 74.8 (11.8)/ 53.7 (21.5) 27.7 (4.7)/ 27.0 (5.4)† MI: MONICA criteria (<75 yrs) or discharge diagnosis of MI; CAD: PCI or participation in CVD genetics program with self-report of CABG or PCI, or discharge diagnosis of angina pectoris, MI or chronic ischaemic heart disease Population sample 3
note: No combined total stated; counts not summed. Earlier early-onset MI counts are a subset. CARDIoGRAM membership retained; additional subcohort relation to the deCODE Icelandic cohort supported by case and control recruitment at deCODE.

label: De Novo Parkinson Cohort
quote: Cross-sectional analyses of baseline investigations identified significant differences in the NMS Questionnaire (NMSQuest) and the Scopa-AUT Gastrointestinal score in 159 drug-naïve PD patients vs 110 controls.
note: The design/baseline paper gives separate counts, not a total; no sum is asserted. The later genetic analysis has 149 patients and 92 controls, a subset. No parent or aggregation established.

label: Depression Genes and Networks
quote: The recruitment procedure of the Depression Genes and Networks study (National Institute of Mental Health Grant 5RC2MH089916) was designed to collect samples of individuals with and without major depressive disorder, ages 21–60, from a survey research panel that was broadly representative of the United States population (Supplemental Material).
note: 922 is the published analysed sample, not the invited survey-panel population. The source records cases as recurrent or chronic MDD. No assertion that this independently recruited panel is a subcohort of GenRED.

label: Data from an Epidemiological Study on the Insulin Resistance Syndrome
quote: Subjects were men and women aged from 30 to 64 years who participated in a 9- year follow-up study that aims to clarify the development of the insulin resistance syndrome.
note: The design-source supplement gives the baseline count directly; the 3528 followed normoglycaemic subjects and 2005 persistently non-obese normoglycaemic controls are subsets. No parent established.

label: Dutch Familial Bilateral Breast Cancer Study
quote: DFBBCS Netherlands BRCA1/2 mutation negative familial bilateral breast cancer patients selected from five clinical genetics centers; Erasmus University Medical Center/Daniel den Hoed, The Netherlands Cancer Institute, Leiden University Medical Center, University Medical Center Utrecht, and VU University Medical Center.
note: No combined total or pre-QC enrolment count is stated in the sources read. Rotterdam supplied controls only, so the whole case-control study is not its subcohort. No explicit aggregation membership verified.

label: Dutch Familial Colorectal Cancer Study
quote: Pittman AM (DFCCS) 2008 Netherlands European Replication KASPar 783/664 0.90 53.4 (13.4) Yes 0.61 51.1 (11.3) Population based
note: The original paper PMID:18753146 is readable only as an abstract. The cohort-specific evidence is the secondary table; no total is computed. An expanded Leiden familial CRC series is not proven identical; no merge or parent asserted.

label: Danish Longevity Study
quote: To investigate the impact of CNVs on prospective mortality at the extreme end of life, where the genetic component of lifespan appears most profound, we analyzed genomewide CNV data in 603 Danish nonagenarians and centenarians (mean age 96.9 years, range 90.0–102.5 years).
note: Longevity is a trait, not a disease. No combined total stated; counts are not summed. The 603-person CNV analysis is a subset. Participants were drawn across several ageing cohorts, so no single parent is asserted.

label: UK Young Lacunar Stroke DNA Study
quote: A total of 1,029 Caucasian patients with lacunar stroke, aged ≤70 years, were recruited from 72 specialist’s stroke centres throughout the UK between 2002 and 2012, as part of the Young Lacunar Stroke DNA Resource.
note: No control or combined recruitment total is stated in the study description. DNA was available for 930; 82 additional GENESIS patients are outside this cohort. No parent membership asserted merely from contributing data. The Catalog label DNA Lacunar 2 is retained only as a database-tagged synonym; the ID denotes the earlier UK Young Lacunar Stroke DNA Study.

label: Dutch HeFH cohort
quote: We analyzed data from a prospective cohort study of 1,315 individuals who carried a HeFH variant and 1,315 matched family noncarriers derived from a nationwide screening program in the Netherlands, with subsequent replication in 151,009 participants of the UK Biobank.
note: No combined carrier/noncarrier total is stated; not summed. The methods initially included 1343 carriers, with 1315 in final analyses. The controls are family noncarriers, not CAD cases; CAD is a prospective outcome. Genetic-variant selection is not an environmental exposure. No COHO parent established.

label: European American and Polish height panels
quote: We genotyped an additional 29,098 individuals of European ancestry from five studies, including three population-based studies (15,167 adults and 6,827 children), a type 2 diabetes case-control set (3,897 adults) and a collection of 3,207 adults sampled from the near-extremes of the height distribution (the 5th to 10th and 90th to 95th percentiles; Supplementary Table 1).
note: Height is a trait, not a disease. The 2010 validation paper reports 2181 US and 1009 Polish subjects, not summed here; these are a later genotyped sample. Tall/short group counts are not stated in the cited passage. The two panels remain one cohort term as previously checked; recruitment details require the closed design paper PMID:16041375. No parent established.

label: Fudan Lung Cancer Study
quote: Cases were patients who presented to these hospitals with primary lung cancer.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Guangdong Study
quote: All of the cases were histologically confirmed primary lung cancer (all histological types).
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Genetic Epidemiological Study of Lung Adenocarcinoma
quote: Cases were 18 years or more of age with incident primary lung cancer.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Genes and Environment in Lung Cancer, Singapore Study
quote: Diagnosis of primary lung cancer was ascertained either through histologic or cytologic reports (358 cases) or through radiologic reports (16 cases) with metastatic cancer to the lung from other sites was ruled unlikely.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Hong Kong Study
quote: Cases were lung cancer patients who underwent tumor resection in the Grantham Hospital and the Queen Mary Hospital, ranged from at least 18 years to 80 years old.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Harvard Lung Cancer Study
quote: Briefly, eligible cases included any person over the age of 18 years with a diagnosis of primary lung cancer that was further confirmed by an MGH lung pathologist.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Japanese Female Lung Cancer Collaborative Study
quote: Case subjects were patients with no history of cancer who were histologically diagnosed with lung cancer.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Kentucky Lung Cancer Research Initiative
quote: The Kentucky Lung Cancer Research Initiative is a study conducted by the Markey Cancer Center Cancer Center and the University of Kentucky using a population-based, case- control framework to study the extraordinarily high rates of lung cancer in Southeastern, Appalachian Kentucky.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: New England Lung Cancer Study
quote: Cases with histologically confirmed primary incident lung cancer were identified from 2005 to 2007 using the New Hampshire State Cancer Registry and the Dartmouth-Hitchcock Medical Center (DHMC) Tumor Registry.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Clalit National Israeli Cancer Control Center lung cancer study
quote: The NICCC-LCA study is an ongoing case-control study of newly diagnosed lung cancer cases of any histology and population age/sex/ethnicity-matched "healthy" controls.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Nijmegen Lung Cancer Study
quote: The Netherlands patients with lung cancer were identified through the population-based cancer registry of the Netherlands Comprehensive Cancer Organisation in Nijmegen, the Netherlands.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Norway Lung Cancer Study
quote: Only patients with histologically confirmed early-stage NSCLC were included in our study.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: The Resource for the Study of Lung Cancer Epidemiology in North Trent
quote: The study recruited pathologically confirmed lung cancer cases diagnosed at age 60 years or younger and family matched controls.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Shenyang Lung Cancer Study
quote: Cases were never smoking females with histologically confirmed lung cancers.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Tampa Lung Cancer Study
quote: This study is a hospital case-control study of 511 subjects with newly-diagnosed (within 1 year of diagnosis) lung cancer and 820 race-, sex- and age-matched controls.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Total Lung Cancer Study
quote: The study included 651 lung cancer patients recruited for Moffitt Cancer Center’s Total Cancer Care™ protocol between April 2006 and August 2010.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Tianjin Lung Cancer Study
quote: The TLCS enrolled patients with newly diagnosed and histologically confirmed primary non- small cell lung cancer from Tianjin Medical University Cancer Hospital in Tianjin, China.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Wuhan Lung Cancer Study
quote: The WLCS study was carried out in Wuhan, China and has been described elsewhere13 . Cases were consecutively recruited from the Wuhan Zhongnan Hospital.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Yunnan Lung Cancer Study
quote: Incident lung cancer cases and controls without history of cancer were enrolled.
note: Lung cancer cases define the study; controls do not change the patients role.

label: Familial Ovarian Tumor Study
quote: Enrollment of patients aged 20-79 years of age and diagnosed between January 1, 1995 and December 31, 1999 with epithelial ovarian cancer identified by the Ontario Cancer Registry.
note: Ovarian cancer cases define the study; the inclusion of controls does not change the patients role.

label: Genetic Epidemiology of Ovarian Cancer Study
quote: STA Genetic Epidemiology of Ovarian Cancer (GEOCS) United States Consecutive cases diagnosed from 1997- 2002 in Greater Bay Area Cancer Registry San Francisco.
note: Ovarian cancer cases define the study; the inclusion of controls does not change the patients role.

label: Helsinki Ovarian Cancer Study
quote: Cases treated between 1989-2003 at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology of the Helsinki University Central Hospital, where treatment of ovarian cancer patients from southern Finland is centralized.
note: Ovarian cancer cases define the study; the inclusion of controls does not change the patients role.

label: Hannover-Jena Ovarian Cancer Study
quote: HJO Hannover-Jena Ovarian Cancer Study (HJOCS) Germany Cases attending the Gynecology Clinics at Hannover Medical School or Friedrich Schiller University Jena.
note: Ovarian cancer cases define the study; the inclusion of controls does not change the patients role.

label: Hannover-Minsk Ovarian Cancer Study
quote: Hospital-based case series of Byelorussian patients with epithelial ovarian cancer who had been recruited during the years 2006–2009 at the Byelorussian Institute for Oncology and Medical Radiology Aleksandrov N.N. in Minsk, Belarus.
note: Ovarian cancer cases define the study; the inclusion of controls does not change the patients role.

label: Hawaii Ovarian Cancer Study
quote: Eligible cases for this population-based, case–control study in Hawaii comprised all patients, 18 years of age and older, with histologically confirmed, primary, epithelial ovarian cancer diagnosed between 1993 and 2006
note: Ovarian cancer cases define the study; the inclusion of controls does not change the patients role.

label: Hormones and Ovarian Cancer Prediction Study
diseases: epithelial ovarian cancer|fallopian tube cancer|peritoneal cancer
quote: The HOPE study enrolled women with primary epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or peritoneal cancer between 2003 and 2008 who were residents of the contiguous region consisting of Western Pennsylvania, Eastern Ohio, and Western New York State [20].
note: Ovarian cancer cases define the study; the inclusion of controls does not change the patients role.

label: Los Angeles County Case-Control Studies of Ovarian Cancer
quote: USC (39-41) USA Los Angeles County Case-Control Studies of Ovarian Cancer 1992-2009 Population-based Interview 55.07 (12.41) 2595 (52.2) 2380 (47.8)
note: Ovarian cancer cases define the study; the inclusion of controls does not change the patients role.

label: Malignant Ovarian Cancer Study
