note: Probands and affected relatives have recurrent major depressive disorder of early onset; parents and some unaffected siblings were sampled only as family members.

label: Danish General Suburban Population Study
quote: The Danish General Suburban Population Study was a cross-sectional study of subjects aged > 20 years living in Næstved municipality, Denmark, which recruited 21,205 adults between 2010 and 2013.
note: A general population study of adults living in one Danish municipality, set up to facilitate epidemiological and genetic research, with no single disease as its purpose.

label: Genes in Myopia Study
quote: The Genes in Myopia (GEM) Study aims to recruit probands with myopia and their family members to allow genetic analysis of myopia to be undertaken.
note: The family study recruited probands with myopia and a family history of it, with their relatives; the twin study invited all adult twins from Victoria on the Australian Twin Registry without regard to refraction, so part of the cohort is a population sample for the study of myopia and refractive error.

label: Genentech Human Genetics Initiative Cancer Immunology Cohort 2020 Q2
diseases: metastatic urothelial carcinoma | non-small cell lung cancer | small cell lung cancer | metastatic renal cell carcinoma | triple-negative breast cancer
quote: seven phase 3 trials testing atezolizumab combinations with chemotherapies and bevacizumab spanning six cancer indications: metastatic urothelial carcinoma (IMvigor21115), squamous and non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (IMpower15016, IMpower13017, IMpower13118), small cell lung cancer (IMpower13319), metastatic renal cell carcinoma (IMmotion15120), and triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) (IMpassion13021,22)
note: Patients with cancer enrolled in seven phase 3 trials of atezolizumab and their control arms; the lung cancer trials cover squamous and non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer.

label: Guangzhou Nutrition and Health Study
quote: In 2008, we launched the GNHS project, a cohort designed to provide evidence for the determinants of metabolic diseases in nutritional aspects, as well as other environmental and genetic factors, and explore possible biomarkers and mechanisms with multi-omics integration.
note: A community cohort of middle-aged and older adults designed for the nutritional, environmental and genetic determinants of metabolic diseases. The profile's introduction names 'common chronic diseases (mainly metabolic diseases)', so the curator may prefer 'no' under the broad-purpose rule; its design statement and conclusion name metabolic diseases alone.

label: Genetics of Brain Structure and Function Study
quote: The Genetics of Brain Structure (GOBS) dataset is a cross-sectional imaging archive aimed at localizing, identifying, and characterizing genes and quantitative trait loci associated with variations in brain structure and function.
note: An imaging-genetics study of brain structure and function in randomly ascertained Mexican American families; it assesses psychiatric disorders, but its stated aim is the genetics of brain traits, not a disease.

label: Geelong Osteoporosis Study
quote: The Geelong Osteoporosis Study (GOS) is a prospective, population-based cohort study of adults in Australia.
note: A population-based cohort whose own name gives osteoporosis as its subject, with bone mineral density and fracture as its core measures; the cohort profile (PMID:23283714), which would state its aims, is closed. It now also studies other musculoskeletal and general health outcomes.

label: Göttingen Research Association for Schizophrenia
quote: Inclusion criteria were (1) confirmed or suspected diagnosis of schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder according to DSM-IV and (2) at least some ability to cooperate.
note: A data collection of patients with schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder, with healthy blood donors as controls for genetic association studies.

label: Groningen Renal Hemodynamic Cohort Study Group
quote: The GRECO protocol comprises integrated measurement of renal hemodynamics and extracellular volume as applied in an ongoing series of studies in healthy subjects [33], [34].
note: A physiology programme whose studies are mostly in healthy volunteers; one substudy (RETAP) studies formerly preeclamptic women, but the programme itself is not defined by any disease.

label: Gilda Radner Hereditary Cancer Program
quote: The program enrolled women at elevated risk due to their family histories of cancer, and participants underwent regular screenings with CA125 and ultrasound in an attempt to diagnose ovarian cancer before it had spread.
note: Women selected for a family history of cancer and screened for ovarian cancer (the founder's account of the program); its later participants include BRCA1 and BRCA2 carriers, who are also at risk of breast cancer, but no paper read states breast cancer as a basis of enrolment.

label: Brain Genomics Superstruct Project
quote: Participants were only enrolled if they were participating in a study of normal (non-clinical) brain function or serving as a control participant in a case-control study of a clinical population.
note: Clinically normal volunteers only, enrolled from studies of normal brain function or as controls; the project is about normal brain structure and function, not a disease.

label: UK2 GWAS
quote: We studied 3,960 cases of breast cancer from the UK, selected for a positive family history of breast cancer.
note: A case-control GWAS whose cases are breast cancer patients selected for a family history of the disease, compared with population controls.

label: HangAmDan-B1-Investigator Initiated Trial
quote: The clinical trial is a randomized, multi-center, open-label study to compare the safety and efficacy of HAD-B1 combined with afatinib therapy for patients with locally advanced or metastatic EGFR-mutation-positive NSCLC.
note: A treatment trial whose participants all have locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer with an EGFR mutation.

label: Healthy Aging Longitudinal Study in Taiwan
quote: The HALST is designed as a longitudinal study recruiting community-dwellers aged 55 and above in seven selected areas in Taiwan: two in the north (Shilin District and Yangmei Township), two in the central region (Miaoli City and Changhua City), two in the south (Puzi Township and Lingya District) and one in the east (Hualien).
note: A population sample of older community-dwellers drawn from household registries, with broad aims on healthy ageing (physical functioning, chronic and cardiovascular disease, neuropsychiatric health, frailty); no single disease defines it.

label: Human Biological Data Interchange Repository
quote: Two collections of DNA samples from families with T1D are publicly available for genetic linkage studies, the Diabetes UK Warren 1 repository of samples from the United Kingdom and the HBDI collection of samples largely from the United States.
note: A repository of families with type 1 diabetes, chiefly multiplex families with an affected sib pair and their parents; classified as its UK counterpart the Warren 1 Repository is.

label: Harvard Biomarkers Study
quote: HBS is a Harvard-wide, longitudinal, case-control study designed to accelerate the discovery and validation of molecular diagnostics that track or predict progression of early-stage PD and Alzheimer’s disease (AD).
note: A longitudinal case-control biomarker study of patients with Parkinson's disease (its main focus in later papers), Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative diseases, with controls free of neurological disease.

label: Healthy Lifestyle in Europe by Nutrition in Adolescence Study
quote: Briefly, the HELENA-CSS aimed to describe the lifestyle and nutritional status among European adolescents [16] and took place between October 2006 and December 2007 in ten European cities.
note: A school-based sample of adolescents drawn by random cluster sampling, with a broad purpose (nutritional status and lifestyle); obesity prevalence and cardiovascular risk factors are among its measurements, but no disease defines it.

label: Hellenic Longitudinal Investigation of Aging and Diet
diseases: Alzheimer's disease | dementia | mild cognitive impairment
quote: The HELIAD is a population-based, multidisciplinary, collaborative study designed to estimate the prevalence and incidence of AD, other dementias, mild cognitive impairment, and other neuropsychiatric conditions of aging in the Greek population and to investigate associations between nutrition and cognitive dysfunction/age-related neuropsychiatric diseases in this Mediterranean population.
note: A random population sample of older adults whose stated purpose is the prevalence and incidence of Alzheimer's disease, other dementias, mild cognitive impairment and other neuropsychiatric conditions of ageing, as COHO classifies other population dementia studies.

label: Hertfordshire Cohort Study
quote: The Hertfordshire Cohort Study (HCS) is a population-based sample of men and women born between 1931 and 1939 in Hertfordshire, UK who still lived there at the time of the study [24].
note: A population-based sample defined by place and years of birth; it was set up to study growth in infancy and the risk of adult diseases in general, a broad purpose, not one disease.

label: Health, Risk Factors, Training and Genetics Family Study
quote: The HERITAGE family study (HEalth, RIsk factors, exercise Training And GEnetics) will document the role of the genotype in the cardiovascular, metabolic, and hormonal responses to aerobic exercise training.
note: Sedentary families recruited to study the genetics of the response to exercise training; they were not selected for a disease or for disease risk, and the aim is physiological response, not one disease.

label: Hispanic/Latino Anthropometry Consortium
quote: To date, no large-scale GWAS of anthropometric traits has been conducted among Hispanic/Latino populations; we therefore performed a large-scale genomic study of multiple anthropometric traits, including BMI, height, and waist-to-hip ratio adjusted for BMI (WHRadjBMI), in Hispanic/Latino populations to describe what may be novel loci, or new signals in established loci, for this population.
note: A consortium formed to study anthropometric traits (BMI, height, waist-to-hip ratio) in Hispanic/Latino adults; some member studies are disease case-control studies, but the consortium collects them for traits, not for a disease.

label: Healthy Nevada Project
quote: The HNP is a population health study of Nevadans, with specific targeted recruitment in rural and socioeconomically depressed Northern Nevada areas.
note: An all-comer population health study of adult volunteers in northern Nevada; participants are not selected for any disease.

label: Hoorn Study
quote: To study the prevalence and determinants of glucose intolerance in a general Caucasian population.
note: A random general-population sample whose baseline objective was glucose intolerance (diabetes and impaired glucose tolerance); later papers describe it as a cohort 'on glucose metabolism and vascular disease' (PMID:19768735).

label: Oxford Family Blood Pressure Study
quote: Families were ascertained through a hypertensive proband (through a hospital hypertension service or via their family physicians) defined as daytime ambulatory blood pressure of >140/90 mmHg before the age of 65 years, a level which corresponds to the upper 5% of the distribution in Caucasian populations.
note: Families collected through a proband with essential hypertension, the other members regardless of their blood pressure, for a genetic study of hypertension; most participants are relatives of patients, as COHO classed the GenSalt family study (COHO:0000540).

label: HYPERGENES–European Network for Genetic-Epidemiological Studies
quote: The HYPERGENES Project investigated associations between genetic variants and essential hypertension pursuing a two-stage study by recruiting cases and controls from extensively characterized cohorts recruited over many years in different European regions.
note: A case-control collection of patients with essential hypertension and hyper-normal controls, the disease model of the project.

label: Indiana Biobank Liver cohort
quote: Chronic liver disease cases were identified using ICD9/10 liver disease–specific codes and subsequently confirmed via electronic medical chart review (N=1033).
note: Cases are Indiana Biobank participants with chart-confirmed chronic liver disease (591 of them with cirrhosis, alcohol-associated or MASLD-related), with liver disease-free controls.

label: Inflammatory Bowel Disease in South-Eastern Norway
quote: The IBSEN cohort included 519 incident patients with ulcerative colitis [UC] and 237 patients with Crohn’s disease [CD] between 1990 and 1993, each matched with five controls.
note: A population-based inception cohort of patients newly diagnosed with inflammatory bowel disease (ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease) in 1990-1993.

label: integrated Cancer Repository for Cancer Research
quote: These data should be longitudinal, have broad geographical coverage, and be collected from patients diagnosed with different types of cancer, high-risk individuals, and normal controls.
note: An umbrella of cancer-specific registries (pancreatic, breast and thyroid cancer, among others) that enrol mainly cancer patients, with some high-risk individuals and controls; the quote is the registry group's statement of whom its registries collect, in the paper that places them under iCaRe2.

label: International Cohort Collection for Bipolar Disorder
quote: The ICCBD includes BD cases and unaffected controls from the Sweden Bipolar Disorder Cohort (SWEBIC), the Bipolar Disorder Research Network (BDRN) in the United Kingdom, and the Genomic Psychiatry Consortium (GPC) from the University of Southern California.
note: A consortium that pools bipolar disorder case-control collections (cases with controls) for genome-wide association studies of bipolar disorder and its subtypes.

label: Study to investigate the genetics of in situ carcinoma of the ductal subtype
quote: The ICICLE study was a case–control study recruiting DCIS cases and healthy controls without a family history of breast cancer between 2007 and 2012 (ethically approved by the Southampton and South West Hampshire Research Ethics Committee A under MREC reference: 08/H0502/4).
note: A case-control study whose cases are women diagnosed with ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) of the breast, designed to find genetic predisposition to DCIS.

label: Intern Health Study
quote: The Intern Health Study is a prospective cohort study assessing stress and depression during the first year of residency training in the US.
note: Physicians entering internship, not selected for any disease, followed to study the development of depression (with anxiety and suicidal ideation) under the stress of internship; its stated purpose is depression, as for Army STARRS (COHO:0000958) and IGEDEPP (COHO:0001193).

label: Icelandic Kidney Stone Registry
quote: The Icelandic kidney stone cases consisted of patients with confirmed radiopaque kidney stones from the Icelandic Kidney Stone Disease Registry at LUH.
note: A registry of patients with kidney stone disease, whose patients were the cases of a deCODE genetic association study.

label: Carotid Intima-Media Thickness (IMT) and IMT-Progression as Predictors of Vascular Events in a High-Risk European Population
quote: The 'IMPROVE study' was designed to investigate whether cross-sectional carotid artery intima-media thickness (IMT) and overall IMT progression are predictors of new vascular events in European individuals at high risk of cardiovascular diseases.
note: Participants were selected for high cardiovascular risk (at least three vascular risk factors, no previous cardiovascular or cerebrovascular event) and followed for vascular events.

label: India–Scotland Partnership for Precision Medicine in Diabetes
quote: The main inclusion criterion for the study for all cohorts was diagnosis of type 2 diabetes using the WHO criteria [24].
note: A partnership whose cohorts, DMDSC in Chennai and ESDC in Tayside and Fife, are people with type 2 diabetes, brought together for the study of diabetes.

label: Interplay Between Genetic Susceptibility and External Factors
quote: A random sample of 8626 adults aged 24–77 years was drawn from population registers, of whom 3614 (42%) accepted the invitation and underwent baseline clinical examination between 2001 and 2004.
note: A random population sample with a broad purpose (chronic disease); not selected for any disease. The programme's coronary heart disease case-control study is a separate sample.

label: Internet-based Students Health Research Enterprise
quote: The objectives of the i-Share cohort are to evaluate important health aspects among university students over the course of 10 years.
note: Volunteer students in French higher education, not selected for any disease, followed for their health in general.

label: International Studies of Infarct Survival
quote: In the early 1990s responses to a postal questionnaire were obtained from 13926 survivors of myocardial infarction (cases) recently discharged from hospitals in the United Kingdom and 32389 of their relatives (controls).
note: Trials of patients with suspected acute myocardial infarction and a case-control study whose cases are survivors of myocardial infarction from those trials.

label: Japanese Centenarian Study
quote: The JCS enrolls Japanese centenarians from throughout Japan with an emphasis upon recruiting semi-supercentenarians (age 105+ years) and referent cohort subjects comprising spouses of centenarians' offspring and healthy younger volunteers.
note: Centenarians and semi-supercentenarians with referent subjects: a cohort defined by a trait (exceptional longevity), not a disease.

label: Joslin Kidney Study
quote: the Joslin Kidney Study on the Genetics of Diabetic Nephropathy, a clinic-based cohort study in which case subjects with diabetic nephropathy and a random sampling of eligible control subjects were identified and recruited
note: A clinic-based cohort of Joslin Clinic patients with diabetes, enrolling those with diabetic nephropathy (albuminuria) and a random sample of normoalbuminuric patients, followed for kidney function decline and ESKD. Every participant has type 1 or type 2 diabetes (Supplemental Methods of PMID:39435665); the curator may add those two diseases, which this quote does not name.

label: Jerusalem Lipid Research Clinic Study
quote: the population-based Jerusalem Lipid Research Clinic (LRC) cohort study which was initiated in the 1970s as a cardiovascular prevalence study, using protocols of the North American LRC prevalence studies
note: A population cohort of Jerusalem 17-year-olds and their parents, begun as the Jerusalem arm of the Lipid Research Clinics prevalence studies, a cardiovascular prevalence study measuring plasma lipids and lipoproteins; classified like Bogalusa and Young Finns. The source says 'cardiovascular' without naming a disease, so the broad term is used.

label: Kawasaki Aging and Wellbeing Project
quote: The prime aim of the KAWP is to explore trajectories of functional decline, frailty, and cognitive impairment, and to identify genetic, biological, behavioral, and socioenvironmental factors that delay or modify this deteriorating process at an advanced age.
note: A cohort of physically independent people aged 85-89 from the general population of Kawasaki City, set up to study ageing (functional decline, frailty and cognitive decline) at advanced age; ageing is not a disease in this scheme and no disease defines recruitment.

label: Validation Cohort of Korean Brain Aging Study for the Early Diagnosis and Prediction of AD
quote: We recruited 71 cognitively normal (CN) participants, 96 with subjective cognitive decline (SCD), 72 with mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and 56 with AD dementia (ADD).
note: A memory-clinic cohort across the clinical spectrum of Alzheimer's disease: patients with MCI or AD dementia, with cognitively normal people and people with subjective cognitive decline recruited under the same protocol for comparison.

label: Kilifi severe malaria case-control study
quote: We recruited as cases children presenting with severe malaria to the high-dependency ward of Kilifi County Hospital.
note: A case-control study whose cases are children admitted with severe Plasmodium falciparum malaria; the controls are community infants.

label: Kick It at Swope III
quote: KIS-III was a randomized, double-blind placebo-controlled study with the primary aim of evaluating the efficacy of bupropion SR in combination with HE counseling for smoking cessation among African American light smokers.
note: A smoking-cessation trial of treatment-seeking light smokers, who were treated for their smoking, classified as for PNAT2 (COHO:0000844) and UW-TTURC (COHO:0002536); the same report measured the participants' nicotine dependence (FTND) and speaks of their 'physical nicotine dependence'.

label: Korean Children-Adolescents Study
quote: The overall objective of the cohort study was to identify early risk factors for obesity and associated metabolic diseases in Korean children.
note: A school-based cohort of unselected children whose stated objective is early risk factors for obesity and the associated metabolic diseases.

label: Leiden 85-plus Study
quote: The Leiden 85-plus Study, an observational population-based prospective cohort study, examined health, functioning and well-being in very old adults.
note: A population-based cohort of all 85-year-olds of a city, with no exclusion criteria, studying health, functioning and well-being in very old age; ageing is not a disease in this scheme and no disease defines it.

label: Lung Cancer Cohort Consortium
quote: The Lung Cancer Cohort Consortium (LC3) database includes detailed risk factor and lung cancer outcomes data from 24 prospective cohort studies in North America, Asia, Australia, and Europe
note: A consortium of general-population prospective cohorts (and the PLCO screening trial) pooled to study lung cancer risk, risk prediction and early detection, so it is a population study of one disease, as its name says.

label: Long Island Breast Cancer Study Project
quote: The Long Island Breast Cancer Study Project is a federally mandated, population-based case-control study to determine whether breast cancer risk among women in the counties of Nassau and Suffolk, NY, is associated with selected environmental exposures, assessed by blood samples, self-reports, and environmental home samples.
note: A population-based case-control study whose cases are women newly diagnosed with in situ or invasive breast cancer, with population controls; the cases were later followed for prognosis.

label: LIFE Child Study
quote: The LIFE Child study is a large population-based longitudinal childhood cohort study conducted in the city of Leipzig, Germany.
note: A population-based childhood cohort whose stated aims are healthy development and 'lifestyle diseases such as obesity' in general (the 2012 protocol names obesity, atopy and mental health), a broad purpose; its obesity sub-cohort recruits obese children through the university hospital, but the study as a whole is not defined by one disease.

label: LifeGen Consortium
quote: Here we extend that approach in a genome-wide association meta-analysis (GWAMA) to discovery across UKB European- and African-ancestry populations and 24 further population studies (LifeGen), mainly from Europe, Australia and North America, to search for further genetic variants influencing longevity.
note: A consortium of population studies pooled to study the genetics of longevity through parents' survival; lifespan is a trait, not a disease, and no member was selected for a disease.

label: Learning on Genetics of Schizophrenia Spectrum
quote: The LOGOS cohort provides a comprehensive endophenotypic assessment of schizophrenia-related intermediate phenotypes in a demographically and genetically homogeneous population of healthy, young, Greek males.
note: Randomly selected healthy conscripts, screened to exclude mental illness, studied for schizophrenia-related intermediate phenotypes and their genetics, as the study's name (schizophrenia spectrum) states; classified like its sister study ASPIS (COHO:0001498), which COHO has as a population study of schizophrenia and psychosis.

label: LonGenity study
quote: From 2008 through 2024, the study enrolled Ashkenazi Jewish individuals from the New York City area, aged 65 years or older, and free of significant cognitive, visual, or hearing impairments.
note: Older adults without significant cognitive, visual or hearing impairment, selected by their parents' lifespan (exceptional longevity or usual survival) to study healthy ageing; longevity is a trait, not a disease.

label: Lovelace Smokers Cohort
quote: Enrollment in the LSC started in 2001 with the goal to conduct longitudinal studies on biomarkers of respiratory diseases, including COPD and lung cancer in biospecimens from smokers.
note: Current and former smokers with a substantial smoking history, enrolled for their risk of COPD and lung cancer and followed for lung function decline, lung cancer incidence and death; none had lung cancer at entry.

label: Sydney Memory and Ageing Study
quote: The Sydney Memory and Ageing Study (Sydney MAS) was initiated in 2005 to examine the clinical characteristics and prevalence of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and related syndromes, and to determine the rate of change in cognitive function over time.
note: A population sample of non-demented older people drawn at random from the electoral roll, whose stated purpose is mild cognitive impairment and cognitive decline; classified like the Mayo Clinic Study of Aging (COHO:0001204).

label: Mauritius study
quote: Replication testing amongst South Asians was carried out amongst 13,170 T2D cases and 25,398 controls participants from the following studies: the Chennai Urban Rural Epidemiology Study (CURES) the COBRA study the Diabetes Genetics in Pakistan (DGP) and UK Asian Diabetes Study (UKADS), the Mauritius study, the Ragama Health Study (RHS), the Sikh Diabetes Study (SDS), the Singapore Consortium of Cohort Studies (SCCS), the Sri Lankan Diabetes Study (SLDS), and the LOLIPOP and PROMIS studies.
note: A type 2 diabetes case-control sample: cases with diabetes by history, medication or OGTT (1999 WHO criteria) and controls with normal glucose tolerance, drawn from the 1998 population survey.

label: MDD2000+ study
quote: The MDD2000+ project comprises a total of 2431 cases with MDD and 3673 screened controls from different sources and genotyped on different platforms (Tables 1 and 2).
note: A case-control collection for a genome-wide study of major depressive disorder: cases with MDD from Australian twin families, NESDA, NTR and Scottish psychiatric services, with controls screened negative for MDD.

label: MedGenome case-control study
quote: To provide a set of individuals to test the framework for GPSCAD assessment, a second set of individuals −1,826 CAD cases and 1,209 controls - were recruited from outpatient clinics and hospitals at 5 cities in India -- Kochi, Jaipur, Coimbatore, Chennai and Bangalore.
note: A coronary artery disease case-control study: CAD cases and controls recruited from outpatient clinics and hospitals.

label: MEta-analysis of type 2 DIabetes in African Americans Consortium
quote: In order to investigate the genetic architecture of T2D in African Americans, the MEta-analysis of type 2 DIabetes in African Americans (MEDIA) Consortium examined 17 GWAS on T2D comprising 8,284 cases and 15,543 controls in African Americans in stage 1 analysis.
note: A consortium pooling type 2 diabetes case-control genome-wide studies of African Americans.

label: Metabolic Syndrome Berlin Potsdam Study
quote: Participants were selected from the ongoing German Metabolic Syndrome Berlin Potsdam (MeSyBePo) study that currently includes ∼2,500 individuals with different states of glucose tolerance.
note: A randomly recruited population sample ('randomly recruited from Berlin, Potsdam and surroundings', PMID:28835639) studied for the metabolic syndrome, as its name says, with an OGTT for everyone and type 2 diabetes as the main outcome of its analyses ('325 participants with T2DM were compared to 1,572 non-affected individuals', PMID:19052638).

label: Metabolic Syndrome Cohort
diseases: type 2 diabetes | arterial hypertension | cardiovascular disease
quote: We performed a prospective observational cohort study including Mexican adults living in large urban settings of central Mexico including Mexico City, Cuernavaca, Leon, Toluca and Aguascalientes to evaluate incidence of T2D, arterial hypertension and cardiovascular disease, We aimed to identify risk factors associated to ID in order to develop a predictive model for ID in our population.
note: Apparently healthy adults, recruited at workplaces, homes and medical units rather than for a disease, followed up for the incidence of type 2 diabetes (T2D in the quote), arterial hypertension and cardiovascular disease, the stated purpose of the cohort.

label: Mexican ancestry in Los Angeles, California
quote: Samples from seven additional populations were also included: African ancestry in the southwestern USA (ASW); Chinese in metropolitan Denver, Colorado, USA (CHD); Gujarati Indians in Houston, Texas, USA (GIH); Luhya in Webuye, Kenya (LWK); Maasai in Kinyawa, Kenya (MKK); Mexican ancestry in Los Angeles, California, USA (MXL); and samples collected in Tuscany, Italy (TSI).
note: A HapMap reference population sample of people of Mexican ancestry in Los Angeles, collected as a reference for human genetic variation; not selected for any disease.

label: Midspan Family Study
quote: The Midspan Family Study is a general population survey of 1477 Caucasian families in Renfrew and Paisley (Scotland), which included 15 402 participants in the first, parental, generation (aged 45–64 years) surveyed between 1972 and 1976.
note: A general population survey of families, not selected for any disease; the offspring were invited 'to complete a questionnaire and attend a cardiorespiratory examination at a community clinic' (PMID:10884260), and its papers cover cardiovascular disease, lung function, asthma and hay fever among other outcomes, but no source read states a single disease or disease family as its purpose. The curator may read the cardiorespiratory examination as a population study of cardiovascular and respiratory disease.

label: Microarray in Node-Negative and 1 to 3 Positive Lymph Node Disease May Avoid Chemotherapy
quote: In this randomized, phase 3 study, we enrolled 6693 women with early-stage breast cancer and determined their genomic risk (using the 70-gene signature) and their clinical risk (using a modified version of Adjuvant! Online).
note: A randomised phase 3 trial whose participants all have operable early-stage invasive breast cancer.

label: Mammography, Oestrogens and Growth Factors study
quote: Cancer-free women who were enrolled in the Age trial and were regularly attending screening were invited to participate between 2000 and 2003 and were sent a baseline questionnaire on demographic, anthropometric, lifestyle and reproductive characteristics, and asked to provide a blood sample.
note: Cancer-free women attending a screening trial, studied for mammographic density, a trait and marker of breast cancer risk rather than a disease; the curator may prefer to read it as a population study of breast cancer, the purpose of the Age Trial it is nested in.

label: Monitoring National du Risque Artériel
quote: Participants aged 35 to 74 years (n=4609) were randomly selected from the general population of three French regions. A standardized data collection was performed to assess cardiovascular risk as described in the French and European guidelines.
note: A random general-population survey whose purpose, as its name says ('National Monitoring of Arterial Risk'), is cardiovascular risk; classified like the WHO MONICA surveys in COHO (COHO:0000118, COHO:0001642, COHO:0001977).

label: Montreal/Boston Collection
quote: Subjects diagnosed with autism spectrum disorders with both of their parents were recruited from clinics specializing in the diagnosis of Pervasive Developmental Disorders (PDD), readaptation centers, and specialized schools in the Montreal and Quebec City regions, Canada, as described 31.
note: Families ascertained through a child with autism spectrum disorder (the probands of the trios), in Montreal and likewise in the Boston-area samples ('Families were ascertained for having one or more autistic children', EDSP), as for the Autism Genome Project (COHO:0001479).

label: Memorial Sloan Kettering Bladder Cancer Study
quote: MSKCC 149 152 53(17-84) 82 77 87 44 Hospital-based
note: A hospital-based bladder cancer case-control study: the row gives its bladder cancer cases and controls in the table of case-control groups of a bladder cancer GWAS (PMID:19648920, 'We conducted a genome-wide association study on 969 bladder cancer cases and 957 controls from Texas.'); no single sentence names both the study and the disease.

label: Memorial Sloan Kettering Lung Cancer GWAS
quote: the Memorial Sloan Kettering Lung Cancer GWAS (30) and the Mayo lung cancer GWAS (31).
note: A hospital-based case-control lung cancer GWAS, one of the 13 lung cancer GWAS pooled in PMID:26363033, whose Table 1 gives its lung cancer cases by histology; classified like the Mayo lung cancer GWAS (COHO:0002036).

label: Ms. OS (Hong Kong)
quote: It was initially aimed to investigate osteoporosis, sarcopenia, and other aging-related health outcomes, and through multiple follow-ups has become an important resource for geriatric research.
note: A community sample of older Chinese women (not selected for disease) in a study named for osteoporosis ('osteoporotic fractures in women') whose stated initial aim was osteoporosis and sarcopenia; classified like MrOS (COHO:0000549) and the Hong Kong Osteoporosis Study (COHO:0000949).

label: Mammography Screening Project
quote: Additionally, to increase both the number of women and longitudinal blood samples, the Mammography Screening Project (MSP) was conducted during 1995–2006, including women who attended mammography in Västerbotten.
note: Women attending routine mammography screening in Västerbotten, recruited to add women and repeated blood samples to the NSHDS; they were not selected for a disease or for risk of one, and no single disease is the project's stated purpose.

label: Mid-South Tobacco Family
quote: Once a proband and a full sibling who was also nicotine dependent (for most of our families) were identified, additional siblings and biological parents were recruited whenever possible, regardless of their smoking status.
note: Families were ascertained through a nicotine-dependent smoker proband and, in most families, a nicotine-dependent full sibling, then extended to other siblings and parents, for linkage and association studies of nicotine dependence.

label: Minnesota Twin Family Registry
quote: MTR twins were identified from Minnesota State birth certificates, which are publically available.
note: A population-based twin registry ascertained from birth records, not selected for any disease; twin registries are out of scope as disease cohorts.

label: Myopia Genomics Study of Hong Kong
quote: In an initial association study, 600 unrelated Southern Han Chinese subjects (Group 1) were recruited: 300 cases of high myopes with spherical equivalent (SE) ≤−8.00 D in both eyes, and 300 emmetropic controls with SE within ±1.00 D in both eyes.
note: A genetic study of myopia recruited at the Hong Kong Polytechnic University's Optometry Clinic; the study's own description says its recruitment is 'as described previously' in three case-control studies of high myopia (spherical equivalent -8.00 D or worse) with emmetropic controls, of which this quote is from the first (ref 23). The quote describes that paper's sample, not the genome-wide sample by name, hence medium confidence.

label: Newcastle 85+ Study
quote: The Newcastle 85+ Study aims to systematically study the clinical, biological, and psychosocial attributes of an unselected cohort of 85 year olds and to examine subsequent health trajectories as the cohort ages; health at baseline is reported.
note: An unselected birth-year cohort of 85-year-olds studied for health and ageing in general; no single disease is its purpose.

label: Nicotine Addiction Genetics
quote: Twin pairs concordant for smoking history were recruited along with their family members, as part of the multisite Nicotine Addiction Genetics consortium.
note: The consortium collects family studies of smokers (Finnish twin pairs concordant for smoking, Australian families with a sib pair concordant for heavy smoking) and their relatives, recruited to study nicotine addiction; classified as its Finnish member (COHO:0001377) is, at risk of nicotine dependence.

label: Norwegian Addison Registry
quote: The National Norwegian Addison Registry (ROAS) collates clinical information, demographics, and biological samples from patients with PAI.
note: A national registry and biobank of patients with primary adrenal insufficiency (Addison's disease), mostly autoimmune.

label: Netherlands Brain Bank
quote: The NBB was established in 1985 to collect human brain tissues from donors with various neurological and psychiatric disorders and also non-diseased donors.
note: A brain bank of donors with neurological and psychiatric disorders, with non-diseased donors as controls; classified as the Queen Square Brain Bank (COHO:0001395) is. It was founded to supply tissue from Alzheimer's disease patients and controls (PMID:8360654).

label: North Cumbria Community Genetics Project
quote: Samples and data from this prospective, unselected, population-based cohort were collected between 1996 and 2003 at a single maternity unit in West Cumbria, UK.
note: An unselected population birth cohort and DNA bank, set up as a resource for genetic and epidemiological research in general, not for a disease.

label: Netherlands Mental Health Survey and Incidence Study
quote: The main objectives of the new study are to provide up‐to‐date figures on the prevalence, incidence, course and consequences of mental disorders, and to study trends in mental disorders and service use, with the use of a new sample.
note: A general-population survey whose stated purpose is one disease family, mental disorders (NEMESIS-1 likewise 'To determine prevalence, incidence and course of psychiatric disorders in non-institutionalised Dutch adults', PMID:9555130); participants are not selected for any disorder.

label: Newfoundland Osteoarthritis Study
quote: The NFOAS recruited OA patients who underwent a total knee replacement surgery due to primary OA between November 2011 and December 2013 at the St. Clare’s Mercy Hospital and Health Science Centre General Hospital in St. John’s, the capital city of Newfoundland and Labrador (NL), Canada.
note: A series of patients undergoing joint replacement, largely for primary osteoarthritis, recruited to find markers for osteoarthritis.

label: 1998 Singapore National Health Survey
quote: NHS98 is a population-based, cross-sectional study of Chinese, Malays, and Asian Indians, aged between 18 and 69 years, that has previously been described (9,10).
note: A national population survey of residents aged 18-69 following the WHO model for surveys of diabetes and other noncommunicable diseases, a broad purpose; participants were not selected for any disease.

label: Norfolk Island Health Study
quote: However, because the initial aim of the Norfolk Island Health Study (NIHS) was to study cardiovascular diseases, only serum biomarkers were collected.
note: A population study of volunteers from an island isolate, whose initial aim was cardiovascular disease (PMID:34593906; the 2026 paper says it was established to investigate genetic risk factors for complex diseases); participants were not selected for disease.

label: NIPT PLUS cohort
quote: In addition to the previously mentioned participants, we collected data from 4,688 individuals who sought maternity check-ups at Shenzhen Baoan Women’s and Children’s Hospital (Shenzhen, China) throughout the entire 40-week gestational period.
note: Unselected pregnant women attending maternity check-ups and prenatal screening; pregnancy is not a disease, and gestational diabetes and gestational thrombocytopenia are outcomes studied in the cohort, not the basis of recruitment.

label: NL4
quote: Cases were diagnosed with probable or definite ALS according to the revised El-Escorial Criteria by neurologists specialized in motor neuron diseases11 . Both cases with and without a family history for ALS were included. Tertiary referral centers for ALS were University Medical Center Utrecht, Academic Medical Centre Amsterdam and Radboud University Medical Center Nijmegen.
note: The cases of a case-control cohort of the Dutch population-based ALS registry (cohort 26 of the Supplementary Note of PMID:27455348); its controls are matched population controls.

label: NordicDB
quote: These samples are individuals chosen to be controls in the original case–control studies.
note: A pool of the controls of Nordic case-control and twin studies (healthy, randomly ascertained individuals); it collects no patients, so it has no disease of interest although its source studies were of prostate cancer, breast cancer, type 2 diabetes, schizophrenia and multiple sclerosis, and intracranial aneurysm.

label: North of Scotland Osteoporosis Study
quote: NOSOS is a population‐based osteoporosis screening programme of postmenopausal females aged 60‐82 years of age at baseline.
note: Women drawn at random from general practice registers for an osteoporosis screening programme (PMID:18633668: 'a population-based screening programme for osteoporotic fracture'); a population study of one disease, not a patient series.

label: Nottingham Smokers
quote: A total of 206 subjects with COPD defined by spirometry (forced expiratory volume (FEV)/forced vital capacity (FVC) <0.7, FEV1% <80%), over 40 years of age, and 338 controls, as part of the Nottingham Smokers Study.
note: Smokers over 40 with more than 10 pack-years, a group at high risk of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, with spirometry at enrolment; the papers divide them into spirometric COPD cases and smoking controls, but they were recruited as smokers, not as patients.

label: Novartis secukinumab clinical trials
quote: Novartis data was collected from five clinical trials of secukinumab in psoriasis (details available on https://clinicaltrials.gov/): CAIN457A2302 (NCT01365455), CAIN457A2303 (NCT01358578), CAIN457A2304 (NCT01406938), CAIN457A2223 (NCT01537432), CAIN457A2403 (NCT03553823).
note: Participants of clinical trials of a psoriasis treatment, used as a psoriasis-only cohort; all have the disease.

label: Northeastern Taiwan Community Medicine Research Cohort
quote: The Northeastern Taiwan Community Medicine Research Cohort (NTCMRC; ClinicalTrials.gov identifier NCT04839796) was a community cohort study launched in 2012 by the Community Medicine Research Center of Chang Gung Memorial Hospital in Keelung and enrolled adult participants in Northeastern Taiwan.
note: A community cohort of adult volunteers on disease prevention and health promotion; its registration lists collaborative projects on chronic kidney disease, chronic liver disease, metabolic syndrome, depression, dementia and obesity, a broad purpose rather than one disease.

label: Neocodex–Murcia study
quote: A sample of 327 sporadic AD patients and 801 controls with unknown cognitive status from the Spanish general population were included in our initial study.
note: A case-control sample whose cases are patients with sporadic Alzheimer's disease (AD in the source, defined in the same abstract as Alzheimer's disease), diagnosed at the Virgen de la Arrixaca University Hospital in Murcia; the controls are general-population controls.

label: New Zealand CAD Study
quote: New Zealand CAD patients all had angiographically proven coronary artery stenosis ≥50% of the vessel internal diameter in at least 1 vessel.
note: A case-control sample whose cases are patients with angiographically proven coronary artery disease (CAD), and whose age-matched controls had no history of ischaemic heart disease (PMID:19198610 Supplementary Note).

label: Ogliastra Genetic Park
quote: People living in the villages were invited to take part in the study by means of information campaigns and letters sent to every family, achieving a participation of about 80% of the resident population.
note: A population survey of whole villages of a genetic isolate, studying complex traits and diseases in general (platelet count, hypertension, metabolic syndrome, kidney function), not one disease.

label: Ocular Hypertension Treatment Study
quote: The Ocular Hypertension Treatment Study (OHTS) seeks to evaluate the safety and efficacy of topical ocular hypotensive medication in preventing or delaying the onset of visual field loss and/or optic nerve damage in subjects with ocular hypertension at moderate risk for developing primary open angle glaucoma.
note: The participants have ocular hypertension without glaucomatous damage and were enrolled for their risk of primary open-angle glaucoma, the trial's outcome; ocular hypertension itself is the risk state, not the disease studied.

label: Osaka-Midosuji Rotary Club
quote: We also obtained 1023 Japanese control DNAs from healthy volunteers from the Osaka-Midosuji Rotary Club, Osaka, Japan.
note: Healthy volunteers who donated DNA for use as controls; not selected for any disease.

label: Orofacial Pain: Prospective Evaluation and Risk Assessment
quote: The project “Orofacial Pain: Prospective Evaluation and Risk Assessment” (OPPERA) was designed to identify a broad range of genetic, physiologic, psychosocial and clinical characteristics that influence development of painful temporomandibular disorders (TMD).
note: Community volunteers free of TMD recruited into a prospective cohort to identify risk factors for first-onset TMD, with a baseline case-control study that adds people with chronic TMD; the study's stated purpose is one disease.

label: Oregon Sudden Unexpected Death Study
quote: The Oregon Sudden Unexpected Death Study is a prospective study of out‐of‐hospital cardiac arrest in the Portland, Oregon, metropolitan area (population ≈1 million), ongoing since 2002.
note: Cases are out-of-hospital sudden cardiac arrests and deaths ascertained through emergency medical services, hospitals and the medical examiner, compared with geographic controls, most with coronary artery disease; the patients (cases) define the study.

label: Osteoporosis and Ultrasound Study
quote: The Osteoporosis and Ultrasound Study (OPUS) is a multicenter prospective study of risk factors for fractures in post menopausal women.
note: Women recruited from random population samples, followed for risk factors of osteoporotic fracture; the study's stated purpose is osteoporosis and fractures (vertebral and other major osteoporotic fractures).

label: OVCARE Gynecologic Tissue Bank and Outcomes Unit
quote: Genotype analyses were restricted to invasive epithelial ovarian cancer patients of European ancestry with detailed chemotherapy and clinical follow-up for disease progression and survival following first-line treatment from OCAC and TCGA (Supplementary Table 6).
note: A tissue bank and outcomes unit of a gynaecological oncology service whose patients, recruited at Vancouver General Hospital and the BC Cancer Agency, are the unit's contribution to OCAC; the quote describes the patients of all the OCAC sites in Supplementary Table 6, VAN among them.

label: Oxford Endometriosis Gene Study
quote: From 1995-2006, the Oxford Endometriosis Gene (OXEGENE) study, Oxford, UK, recruited 245 families with ≥2 affected sisters with surgically confirmed endometriosis, and 785 single cases.
note: Every participant counted by the study is a woman with surgically confirmed endometriosis (affected sisters and single cases); it is a genetic study of that disease.

label: Progression to insulin deficiency: South West England cohort
quote: We assessed a cross-sectional cohort of people diagnosed with diabetes between the ages of 20 and 40 years (n=223), who had diabetes for more than 3 years and self-reported as white European, from Devon and Cornwall in South West England.
note: Every participant has diabetes (diagnosed at 20-40 years, of any type, known monogenic and secondary diabetes excluded); the cohort was used to test prediction of progression to severe insulin deficiency.

label: Pancreatic Cancer: Investigation into Finding Causes Study
quote: The Pancreatic Cancer: Investigation into Finding Causes (PACIFIC) Study is a case-control study of pancreatic cancer based in the defined populations of two large health plans (Group Health Cooperative (GHC) in Seattle, WA and Kaiser Permanente Northern California, (KPNC)).
note: A case-control study whose cases are newly diagnosed pancreatic cancer patients (pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma in the family history analysis) of two health plans.

label: Parkinson's, Genes, and Environment Study
quote: Potential PD patients in this cohort were first identified from self-reports in its follow-up survey in 2004–2006, and then were confirmed either by their treating physicians or by medical record review.
note: A case-control study of Parkinson's disease nested in the NIH-AARP Diet and Health Study: its cases are cohort members with physician-confirmed Parkinson's disease.

label: French Parkinson's Disease Genetics Study Group
quote: Subjects with PD (n=1031) were recruited through the French network for the study of Parkinson's disease genetics associating 15 university hospitals across France.
note: A network that recruits Parkinson's disease patients, many of them early-onset or familial index cases, for genetic studies; the few controls it recruits do not change that.

label: PEAK-25
quote: The PEAK-25 cohort is a longitudinal, prospective, population-based study of young-adult women with the main purpose of exploring the relationship between genetic, clinical, and lifestyle factors associated with attainment of peak bone mass and subsequent changes in bone mass over time.
note: A population-based cohort of young women studied for peak bone mass, a trait; no disease defines or motivates it.

label: PHArmacogenetic study of Statins in the Elderly at risk
quote: Men and women aged 70-82 years were recruited if they had pre-existing vascular disease or were at increased risk of such disease because of smoking, hypertension, or diabetes.
note: The genotyped participants of the PROSPER statin trial, selected for pre-existing vascular disease or a raised risk of it; as for PROSPER (COHO:0000539), the mixed group is recorded as at risk.

label: Philadelphia Cohort
quote: We combined genome-wide association data from 12 cohorts of individuals with epilepsy and controls from population-based datasets.
note: A case-control collection of people with epilepsy (focal and genetic generalised) and controls, one of the 12 cohorts of the ILAE 2014 meta-analysis, whose design sentence names 'Philadelphia (PA, USA)' among them.

label: Portuguese Island Collection
quote: The initial 10,000 GPC participants drawn from earlier studies include our Portuguese Island Collection (PIC) of individuals and multiplex families with schizophrenia and/or bipolar disorder.
note: A psychiatric-genetics collection of individuals and multiplex families with schizophrenia and/or bipolar disorder (with screened controls).

label: Prospective Imaging Study of Ageing: Genes, Brain and Behaviour
quote: This prospective cohort study, “Prospective Imaging Study of Ageing: Genes, Brain and Behaviour” (PISA) seeks to characterise the phenotype and natural history of healthy adult Australians at high future risk of Alzheimer’s disease (AD).
note: Healthy midlife and older adults selected by genetic risk of Alzheimer's disease (high and low polygenic risk and APOE status) to study its prodromal phase; a smaller clinical group of patients with mild cognitive impairment or early Alzheimer's disease serves as positive controls.

label: Pittsburgh Lung Screening Study
quote: We conducted a prospective nested case-control study of incident lung cancer cases and individually matched healthy controls from the Pittsburgh Lung Screening Study cohort of current and former smokers at high risk for developing lung cancer.
note: Long-term heavy smokers were enrolled for CT lung cancer screening and followed for lung cancer; they were selected for their risk of the disease, not because they had it.

label: Molecular Reclassification to Find Clinically Useful Biomarkers for Systemic Autoimmune Diseases
diseases: rheumatoid arthritis | systemic sclerosis | primary Sjögren's syndrome | systemic lupus erythematosus | primary antiphospholipid syndrome | mixed connective tissue disease | undifferentiated connective tissue disease
quote: The target number of included patients affected by systemic autoimmune diseases was 2005 (around 400 by disease or group of diseases: rheumatoid arthritis, scleroderma or systemic sclerosis, primary Sjögren’s syndrome, systemic lupus erythematosus, and primary antiphospholipid syndrome, mixed connective tissue disease and undifferentiated connective tissue disease) and 554 healthy controls.
note: Patients with seven systemic autoimmune diseases were recruited, with healthy controls, to reclassify these diseases molecularly; the source's 'scleroderma or systemic sclerosis' is given as systemic sclerosis.

label: Precision Medicine Platform for Mild Cognitive Impairment Based on Multi-omics, Imaging and Evidence-based Research & Business Development
quote: The PREMIER consortium (May 2019 and December 2022) recruited a research cohort to establish an R&BD platform for the development of early diagnosis and precision medicine-based treatment of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and dementia.
note: Memory-clinic patients with MCI, the study's focus, were enrolled with cognitively unimpaired people as normal controls and patients with Alzheimer's-type or frontotemporal dementia as active controls (PMC12046249).

label: Progression Risk of Glaucoma: Relevant SNPs With Significant Association
quote: This study combined a retrospective longitudinal analysis of suspect and early manifest primary open angle glaucoma cases from the Progression Risk of Glaucoma: RElevant SNPs with Significant Association (PROGRESSA) study with 2 replication cohorts from the UK Biobank and the Canadian Longitudinal Study of Ageing (CLSA).
note: PROGRESSA enrols patients with early manifest primary open-angle glaucoma and glaucoma suspects (ocular hypertension or a suspicious disc), excluding secondary glaucoma (PMC9559075), and follows them for progression; the patients role covers its early-glaucoma cases, and its suspects are at risk of the same disease.

label: Sea Islands Genetic African American Registry
quote: Project SuGAR enlisted medical clinics, churches, and established organizations on the Sea Islands to aid in identifying patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus who belonged to families with multiple affected biological members.
note: The registry recruited patients with type 2 diabetes from families with several affected members, with their relatives, to study the genetics of the disease; 1105 of its 1321 participants had diabetes at enrolment.

label: Pharma SNP Consortium
quote: We included a dataset of 924 and 435 healthy subjects from the Pharma SNP Consortium (PSC) as the discovery set and the Japan Biological Informatics Consortium (JBIC) as the replication set, resulting in a total of 1,359 control subjects.
note: Healthy volunteers whose health was checked through the consortium, used as population controls; no disease defines the sample.

label: Pumwani Sex Workers Cohort
quote: The Pumwani sex worker cohort was established in Nairobi, Kenya, in 1985 (27, 48) and has become well known for a small group of women who remain seronegative and PCR negative to HIV despite repeated exposure through active high-risk sex work.
note: Women were enrolled as sex workers, a group at very high risk of HIV-1 (prevalence about 70% in the cohort, PMID:24992306), and are followed for seroconversion, resistance and progression; the same paper says the cohort was set up as an observational study of the immunobiology and epidemiology of sexually transmitted infections, of which HIV-1 is the focus of every paper read.

label: Prospective Urban Rural Epidemiology study
quote: The PURE study was established to investigate associations between social, behavioural, genetic, and environmental factors and cardiovascular diseases in 17 countries.
note: A general-population cohort whose stated purpose is cardiovascular disease; its design paper names chronic non-communicable diseases (obesity, diabetes and cardiovascular disease) as the outcome, but says its data collection is 'geared toward addressing major questions on causation and development of the underlying determinants of cardiovascular disease'.

label: Quit2Live
quote: Eligible participants are non-Hispanic African American or White adults, 18 years of age or older who smoke 3–20 cigarettes per day on 25 days or more during the preceding month, and are interested in quitting smoking, taking varenicline for 3 months, have a functioning telephone, and are willing to complete all study-related requirements.
note: A treatment trial of daily smokers who wanted to quit, all given varenicline and counselling that follows the Tobacco Use and Dependence guideline; classified like the PNAT2 cessation trial (COHO:0000844, patients, tobacco dependence), although the sources call the participants smokers and do not name a diagnosis.

label: Quebec Family Study
quote: The cohort is a mixture of random sampling and ascertainment through obese individuals.
note: A family cohort that began as a random sample with a broad genetic purpose and turned to the genetics of obesity, adding families ascertained through obese members; the overview presents it as a study of 'the determinants of obesity'.

label: SYNERGIQC
quote: SYNERGIQC originates from the Quebec lung cancer screening program [17], a provincial multicenter pilot-study launched in 2021 for ever-smokers aged 55–74.
note: Ever-smokers screened for lung cancer and selected for a high clinical risk of it (PLCOm2012norace risk of 2% or more), so at risk of lung cancer.

label: Queensland Study
quote: QLD = A longitudinal cohort study (Prostate Cancer Supportive Care and Patient Outcomes Project: ProsCan)conducted in Queensland, through which men newly diagnosed with prostate cancer from 26 private practices and 10 public hospitals were directly referred to ProsCan at the time of diagnosis by their treating clinician (age range 43-88 years).
note: A prostate cancer case-control study whose cases are men newly diagnosed with prostate cancer; the controls do not change the role.

label: Radiogenomics: Assessment of Polymorphisms for Predicting the Effects of Radiotherapy
diseases: prostate cancer | breast cancer | head and neck cancer
quote: The RAPPER, RADIOGEN, GenePARE, UGhent, and CCI-EBRT Radiogenomics Consortium (RGC) cohorts included men with non-metastatic prostate cancer who received curative-intent external beam radiotherapy [EBRT], brachytherapy, or both, with or without surgery and/or anti-androgen therapy, described in published GWAS (15–17,20) and summarized in Table 1.
note: Cancer patients treated with radiotherapy and followed for its toxicity; the quote shows the prostate arm, and the breast arm ('female breast cancer patients from the RAPPER (Radiogenomics: Assessment of polymorphisms for predicting the effects of radiotherapy) study', PMID:26510858) and the head and neck arm (RAPPER-HNC, PMID:37862240) are named in other papers.

label: REQUITE cohort
diseases: breast cancer | prostate cancer | lung cancer
quote: Eligible patients had breast, prostate or lung cancer and planned potentially curable radiotherapy.
note: Recruits patients with breast, prostate or lung cancer planned for radiotherapy, followed for radiotherapy toxicity.

label: Reykjavik Eye Study
quote: A population-based cataract epidemiological study, the Reykjavik Eye Study, was conducted to determine the prevalence and characteristics of lens opacities in Iceland.
note: A population sample of older Reykjavik residents examined for eye disease; its first stated purpose is cataract (lens opacities). It also measured refraction and reported open-angle glaucoma (PMID:12928689), so the curator may prefer a broader 'eye diseases', as for other population eye studies in COHO.

label: Risk Evaluation of Viral Load Elevation and Associated Liver Disease/Cancer-Hepatitis B Virus
quote: To examine whether biomarkers of gut barrier dysfunction (i.e., anti-LPS, anti-flagellin, soluble CD14, and LPS-binding protein) are related to risk of HCC in chronic HBV and HCV carriers in an Asian population, we analyzed samples from the Risk Evaluation of Viral Load Elevation and Associated Liver Disease/Cancer (REVEAL)-HBV and -HCV cohorts of Taiwan.
note: Chronic hepatitis B virus carriers (HBsAg seropositive) followed for hepatocellular carcinoma, so at risk of HCC; since the carriers have chronic HBV infection, the curator may prefer, or add, 'patients: chronic hepatitis B' (COHO holds one role per cohort).

label: Research on Osteoarthritis/Osteoporosis Against Disability
quote: In 2005, we established a large-scale population-based OA cohort study called the Research on Osteoarthritis/Osteoporosis Against Disability (ROAD) with the goal of establishing epidemiologic indices to evaluate clinical evidence for the development of a disease-modifying treatment for skeletal diseases [6,7].
note: Population-based cohort of three Japanese communities whose stated purpose is osteoarthritis and osteoporosis (skeletal diseases).

label: Rugao Longevity and Ageing Study
quote: All data used in this study were obtained from the RuLAS, a population-based observational two-arm cohort study performed in Rugao, a typical medium-sized city of Jiangsu province, China.
note: A population cohort of long-lived people and older residents studying longevity and ageing (frailty, cognition); longevity is a trait and ageing a broad purpose, so not a disease cohort.

label: San Antonio Family Diabetes/Gallbladder Study
quote: Evidence was previously reported of linkage to diabetes on 10q with suggestive evidence on 3p and 9p in a genome-wide scan of 440 individuals from 27 pedigrees ascertained through a single diabetic proband.
note: Extended families ascertained through a proband with type 2 diabetes, so relatives at risk of it (as COHO classifies the parent SAFS); the later gallbladder component studies gallbladder disease in the same families, which the curator may add.

label: Stanford Aging and Memory Study
quote: SAMS is an ongoing longitudinal study of healthy aging.
note: Cognitively unimpaired older volunteers studied for healthy ageing and medial temporal lobe memory; it measures preclinical Alzheimer disease biomarkers but its participants are not selected for a disease.

label: Swedish Addison Registry
quote: A cross-sectional, population-based study that included 660 AAD patients from the Swedish Addison Registry (2008-2014).
note: A registry of patients with autoimmune Addison disease (AAD, spelled out in the same abstract and its title); the source's name for the disease is autoimmune Addison disease.

label: South African Zulu
quote: South African Zulu individuals were type 2 diabetes cases and controls from two studies: the Durban Diabetes Study (DDS) and the Durban Diabetes Case Control study (DCC).
note: A combined type 2 diabetes case-control sample (population-based DDS plus diabetes-clinic cases from DCC); its cases have the disease.

label: Sheffield Breast Cancer Study
quote: The Sheffield Breast Cancer Study (SBCS) recruited histologically confirmed breast cancer patients from surgical outpatient clinics in the Royal Hallamshire Hospital, Sheffield and Rotherham District Hospital from 1998 to 2005.
note: A hospital-based breast cancer case-control study; its cases are breast cancer patients, with screening-clinic controls.

label: Shanghai Breast Cancer Survival Study
quote: Briefly, 5042 patients with newly diagnosed breast cancer, aged 20 to 75 years, were identified from the Shanghai Cancer Registry between March 2002 and April 2006 and enrolled in the SBCSS approximately 6 months after cancer diagnosis.
note: A cohort of women with newly diagnosed breast cancer identified through the Shanghai Cancer Registry and followed for outcomes.

label: SCARFSHEEP
quote: SHEEP/SCARF are Swedish population based case‐control studies. Cases are patients with a first confirmed myocardial infarction, controls have no history of myocardial infarction.
note: A combined myocardial infarction case-control sample; its cases had a first confirmed myocardial infarction.

label: Subjective Cognitive Impairment Cohort
quote: Main outcome measures are clinical progression to MCI or dementia and decline in cognitive functioning.
note: Memory-clinic patients with subjective cognitive decline but normal cognition, followed for progression to MCI or dementia; selected for their risk, as COHO has done for GERO and MEMENTO.

label: Singapore Cohort Study of the Risk Factors for Myopia
quote: Children aged 7–9 years from three Singapore schools were invited to participate in the SCORM (Singapore Cohort study Of the Risk factors for Myopia) study.
note: A school-based cohort of unselected children whose stated purpose, in its name and design, is the risk factors for onset and progression of myopia; COHO treats myopia as a disease (as for CREAM and the Guangzhou Twin Eye Study).

label: Study of Digestive Health
quote: Briefly, SDH included cases aged 18–79 years with newly diagnosed Barrett’s esophagus (confirmed by histology as specialized intestinal metaplasia in a biopsy from the tubular esophagus).
note: A case-control study whose cases have newly diagnosed Barrett's oesophagus; its controls are population controls and endoscopy patients with reflux-type oesophageal inflammation.

label: Stockholm Diabetes Prevention Program
quote: Type 2 diabetes is the most common type of diabetes, with a prevalence of at least 4% in Sweden. Aiming at primary prevention of the disease, the Stockholm Diabetes Prevention Program (SDPP) was developed as a joint program between the Departments of Endocrinology, Social Medicine and Epidemiology at the Karolinska Institute.
note: A population-based cohort of adults without diabetes set up to study and prevent type 2 diabetes; by design half the sample had a family history of diabetes ('By design, the cohort was enriched by 50% with subjects that had family history of diabetes.', PMID:35435501), so 'at risk' would also fit that half.

label: NIMH Schizophrenia Genetics Initiative
quote: Briefly: SGI subjects (2.4%) were recruited by three research groups in the United States (see Acknowledgments) in a study designed to collect families with affected sibling pairs (and other affected members when available), ascertaining through probands with schizophrenia recruited through clinical settings.
note: A family collection ascertained through probands with schizophrenia and affected sibling pairs (schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder); the affected members are patients, their relatives are included for linkage.

label: Shanghai Genome-Wide Association Studies
diseases: breast cancer | endometrial cancer | type 2 diabetes
quote: Shanghai genome-wide association studies (SGWAS) population-based 1) 2,895 breast cancer cases, 2) 828 endometrial cancer cases, 3) 886 type 2 diabetes cases, 4) 2,309 controls, all unrelated
note: SGWAS was assembled as case groups of breast cancer, endometrial cancer and type 2 diabetes with a common control group, selected from the Shanghai case-control and cohort studies; classified by the cases it collects.

label: Singapore Indian Chinese Cohort
quote: In conjunction with the Singapore Malay Eye Study, the SICC study will permit an in-depth evaluation of the prevalence, risk factors, and impact of major eye diseases in Chinese, Indians and Malays, three distinct Asian ethnic groups, whose combined numbers represent half the world's population.
note: A population-based sample of Indian and Chinese adults whose stated purpose is the epidemiology of major eye diseases, as for its sister studies SiMES, SINDI, SCES and SEED in COHO.

label: South Korea Multi-Center Lung Cancer Study
quote: The SKLCS study of lung cancer in Korea consists of several studies conducted at multiple study centers, which have been previously described6-8 , as follows: The SNU study of lung cancer in Korea was conducted between 2001 and 2008 and is described in. The lung cancer patients were recruited from patients at Seoul National University Hospitals in Seoul and Bundang
note: An umbrella of three Korean hospital case-control studies of lung cancer, whose cases are lung cancer patients; matches FLCCA (COHO:0000864) and CNULCS (COHO:0001600) in COHO.

label: Småbørns Kost Og Trivsel
quote: Inclusion criteria were being a singleton infant born at term (≥37 weeks of gestation), with no diseases expected to affect growth or nutritional intake.
note: An observational cohort of healthy young children followed for diet, growth and development; SKOT II selects infants of obese mothers to study how maternal obesity affects growth, but neither recruitment is defined by a disease of the children.

label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus in Gullah Health Study
quote: The Sea Island Gullah African American population enrolled in the SLE in Gullah Health (SLEIGH) study, an established cohort of African American patients with SLE, is an ideal cohort for defining genetic and environmental risk factors for SLE because of their genetic homogeneity with very low non-African genetic admixture and preserved family unit.
note: A cohort built around Gullah patients with SLE (ACR criteria), with their relatives and unrelated controls; the patients define it.

label: Study of Irish Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
quote: This study utilized samples from Irish patients with sporadic ALS and Irish control individuals.
note: A case-control collection whose cases are Irish patients with sporadic ALS (El Escorial criteria).

label: Strabismus, Amblyopia and Refractive Error Study in Singaporean Chinese Preschoolers
quote: The Strabismus, Amblyopia and Refractive Error in Singaporean Children (STARS) is a population-based study in southwest Singapore.
note: A population-based sample of preschool children set up, as its name and design paper say ('The STARS study is a population-based study of eye diseases in children aged 6 to 72 months.'), to study strabismus, amblyopia and refractive error.

label: Suita Study
quote: As described elsewhere [20, 21], the Suita Study is a population-based study with a prospective cohort design, aimed at investigating CVD risk factors.
note: A random sample of an urban Japanese population followed to study the risk factors of cardiovascular disease, like Framingham.

label: SUpplementation en VItamines et Minéraux AntioXydants
quote: The targeted population is the general population (not simply high-risk subjects) and the antioxidant agents tested are being administered at a level which is not pharmacologic and which may be attained by dietary intake of natural sources of these micronutrients and/or enriched foods.
note: A primary-prevention trial in the healthy general population whose outcomes are two disease families (cancers and cardiovascular diseases), a broad purpose, as for the Women's Health Study and Physicians' Health Study in COHO.

label: Swiss Memory Genetics Study
quote: Swiss Memory Genetics Study (Swiss MGS): A total of 1,561 healthy, young Swiss university students or age-matched employees/trainees (658 from the University of Zürich and 903 from the University of Basel) were recruited for a genetic study of memory performance.
note: Healthy young adults recruited for a genetic study of a trait (memory performance), not for a disease.

label: Southampton Women's Survey
quote: In brief, 12,583 non-pregnant women aged 20-34 years were recruited to the SWS between 1998 and 2002 from the general population of Southampton, UK, with no other exclusion criteria.
note: A general-population preconception mother-offspring cohort; its stated aims (fetal and childhood growth and the children's risk factors for a range of chronic diseases) are broad, so it is not a disease cohort.

label: Tulsa 1000 study
diseases: mood disorders | anxiety disorders | substance use disorders | eating disorders
quote: The T-1000 is a naturalistic study that will recruit, assess and longitudinally follow 1000 participants, including healthy controls and treatment-seeking individuals with mood, anxiety, substance use and eating disorders.
note: The study recruits treatment-seeking people with mood, anxiety, substance use and eating disorders, with healthy controls, so its patients make it a disease cohort.

label: Type 2 Diabetes Global Genomics Initiative
quote: Through the newly established Type 2 Diabetes Global Genomics Initiative, we present findings from a very large meta-analysis of T2D GWAS data, comprising more than 2.5 million individuals of diverse ancestry—an increase of nearly threefold in the effective sample size compared with previous efforts8,9.
note: An initiative that pools type 2 diabetes case-control GWAS; classified by what it collects, so its cases make it a disease aggregation.

label: The Admixture and Neurodegeneration Genomic Landscape
diseases: Alzheimer's disease | frontotemporal lobar degeneration-motor neuron disease continuum | early-onset dementia
quote: Genomes from 900 Colombian individuals with Alzheimer’s disease (AD) [n = 376], frontotemporal lobar degeneration-motor neuron disease continuum (FTLD-MND) [n = 197], early-onset dementia not otherwise specified (EOD) [n = 73], and healthy participants [n = 254] were analyzed.
note: A sequencing cohort of Colombians with neurodegenerative diseases (Alzheimer's disease, FTLD-MND and other early-onset dementias) with affected and healthy relatives and unrelated healthy participants; recruitment targeted early-onset dementia and multiplex families.

label: Tasmanian Study of Cognition and Gait
quote: The Tasmanian Study of Cognition and Gait (TASCOG) is a population based longitudinal study of gait, cognition and brain imaging in older people.
note: A population-based random sample of older people studied for gait, cognition and brain imaging, which are traits of ageing rather than one disease.

label: Taichung CAD study
quote: TCAD (Taichung CAD study): the study includes patients with a variety of cardiovascular diseases receiving care at the Taichung Veterans General Hospital.
note: A hospital series of cardiovascular patients, chiefly those admitted for coronary angiography and intervention, named as a coronary artery disease (CAD) study.

label: The Environmental Determinants of Diabetes in the Young Study
quote: The Environmental Determinants of Diabetes in the Young (TEDDY) Study follows from birth 8676 children with T1D risk HLA-DR-DQ genotypes in the USA, Finland, Germany, and Sweden.
note: Newborns selected for HLA-DR-DQ genotypes conferring type 1 diabetes risk (and first-degree relatives of patients), followed for islet autoimmunity and type 1 diabetes.

label: Han Chinese Cell and Genome Bank in Taiwan
quote: The Han-Chinese Cell and Genome Bank in Taiwan21 includes more than 3,300 healthy controls who were recruited via a stratified, 3-staged probability clustering sampling scheme through a registry of all the 329 non-aboriginal townships or city districts in Taiwan.
note: A probability sample of healthy people used as population controls; no disease selects it.

label: Tianjin Study
quote: Patients were all histopathologically diagnosed with primary breast cancer and were consecutively recruited from the Department of Breast Surgery of Tianjin Cancer Institute and Hospital, Tianjin Medical University, China, between December 2004 and August 2005.
note: A hospital-based breast cancer case-control study; its cases make it a disease cohort.

label: Triple Negative Breast Cancer Consortium
quote: In the Triple Negative Breast Cancer Consortium (TNBCC), 22 common breast cancer susceptibility variants were investigated in 2,980 Caucasian women with triple negative breast cancer and 4,978 healthy controls.
note: A consortium pooling triple-negative breast cancer cases (with controls) from its member studies; classified by what it collects.

label: Tasmanian Older Adult Cohort Study
quote: Tasmanian Older Adult Cohort Study (TASOAC), an ongoing prospective population-based study aimed at identifying the environmental, genetic, and biochemical factors associated with the development and progression of OA at multiple sites (hand, knee, hip, and spine), which commenced in 2002.
note: A random population sample of older adults whose stated purpose is one disease, osteoarthritis (OA in the source) at several joint sites.

label: Thematically Organized Psychosis Research Study
quote: Subjects participated in a large ongoing study on schizophrenia and BD and were recruited from out-patient and in-patient psychiatric units in Norway, from May, 2003 through July, 2008.
note: Patients with schizophrenia and bipolar disorder (BD in the source, a bipolar disorder GWAS supplement) recruited from psychiatric units, with population controls; the study also takes other psychotic disorders.

label: Tampere Vascular Study
quote: The atherosclerotic vascular samples used in this study were obtained from patients subjected to carotid (N = 29) and femoral (N = 24) endarterectomy or an abdominal aortic bypass (N = 15) procedure (i.e., aortobifemoral bypass) due to occlusive atherosclerosis.
note: Patients operated on for occlusive atherosclerosis (carotid, femoral, aortic), with non-atherosclerotic arterial controls; its blood arm compares angiographically verified coronary artery disease patients with angiographically normal controls, also atherosclerotic disease.

label: Utrecht Cannabis Cohort
quote: In a sample of individuals without a psychiatric disorder (N = 1262), we analyzed the interactions between regular cannabis use and genotype with psychotic-like experiences (PLE) as outcome.
note: Non-clinical young adults recruited online; the outcome studied, psychotic-like experiences, is subclinical, and no participant was selected for a disease.

label: Dutch Bipolar Cohort
quote: DBC investigates genetic and phenotypic information of patients with bipolar disorder type I (BD‐I), their first‐degree relatives, and controls.
note: A case-control study of patients with bipolar I disorder, with their first-degree relatives and controls.

label: UK Barrett's Oesophagus Gene Study
quote: Barrett’s esophagus cases were identified at endoscopy with a confirmed histopathological diagnosis of intestinal metaplasia from the UK Barrett’s Oesophagus Gene Study.
