note: Patients with histologically confirmed Barrett's oesophagus (intestinal metaplasia at endoscopy).

label: United Kingdom Graves' disease cohort
quote: For the Graves' disease analyses, cases were recruited from the United Kingdom Graves' disease cohort and controls from the British 1958 Birth Cohort.
note: Patients with Graves' disease, the Graves' disease part of the UK autoimmune thyroid disease national collection.

label: UK Small Aneurysm Trial
quote: We randomly assigned 1090 patients aged 60-76 years, with symptomless abdominal aortic aneurysms 4.0-5.5 cm in diameter to undergo early elective open surgery (n=563) or ultrasonographic surveillance (n=527).
note: A randomised trial in patients with small asymptomatic abdominal aortic aneurysms.

label: University of Miami/Vanderbilt University/Mt. Sinai School of Medicine
quote: Each affected individual met NINCDS-ADRDA criteria for probably or definite Alzheimer’s disease (G. McKhann et al., 1984; G. M. McKhann et al., 2011) with age at onset greater than 60 years
note: A case-control collection of late-onset Alzheimer's disease (onset after 60) with cognitively healthy controls.

label: URWCI study
quote: The URWCI study recruited patients with prostate cancer between April 2016 and March 2019 from two hospitals in the United States (University of Rochester Wilmot Cancer Institute and the Medical College of Wisconsin).
note: Men with non-metastatic prostate cancer treated with curative radiotherapy and followed for late toxicity.

label: US Military HIV Natural History Study
quote: Since that time, active-duty members diagnosed with HIV infection and evaluated at participating military treatment facilities (MTFs) are offered enrollment in the NHS, an Institutional Review Board-approved protocol with written informed consent.
note: A cohort of people with HIV in US military health care: participants are enrolled because they have HIV infection.

label: Vantaa 85+ Study
quote: We have addressed this question by performing a population‐based and prospective neuropathological study on very elderly subjects (Vantaa 85+ study), to analyze the frequency and co‐occurrence of common old‐age‐associated neuropathologies and their impact on the development of clinical dementia.
note: A population-based study of all people aged 85 or over in one Finnish city, followed clinically for dementia (DSM-III-R) and by autopsy; its papers describe it as a prospective neuropathological study of the neuropathologies behind clinical dementia in the oldest old, so a population study of dementia rather than a general ageing cohort.

label: Viborg Aneurysm Screening Study
quote: Consequently, we carried out a randomised controlled trial to determine whether screening Danish men aged 64-73 for abdominal aortic aneurysms reduces mortality.
note: A randomised population screening trial of all men of a given age in one Danish county, whose stated purpose is one disease, abdominal aortic aneurysm; classified like its successor VIVA (COHO:0001129).

label: Verlauf der diagnostischen Abklärung
diseases: colorectal cancer | gastric cancer | breast cancer
quote: Briefly, residents of Saarland with a first diagnosis of colorectal cancer (CRC), gastric cancer and breast cancer below age 80 between November 1996 and February 1998 were recruited.
note: A statewide series of newly diagnosed cancer patients (colorectal, gastric and breast cancer) recruited through the hospitals of Saarland and adjacent counties.

label: Variation in Recovery: Role of Gender on Outcomes of Young AMI Patients
quote: Variation in Recovery: Role of Gender on Outcomes of Young AMI Patients (VIRGO) is a large, observational study of the presentation, treatment, and outcomes of young women and men with AMI.
note: Young women and men hospitalised with acute myocardial infarction, enrolled 2:1 female to male.

label: Vobarno Study
quote: The Vobarno Study represents the first observational study aimed to assess in a general population sample the relationship between parameters of cardiac and vascular structure (and function) and blood pressure values, measured in the clinic and during the 24 hours.
note: A random general-population sample of a small town examined for cardiac and vascular structure (left ventricular hypertrophy, carotid thickening and plaque, arterial stiffness) in relation to clinic and ambulatory blood pressure and followed for 25 years for cardiovascular morbidity and mortality; classified like PAMELA (COHO:0000143) as a population study of cardiovascular disease. The source is broad, so the broad term is used.

label: Vlagtwedde/Vlaardingen study
quote: The Vlagtwedde-Vlaardingen study is a general population based study on the epidemiology of pulmonary diseases in a general population of exclusively white individuals of Dutch descent [18,19].
note: A general population cohort of two Dutch communities whose stated purpose is the epidemiology of pulmonary diseases ('aimed to gain insight into chronic airway diseases' in the supplement of PMID:30845926).

label: Western Australian HIV Cohort Study
quote: The 125 subjects used for all cellular studies were enrolled into the WAHCS which is a prospective, observational study of HIV-infected individuals established in 1983 and approved by the Royal Perth Hospital Ethics Committee and conforms to the provisions of the Declaration of Helsinki.
note: A prospective observational cohort of HIV-infected people in care in Perth, set up to study the natural history of HIV disease.

label: Westlake Precision Birth Cohort
quote: Inclusion criteria for WeBirth involved pregnant women (1) who were aged 18 years or older and had received a diagnosis of GD, and with a gestational age ranging from 24 to 28 weeks; and (2) who intended to deliver at Hangzhou Women’s Hospital and remain in Hangzhou with their children for 4 or more years.
note: Pregnant women recruited after a diagnosis of gestational diabetes at 24-28 weeks and followed to delivery.

label: Wellcome Genetics study
quote: People with T2D (n = 3111) being treated at the Diabetes Unit, KEM Hospital (Pune, India) and associated clinics were included in the WellGen cohort.
note: A clinic-based collection of people with type 2 diabetes for genetic and phenotypic study.

label: Whitehall II Study
quote: This observation led to the initiation of the Whitehall II study in 1985 to investigate a range of possible mechanisms potentially underlying these socioeconomic inequalities in disease, most notably psychosocial stress.
note: An occupational cohort of London civil servants set up to study the mechanisms behind socioeconomic inequalities in disease in general; the first Whitehall study's gradient in cardiovascular mortality prompted it, but its stated purpose is not one disease.

label: Wuhan-Zhuhai Cohort
diseases: hypertension | dyslipidemia | cardiovascular diseases | COPD | asthma
quote: As the study endpoints, lung function declined, changes of heart rate variability (HRV), hypertension, dyslipidemia, cardiovascular diseases, COPD, and asthma will be studied.
note: A community-based cohort whose design paper is titled a study of 'environmental air particulate matter and the pathogenesis of cardiopulmonary diseases' and names these diseases as its endpoints, like SAPALDIA and SCAPIS in COHO.

label: Women's Insights and Shared Experiences Study
quote: The current report represents a subanalysis of the Women's Insights and Shared Experiences Study, a pair of case-control studies examining associations between exogenous hormone use, parity, estrogen-related genes, and endometrial or breast cancer.
note: A pair of population-based case-control studies whose cases are women with incident endometrial cancer and women with incident breast cancer.

label: Warfarin Pharmacogenomics Cohort
diseases: venous thromboembolism | stroke | transient ischemic attacks | atrial fibrillation | myocardial infarction | peripheral arterial disease
quote: Warfarin therapy requiring a target international normalized ratio (INR) range of 2-3 was initiated in patients with venous thromboembolism, stroke/transient ischemic attacks, atrial fibrillation, myocardial infarction, and/or peripheral arterial disease.
note: Every participant starts warfarin for one of these thromboembolic or cardiovascular conditions, so they are patients with them (as for WarPATH, COHO:0001433); the cohort itself is defined by the treatment, and the curator may prefer 'no' as for IWPC (COHO:0001361).

label: Wuxi Non-Communicable Diseases cohort
quote: A total of 10,858 adults aged ≥30 years old were recruited with random cluster sampling from 2 communities.
note: A population sample of two Wuxi communities, named for non-communicable diseases in general (a broad purpose); the type 2 diabetes focus belongs to the Catalog's paper, not to the cohort.

label: Wuhan-Beijing GWA study
quote: The Wuhan-Beijing GWA study (WHBJ) includes 1,461 subjects from the Dongfeng-tongji cohort study and 1,964 subjects with esophageal squamous-cell cancer from Beijing, China.
note: A case-control GWAS sample (Supplementary Method Table 1: 'Case-control') whose case group is 1,964 patients with oesophageal squamous-cell carcinoma recruited in Beijing; its other participants are Dongfeng-Tongji cohort members, a cohort that excluded people with cancer at enrolment.

label: RuiJin T2D Study
quote: The GWAS genotyped 804 type 2 diabetic patients recruited from outpatient departments of Ruijin Hospital, and 907 healthy controls were selected one glucose survey in Youyi community, Baoshan district, Shanghai
note: A case-control GWAS of type 2 diabetes (Supplementary Method Table 1: 'Case-control') whose cases are type 2 diabetes outpatients of Ruijin Hospital.

label: Suzhou study on hypertension
quote: Conducted in 2010, the Suzhou study on hypertension (Suzhou study) was a cross-sectional survey of 4 urban communities and 4 rural villages in the Jinchang district of Suzhou in China’s Jiangsu province.
note: A community survey (four urban communities and four rural villages) whose stated subject is hypertension; its participants were not selected for the disease.

label: Metformin Response cohort
quote: Included participants had a clinical diagnosis of type 2 diabetes and were treated with sulfonylureas as monotherapy or as an add-on to metformin.
note: A cohort of Kaiser Permanente patients recruited for their response to metformin, a type 2 diabetes drug; the quote describes the participants of every data set of the sulfonylurea meta-analysis, METRO among them (the same evidence as the sister cohort PMET, COHO:0002264).

label: UKCVD
quote: For Stage 2 replication, we directly genotyped 3 lead SNPs representing 2 top novel independent (r2<0.25) association signals (CSNK2A2 and FER) in a UK CVD cohort available with RTL measures on 2,952 MI patients and healthy controls.
note: The paper describes the pooled sample as myocardial infarction patients and healthy controls (it defines MI as myocardial infarction in its introduction); its member studies are a post-infarction case-control study (HIFMECH), patients with familial hypercholesterolaemia (Simon Broome), diabetes clinic patients studied for coronary heart disease (UDACS) and sons of fathers with premature myocardial infarction with controls (EARS II).

label: Santiago Bladder Cancer Study
quote: TaqMan Santiago Bladder Cancer Study (SANBCS) Hospital-based 306 68 30 - 92 83.7 21.4 339 65.7 18-97 83.8 63.3 case-control, Santiago, Spain
note: A hospital-based case-control study of bladder cancer: its cases have bladder cancer (Table S1, 'Description of bladder cancer studies used in this paper').

label: UK HumanCoreExome genotyped IBD study
diseases: inflammatory bowel disease | Crohn's disease | ulcerative colitis
quote: After quality control, data were available for 4,474 Crohn’s disease, 4,173 ulcerative colitis, 592 IBD-unclassified cases and 9,500 controls for 296,203 variants.
note: Its cases are British IBD patients ('11,768 British IBD cases, diagnosed using accepted endoscopic, histopathological and radiological criteria'), analysed as Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis and IBD; its controls are population controls.

label: International Consortium on the Genetics of Heroin Dependence - Alcohol Related Conditions
note: No source says whether the ARC subset holds heroin-dependent cases, controls or both: Yin et al. 2017 identify it only by its array, and the dbGaP record, which lists the data set's cases (Comorbidity and Trauma Study, Heroin Dependence in Western Australia, the Yale studies) and controls (CATS neighbourhood controls, OZ-ALC and Yale assessed controls, unassessed parents from the mole-development twin study), never names the subsets. The consortium (COHO:0002595) is recorded as patients with heroin dependence; if the curator takes the subset to share the data set's case-control design, that verdict applies, but a subset may hold controls only.

label: International Consortium on the Genetics of Heroin Dependence - Center for Inherited Disease Research
note: No source says whether the CIDR subset holds heroin-dependent cases, controls or both: Yin et al. 2017 identify it only by its array, and the dbGaP record, which lists the data set's cases (Comorbidity and Trauma Study, Heroin Dependence in Western Australia, the Yale studies) and controls (CATS neighbourhood controls, OZ-ALC and Yale assessed controls, unassessed parents from the mole-development twin study), never names the subsets. The consortium (COHO:0002595) is recorded as patients with heroin dependence; if the curator takes the subset to share the data set's case-control design, that verdict applies, but a subset may hold controls only. For this subset the answer is probably yes: the CATS cases and controls were genotyped on the same array at CIDR (PMID:26239289), but no source ties them to the subset by name.

label: International Consortium on the Genetics of Heroin Dependence - Research on Alcohol and Tobacco Related Phenotypes
note: No source says whether the RATRP subset holds heroin-dependent cases, controls or both: Yin et al. 2017 identify it only by its array, and the dbGaP record, which lists the data set's cases (Comorbidity and Trauma Study, Heroin Dependence in Western Australia, the Yale studies) and controls (CATS neighbourhood controls, OZ-ALC and Yale assessed controls, unassessed parents from the mole-development twin study), never names the subsets. The consortium (COHO:0002595) is recorded as patients with heroin dependence; if the curator takes the subset to share the data set's case-control design, that verdict applies, but a subset may hold controls only.

label: Florence Acute Myocardial Infarction-2 registry
quote: In total, 978 acute myocardial infarction patients were enrolled in this study; of these, 146 died and 832 survived during 2 years of follow-up after the acute myocardial infarction.

label: Chinese Glioma Genome Atlas
quote: According to the pathological reassessment of independent neuropathologists, all the subjects were consistently diagnosed with glioma and were then further classified according to the 2007/2016 WHO classification system.

label: CRYOSTEM
quote: The initial objective of the constitution of the collection was to conduct research in the field of GvHD, being the major complication of HSCT. This research topic was broadened to all the complications of HSCT, after validation in March 2016 by the Committee of the Protection of Persons – CPP – South Mediterranean I.

label: Dana-Farber Cancer Institute ALL Consortium
quote: Between 1985–2000, 1457 children aged 0–18 years with newly diagnosed ALL (excluding mature B-cell ALL) were enrolled on four consecutive DFCI ALL Consortium protocols: 85-01 (1981–5, N=220), 87-01 (1987–91, N=369), 91-01 (1991–5, N=377) and 95-01 (1996–2000, N=491).

label: Early Life Interventions for Childhood Growth and Development in Tanzania
quote: Our goal was to test whether administration of scheduled antimicrobials and daily nicotinamide improved linear growth in a region with a high prevalence of stunting and enteric pathogen carriage.

label: Human Tissue Laboratory
quote: HTL’s access to all tissues involved in diabetes from the same individuals allows the researchers to map the genetic and environmental factors that may cause type 1 diabetes and type 2 diabetes.

label: FLAVonoids: University of Reading Study
quote: Participants with a CVD relative risk of 1.5 assessed by risk scores were randomly assigned to one of the 3 groups: habitual (control, CT), high-flavonoid (HF) or low-flavonoid (LF) diets.

label: Human Metabolome study
quote: To analyze the dynamics of the human metabolome in response to environmental stimuli, we submitted 15 young healthy male volunteers to a highly controlled 4 d challenge protocol, including 36 h fasting, oral glucose and lipid tests, liquid test meals, physical exercise, and cold stress.

label: Immunophenotyping Assessment in a COVID-19 Cohort
quote: The study population consists of adult participants hospitalized with known or presumptive coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), a human disease caused by Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus-2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection.

label: Interactive Diet and Activity Tracking in AARP Study
quote: From January through September 2012, 1,110 adult members of AARP, 50 to 74 years of age, were recruited from the Pittsburgh, PA, area to participate in the Interactive Diet and Activity Tracking in AARP (IDATA) study.

label: Isala
quote: Here we established the Isala citizen-science project to analyse the vaginal microbiomes of 3,345 women in Belgium (18–98 years) through self-sampling, 16S amplicon sequencing and extensive questionnaires.

label: Mutographs
diseases: esophageal squamous cell carcinoma | renal cell carcinoma | colorectal cancer | pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma | gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma | head and neck cancer | urinary bladder cancer | gallbladder cancer
quote: Five initial cancer types, esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC), renal cell carcinoma (RCC), colorectal cancer (CRC), pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), and gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (GEJ), including both esophageal adenocarcinoma (EAD) and adenocarcinomas of gastric cardia, were selected based on the following criteria: (1) cancers with the highest differences in incidence across geographical regions, (2) cancers accounting for more than 10% of new cases and about 20% of deaths, and (3) cancers for which prevalence of known risk factors (i.e., smoking, alcohol, and obesity) do not fully explain the large geographical and temporal differences across regions (Figure 3).
note: The quote names the five initial cancer types; the same source adds the other three: 'Three additional cancer types were subsequently integrated in the study based on marked regional incidence differences and/or specific exposures of interest: (1) head and neck cancer (HNC), ...; (2) urinary bladder cancer (UBC), ...; and (3) gallbladder cancer (GBC), ...' (PMC10943582)

label: NCI-UMD-German cohort
quote: Pancreatic tumor tissues from resected PDAC patients were collected at the University of Maryland Medical System (UMMS) in Baltimore, MD, through an NCI-UMD resource contract and at the University Medical Center Göttingen, Germany.

label: NR-SAFE
quote: NR-SAFE is a double-blinded randomized safety study aiming to determine the safety and tolerability of nicotinamide riboside (NR) at a daily dose of 3000mg, in individuals with Parkinson's disease (PD).

label: OmegaROP
quote: Extremely preterm infants are at high risk for retinopathy of prematurity (ROP), a potentially blinding disease characterized by abnormalities in retinal vascularization.

label: RA-MAP Consortium
quote: The “Towards A Cure for Early Rheumatoid Arthritis” (TACERA) study12 was designed to detect distinct disease subtypes and the immunological correlates of disease activity and autoimmunity in patients with early, seropositive RA, with a secondary objective to investigate biomarkers of initial drug response to methotrexate.

label: Towards A Cure for Early Rheumatoid Arthritis
quote: Patients with early untreated seropositive RA were recruited from 28 UK centres.

label: Screening Across the Lifespan Twin Study
quote: Briefly, SALT aimed to screen for the most common complex diseases among twins enrolled in the STR born prior to 1959.
note: Aimed to screen for 'the most common complex diseases' among twins: a population screen with a broad purpose, not a disease of interest.

label: TOFI_Asia
quote: The cross-sectional thin-on-the-outside-fat-on-the-inside (TOFI)_Asia study investigated adipose depots and clinical biomarkers as predictors of fasting plasma glucose (FPG) and insulin resistance (IR; assessed using the updated homeostatic model assessment of IR) in lean and overweight normo- and dysglycemic Chinese (n = 199) and Caucasian (n = 158) individuals.

label: The Effect of Dietary Bioactives on Gut Microbiome Diversity
quote: We conducted a randomised crossover intervention trial to assess alterations to the gut microbiome, urinary and faecal metabolites in 20 healthy subjects receiving two-week high- or low-bioactive diets, separated by a 4-week washout period.

label: VMET study
quote: Eligibility criteria were pregnant women with a singleton pregnancy, with and without risk factors for preterm birth.

label: Vaginal Microbiome and Metabonome in Pregnancy study
quote: Women were defined as being at risk of preterm birth if they had a history of cervical excisional treatment for pre-cancerous cells, a previous preterm birth or mid-trimester loss, or other risk factors such as previous caesarean section at full cervical dilation or congenital uterine anomaly.

label: Zambia Exclusive Breastfeeding Study
quote: All HIV-seropositive pregnant subjects electing to breastfeed their child will be counselled to exclusively breastfeed through 4 months of age.

label: International Pediatric Dialysis Network
quote: This retrospective real-world study used data from two registries, International Pediatric Peritoneal Dialysis Network (IPPN) and International Pediatric Hemodialysis Network (IPHN), to characterize the efficacy and safety of continuous erythropoietin receptor activator (C.E.R.A.) in pediatric patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) on peritoneal dialysis (PD) or hemodialysis (HD).

label: Polish Mother and Child Cohort
quote: The general aim of the REPRO_PL cohort is to evaluate the impact of occupational, environmental and lifestyle-related exposures during the prenatal period and after birth on pregnancy outcomes and/or offspring health during various stages of life (infancy, childhood and adolescence).

label: Mediterranean PHIME cohort
quote: We designed a prospective cohort to investigate the effects of prenatal low-level mercury exposure from maternal consumption of fish and seafood on child neurodevelopment among residents of the Mediterranean coastal areas of 4 neighboring countries.
